65749.recognize_zh: 淋巴結被大小不一、核不規則的中至大型淋巴球瀰漫取代；免疫染色 CD3 全面陽性，卻同時表現 CD20、CD30、CD15 與 TFH 標記（BCL6、ICOS、PD-1），ALK 陰性，FISH 見 DUSP22/IRF4 訊號異常。
features: Diffuse effacement by pleomorphic intermediate to large lymphoid cells with irregular, angulated and elongated nuclei
Hyperchromatic nuclei with inconspicuous to small nucleoli and scant pale cytoplasm; background of sparse stroma
Diffuse membranous CD3 and aberrant diffuse CD20 on the same neoplastic population
CD30 strong and diffuse; CD15 positive in a large subset
Nuclear BCL6 and IRF4/MUM1, membranous ICOS and PD-1 positivity; ALK-1 negative
FISH with IRF4/DUSP22 break-apart probe showing extra fusion signals
65749.describe_en: Lymph node biopsy shows effaced architecture with a diffuse infiltrate of pleomorphic, intermediate to large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei. The neoplastic cells are diffusely positive for CD3, CD20 (aberrant), CD30 and CD15, with nuclear BCL6 and IRF4/MUM1 and membranous ICOS and PD-1, while ALK-1 is negative. FISH with an IRF4/DUSP22 break-apart probe shows increased fusion signals, indicating DUSP22 locus gain. Findings are consistent with peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS, with an unusual CD20+/CD15+/CD30+ T follicular helper-like phenotype and DUSP22 alteration.

ddx.dx: ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma, DUSP22-rearranged
ddx.vs: ALCL shows hallmark cells in cohesive sheets with uniform strong CD30 and frequent loss of T-cell antigens, and typically lacks TFH markers and CD20 expression.

ddx.dx: Nodal T follicular helper cell lymphoma, angioimmunoblastic type
ddx.vs: AITL has a polymorphous background with arborizing HEVs, expanded CD21+ FDC meshworks and EBV+ B immunoblasts, rather than a monotonous CD30+ sheet.
CD30+/CD15+ HRS cells in cHL are scattered in an inflammatory background and are CD3-negative, CD45-negative and weakly PAX5-positive, unlike this diffuse CD3+ PAX5-negative infiltrate.
CD20 alone is misleading here; the cells are CD3+, CD79a-negative and PAX5-negative, excluding a B-cell lineage.

65621.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 H&E 中骨小樑旁有一層較寬、細胞質淡染至透明、核圓的未成熟顆粒球系細胞，而小樑間以核深染的小細胞（紅血球前驅細胞/淋巴球）為主、成熟分葉嗜中性球不明顯；需搭配 MPO 染色確認為成熟停滯的顆粒球系。
features: H&E bone marrow trephine at low power with two bony trabeculae
Paratrabecular expansion of medium-to-large cells with round nuclei and pale to clear cytoplasm (immature granulocytes)
Intertrabecular areas with clusters of small cells with dark round nuclei (erythroid islands/lymphocytes)
Paucity of recognizable segmented neutrophils
Scattered adipocytes; megakaryocytes present but not conspicuous
65621.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine shows bony trabeculae lined by an expanded paratrabecular layer of medium to large cells with round nuclei and pale to clear cytoplasm, consistent with immature granulocytic precursors. The intertrabecular spaces contain clusters of small cells with dense round nuclei representing erythroid precursors and lymphocytes, with scattered adipocytes. Recognizable mature segmented neutrophils are sparse. The granulocytic nature and maturation stage of the paratrabecular cells are better defined by MPO immunostaining; in the setting of a pathogenic ELANE variant, findings are consistent with severe congenital neutropenia with maturation arrest.

ddx.vs: The paratrabecular cells here are MPO-positive granulocytic precursors, whereas lymphoma or carcinoma would be MPO-negative and CD20/CD3 or cytokeratin positive.
AML shows diffuse effacement by blasts with loss of normal topography rather than a paratrabecular layer with preserved erythroid islands.

ddx.dx: Reactive left shift after G-CSF or infection
ddx.vs: Maturation continues to abundant band and segmented neutrophils, whereas they are sparse here.

65237.recognize_zh: 細胞量豐富的骨髓抹片中央有一顆大型巨核細胞，核分成數個圓形分離的核葉，周圍是顆粒球前驅細胞與紅血球母細胞，部分細胞可見細小空泡；支持 VEXAS 骨髓的高細胞性與異生變化。
features: Hypercellular aspirate with left-shifted granulopoiesis and erythroid precursors
Large megakaryocyte with several rounded, partially separated nuclear lobes
Deeply basophilic megakaryocyte cytoplasm with limited granularity
Scattered small clear cytoplasmic vacuoles in some precursors
Mature neutrophils and bands; no increase in blasts evident
65237.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular with left-shifted granulopoiesis and erythroid precursors. A large megakaryocyte with several rounded, partially separated nuclear lobes and basophilic cytoplasm is present, suggestive of dysmegakaryopoiesis. Scattered myeloid precursors contain small clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, and blasts are not increased. In a patient with a UBA1 p.Met41Leu variant, findings are consistent with the hypercellular marrow with dysplastic features and precursor vacuolization of VEXAS syndrome.

ddx.vs: Dysmegakaryopoiesis is shared, so the absence of UBA1 mutation and inflammatory syndrome favors primary MDS.
MPNs show clustered large hyperlobated or bulbous megakaryocytes with JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations rather than separated-nuclei forms with precursor vacuoles.
Reactive megakaryocytes are normally lobulated without separated round nuclei, and precursors lack vacuoles.

65301.recognize_zh: 一群聚集的淋巴球，細胞質比典型 CLL 更豐富、淡藍色，核呈多角形或有切跡、染色質中度凝集且無明顯核仁，屬於 CLL 伴 trisomy 12 常見的非典型形態。
features: Clustered medium-sized lymphocytes with moderate pale blue cytoplasm
Angulated, notched or indented nuclear contours
Moderately condensed, somewhat smooth chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Cytoplasmic borders molded against adjacent cells and red cells
Normochromic normocytic red cells; no smudge cells in this field
65301.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased lymphocytes, several clustered in the center of the field. The cells are medium sized with a moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm, angulated to notched nuclei, and moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli. The red cells are unremarkable. The morphology is that of atypical CLL, which is associated with trisomy 12; immunophenotyping is needed to exclude other small B-cell neoplasms.

ddx.vs: MCL shares irregular nuclei but is CD23-negative and cyclin D1-positive with t(11;14).
LPL shows plasmacytoid lymphocytes with eccentric nuclei and a paranuclear hof, is usually CD5-negative, and carries MYD88 L265P.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous in size with basophilic cytoplasm skirting red cells and are polyclonal on flow cytometry.

65173.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中多個紅血球內可見單一、小而圓、深紫色的核殘餘（Howell-Jolly bodies，箭頭），伴隨靶形紅血球與輕度血小板增加；腹部 CT 脾臟明顯變小，提示脾功能低下（splenic hypoplasia）。
features: Multiple red cells containing a single small, round, dense, eccentric basophilic inclusion (Howell-Jolly bodies, arrows)
Occasional target cells among normochromic red cells
Scattered crenated red cells (echinocytes), likely preparation artifact
Platelets mildly increased in number, normal size
Coronal CT: markedly small spleen (arrow) in the left upper quadrant with an elongated left hepatic lobe
65173.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous red cells containing Howell-Jolly bodies, occasional target cells and scattered echinocytes, with mildly increased platelets. Leukocytes are not represented in this field. Coronal abdominal CT demonstrates a markedly hypoplastic spleen. In the absence of prior splenectomy, findings are consistent with functional hyposplenism due to splenic hypoplasia, accounting for the persistent reactive thrombocytosis.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are multiple small peripheral clustered granules that are Prussian blue positive, whereas Howell-Jolly bodies are usually single, larger, round and DNA-containing.
An overlying platelet shows a pale halo and fine granules and is often out of the red cell's focal plane, unlike the dense homogeneous Howell-Jolly body within the cell.
Ring forms show a blue cytoplasmic ring with a red chromatin dot rather than a solid round dense purple sphere.
ET causes thrombocytosis with large platelets and no Howell-Jolly bodies unless hyposplenism from splenic infarction coexists; driver mutation testing was negative here.

exam.answer_en: Hyposplenism due to splenic hypoplasia — numerous Howell-Jolly bodies, target cells and reactive thrombocytosis; CT shows a small spleen
pearls_zh: 考法：指紅血球內單一深紫圓點問名稱；答 Howell-Jolly body（DNA 核殘餘），代表脾臟清除功能低下，再追問原因：脾切除、功能性無脾或脾發育不全。
功能性無脾常見原因：sickle cell disease（autosplenectomy）、celiac disease、脾梗塞、脾放射治療；脾功能低下也可見 target cell、acanthocyte、Pappenheimer body 與血小板增多。
臨床意義：有 overwhelming post-splenectomy infection 風險（S. pneumoniae、H. influenzae、N. meningitidis 等莢膜菌），需完成疫苗並衛教發燒即就醫。
染色區分：Howell-Jolly body 含 DNA、Prussian blue 陰性；Pappenheimer body 含鐵、Prussian blue 陽性。
exam.pitfall_zh: 常與 Pappenheimer body 或重疊的血小板混淆；Howell-Jolly body 通常單一、較大、圓且緻密，Pappenheimer body 為多顆細小周邊聚集顆粒且鐵染色陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球內單一深紫圓形包涵體稱為什麼？提示何種脾臟狀態？

65109.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片 100 倍：中央與左下有大型細胞，染色質細緻、細胞質豐富且呈深藍嗜鹼性，核略偏心（plasmablast 樣），左上另見一個有絲分裂中的大型嗜鹼性細胞；背景為各階段顆粒球與紅血球系前驅細胞。
features: Large cells with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm and slightly eccentric nuclei with fine, open chromatin
Nucleoli are not well resolved at this focus; one large cell shows faint perinuclear clearing
A large basophilic cell in metaphase (mitotic figure) at upper left
Background maturing myeloid cells including an eosinophilic myelocyte and a neutrophilic metamyelocyte/band
Several basophilic and polychromatic erythroblasts with dense round nuclei
65109.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at 100x shows scattered large cells with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, slightly eccentric nuclei and fine, open chromatin, consistent with plasmablasts, one of which appears to be in mitosis. These cells are admixed with normal trilineage elements, including eosinophilic and neutrophilic granulocytic precursors and erythroblasts. The large basophilic cells are not specific by morphology alone and may resemble proerythroblasts or immunoblasts. Findings are compatible with marrow plasmablasts in the setting of HHV8-associated multicentric Castleman disease, pending LANA-1 immunostaining of the trephine biopsy.

ddx.vs: Proerythroblasts have intensely royal-blue cytoplasm with small blebs and a central round nucleus, while plasmablasts show eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and are CD138/MUM1-positive and glycophorin-negative.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with plasmablastic morphology
ddx.vs: Myeloma shows sheets of light-chain-restricted plasma cells and a paraprotein, whereas MCD plasmablasts are scattered, HHV8-positive and accompanied by normal hematopoiesis.
Immunoblasts have a central prominent nucleolus and are HHV8-negative and polytypic, requiring IHC or clinical context to separate.

64789.recognize_zh: 股骨病灶切片中大量組織球的細胞質充滿嗜酸性、顆粒狀至結晶狀物質（晶體儲積組織球，箭頭），混有嗜酸性球與散在短紡錘形細胞（箭頭尖）；KIT 免疫染色標出成群紡錘狀肥大細胞，提示病灶其實是系統性肥大細胞增生症。
features: MRI (A): solitary lesion in the left proximal femur (arrow)
H&E (B): numerous large histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic granular to crystalline cytoplasm (crystal-storing histiocytes) and small round nuclei
Admixed eosinophils and scattered short spindle cells with pale amphophilic cytoplasm (arrowheads)
H&E (C): small clusters of spindle cells with elongated oval nuclei adjacent to marrow and bone trabecula
IHC KIT (D): strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining of spindle and round mast cells in aggregates
64789.describe_en: MRI demonstrates a solitary lesion in the left femur. Sections show a prominent infiltrate of histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic, granular to crystalline cytoplasm, admixed with eosinophils and scattered short spindle cells with pale amphophilic cytoplasm that focally form small clusters. KIT immunohistochemistry highlights numerous spindle-shaped cells in aggregates, supporting a mast cell origin. In conjunction with CD25 expression and KIT D816V, the findings are consistent with systemic mastocytosis with associated crystal-storing histiocytosis (Charcot-Leyden-type crystals in an eosinophil-rich lesion).

ddx.dx: Crystal-storing histiocytosis due to plasma cell neoplasm/lymphoma
ddx.vs: Immunoglobulin-derived crystals are accompanied by a clonal light-chain-restricted plasma cell or B-cell population, whereas here KIT+/CD25+ mast cells and eosinophils are present.
LCH shows grooved Langerhans cells that are CD1a+/S100+/langerin+, while these histiocytes are CD1a- and S100-.
Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are S100+ and show emperipolesis, which is absent here.
These have granular eosinophilic cells that are desmin or S100/SOX10 positive rather than CD68+ histiocytes with KIT+ spindle mast cells.

64725.recognize_zh: 臨床照片中前臂伸側散布多個大小相近、表面光滑的膚色至淡粉紅色圓頂狀丘疹與小結節，未見潰瘍或鱗屑；在已知復發 AML 的病人身上出現新的多發丘疹結節，應懷疑白血病皮膚浸潤並切片確認。
features: Multiple discrete, dome-shaped, smooth-surfaced papules and small nodules on the forearm
Skin-colored to pink/violaceous hue, roughly uniform size of a few millimeters
Scattered distribution without grouping, vesiculation, scale, crusting, or ulceration
No purpura or hemorrhagic component evident in this photograph
64725.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the forearm shows numerous discrete, firm-appearing, dome-shaped papules and small nodules that are skin-colored to pink, fairly uniform in size, and scattered over the extensor and flexor surfaces. There is no scale, vesiculation, crusting, ulceration, or purpura. The appearance is nonspecific on its own, but in a patient with relapsed AML with t(10;11)(p11.2;q23) shortly after remission, the eruption is suggestive of leukemia cutis, which requires skin biopsy with immunohistochemistry for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Sweet syndrome presents with tender, edematous, erythematous plaques with pseudovesicles and fever, and biopsy shows a dermal neutrophilic infiltrate without blasts.

ddx.dx: Disseminated infection (fungal, mycobacterial, or bacterial emboli)
ddx.vs: Infectious papules are often necrotic, pustular or umbilicated in a neutropenic host and biopsy/culture shows organisms rather than a myeloid blast infiltrate.
Drug eruptions are usually pruritic, erythematous morbilliform or urticarial and temporally linked to a new drug, with a perivascular inflammatory infiltrate on biopsy.
BPDCN typically forms bruise-like violaceous plaques and nodules and is CD123/TCF4+, whereas AML cutis expresses MPO, lysozyme or monocytic markers on biopsy.

64405.recognize_zh: 兩個視野中最顯眼的是大型巨核細胞；上圖中央有一顆細胞質豐富淡染、呈細小泡沫/皺褶狀的大型組織球，是本圖提示儲積細胞（Gaucher cell）的線索，但典型「皺紋紙」紋路在此解析度下不夠清楚。
features: Megakaryocytes with abundant granular cytoplasm and large lobulated nuclei in both panels
Large histiocyte (upper panel, center) with small eccentric nucleus and abundant pale cytoplasm containing fine vacuoles/fibrillary texture
Adjacent pale, faintly striated cytoplasmic areas suggestive of storage cells, but classic crumpled tissue-paper striations are not well resolved
Background trilineage hematopoiesis with erythroid precursors and granulocytic cells
Image is somewhat out of focus with color artifact, limiting evaluation
64405.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show intact trilineage hematopoiesis with readily identified megakaryocytes. The upper panel contains a large histiocytic cell with a small eccentric nucleus and abundant pale, finely vacuolated to fibrillary cytoplasm, and nearby pale storage-type cytoplasm; the characteristic wrinkled tissue-paper appearance of Gaucher cells is not sharply resolved due to focus and image quality. Findings are suggestive of a storage histiocyte in the appropriate clinical context of Gaucher disease; confirmation requires glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay and/or GBA1 genotyping.

ddx.vs: Niemann-Pick cells have uniformly bubbly, soap-bubble vacuolated cytoplasm, whereas Gaucher cells have fibrillary crumpled tissue-paper cytoplasm; the vacuolated cell here overlaps with this appearance.
Pseudo-Gaucher cells in CML, myeloma or mycobacterial infection look identical by light microscopy and are distinguished by clinical context and normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green granules on Romanowsky stain, not pale striated cytoplasm.
Megakaryocytes have large multilobated nuclei with granular pink-purple cytoplasm, whereas Gaucher cells have a small eccentric nucleus with pale fibrillary cytoplasm.

64277.recognize_zh: 左側為三維立體、細胞核重疊的惡性細胞團（細胞核大、核仁明顯），右側一顆大細胞帶有巨大細胞質空泡把多個核擠到一邊（印戒樣），這些都不是間皮細胞或發炎細胞，符合肺癌轉移至肋膜積液。
features: Cohesive three-dimensional cluster of large cells with high N:C ratio and nuclear overlap/molding (left)
Enlarged round nuclei with prominent magenta nucleoli
Large cell/cell group with a single giant cytoplasmic vacuole compressing nuclei to one side (signet ring-like, right)
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with fine vacuolation
Clean background with few scattered small inflammatory cells and cell debris
64277.describe_en: Pleural fluid cytospin shows cohesive three-dimensional clusters of large atypical epithelial cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, nuclear crowding and molding, and prominent nucleoli. A separate cell group shows a large intracytoplasmic vacuole displacing the nuclei peripherally, imparting a signet ring-like appearance. The background contains only scattered inflammatory cells, and a population of these cells is foreign to the normal mesothelial and inflammatory cell repertoire. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma, favoring adenocarcinoma given the vacuolated cytoplasm, in keeping with the known lung primary; immunocytochemistry (e.g., TTF-1, MOC-31/Ber-EP4 versus calretinin) on a cell block is recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive mesothelial cells form flat or small loose groups with 'windows' between cells, two-tone cytoplasm and a single small nucleolus, and are calretinin/WT1 positive and MOC-31/Ber-EP4 negative.
Mesothelioma can form 3D balls but lacks true mucin vacuoles and is calretinin, WT1 and D2-40 positive with loss of BAP1 or CDKN2A deletion.
Hematolymphoid malignancies present as dyscohesive single cells without clusters, molding or signet ring vacuoles.
Histiocytes are dispersed single cells with bean-shaped nuclei and foamy cytoplasm, and are CD68 positive and keratin negative.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic adenocarcinoma (lung primary) in pleural fluid — 3D cohesive clusters with prominent nucleoli and signet ring-like vacuolated cells
pearls_zh: 考法：體液抹片問「這群細胞是間皮細胞、發炎細胞還是外來細胞？」關鍵是出現第二族群（second population）、三維細胞團與核重疊。
Cell block IHC：腺癌 MOC-31、Ber-EP4、claudin-4 陽性，肺來源 TTF-1、Napsin A 陽性；間皮細胞 calretinin、WT1、D2-40 陽性。
惡性肋膜積液在肺癌 TNM 分期屬 M1a，即 stage IV。
積液 cell block 可做分子檢測（EGFR、ALK、ROS1 等）指引標靶治療；台灣肺腺癌 EGFR 突變比例高。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與反應性間皮細胞混淆；間皮細胞呈扁平或鬆散小團、細胞間有 windows、細胞質雙色調，惡性細胞則為三維團塊、核重疊與明顯核仁。

quiz.q: 區分腺癌細胞與間皮細胞最常用的 IHC 標記組合為何？
quiz.a: MOC-31/Ber-EP4（腺癌陽性）對比 calretinin/WT1（間皮細胞陽性）。

64149.recognize_zh: 淋巴結高倍下為大片嗜伊紅性壞死與核碎屑，其中散佈形狀不規則、均質無結構的深藍紫色團塊（hematoxylin body），且看不到嗜中性球浸潤；這種帶藍色核物質團塊的無膿壞死，是紅斑性狼瘡淋巴結病的特徵。
features: Extensive eosinophilic, granular necrosis with abundant karyorrhectic debris
Scattered irregular, homogeneous, smudgy dark blue-purple amorphous bodies (hematoxylin bodies) lacking nuclear detail
Admixed intact small round lymphoid cells, plasmacytoid cells, and histiocytes
Congested vessels and scattered fine brown-black granular pigment in the necrotic zone
Neutrophils are not a conspicuous component
64149.describe_en: Lymph node section at high power shows extensive eosinophilic necrosis with abundant karyorrhectic debris and admixed lymphocytes and histiocytes. Scattered within the necrotic zone are irregular, homogeneous, deeply basophilic amorphous bodies without nuclear structure, representing hematoxylin bodies (altered nuclear material bound by antinuclear antibodies). Neutrophils are not a prominent component, and no atypical large cells are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with necrotizing lymphadenitis of systemic lupus erythematosus; correlation with serology (ANA, anti-dsDNA) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Kikuchi shows similar non-neutrophilic karyorrhectic necrosis with crescentic MPO+ histiocytes and CD123+ plasmacytoid dendritic cells but lacks hematoxylin bodies, which are the discriminating feature of lupus.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell or peripheral T-cell lymphoma with necrosis
ddx.vs: Lymphoma shows sheets of atypical large cells at the edges of necrosis, confirmed by monotypic/aberrant immunophenotype, whereas the viable cells here are small and mixed.
Infectious necrosis contains neutrophilic abscesses or palisading epithelioid granulomas, with organisms on special stains, rather than hematoxylin bodies.

exam.answer_en: Lupus lymphadenitis — necrotizing lymphadenitis with karyorrhectic debris and hematoxylin bodies
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指壞死區中無核構造、均質深紫藍的不規則小體問名稱；答 hematoxylin body，是抗核抗體結合變性核物質所形成，為 SLE 相對特異的組織學表現。
Hematoxylin body 與骨髓/血液中的 LE cell 為同一機轉（ANA 修飾的核物質）；看到後應建議 ANA、anti-dsDNA、補體 C3/C4 檢查。
另一個支持 lupus 的線索為 Azzopardi phenomenon：血管壁被嗜鹼性 DNA 物質沉積；壞死區常見漿細胞較多。
組織學上 lupus lymphadenitis 與 Kikuchi（histiocytic necrotizing lymphadenitis）幾乎相同，Kikuchi 病人日後可發展 SLE，故需長期追蹤血清學。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤診為 Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease：兩者皆為缺乏嗜中性球的 karyorrhectic 壞死，但 Kikuchi 沒有 hematoxylin body；另需與 T-cell lymphoma（非典型大細胞、clonal TCR）區分。

quiz.q: 圖中壞死區內均質、深嗜鹼性、無核結構的小體叫什麼？最支持哪個診斷？
quiz.a: Hematoxylin body；支持 systemic lupus erythematosus lymphadenitis。

64021.recognize_zh: 這是右大腿CT矢狀面重組影像（非形態學圖片），髖部下方、股骨近端內側軟組織中有一團邊界清楚、密度如骨的不規則鈣化團塊，周圍肌肉無明顯大塊積血，在血友病A病人中代表肌肉出血後的異位性骨化（heterotopic ossification）。
features: Sagittal CT reformation of the right thigh from hip to knee
Dense, lobulated, bone-density mass in the proximal thigh soft tissues below the acetabulum/femoral head
Mass has a mature ossified appearance with a cortical rim and internal trabecular-like pattern
No large fluid-density collection or cortical destruction of the distal femur in this plane
Knee joint and distal femur visible at the lower end of the image
64021.describe_en: Sagittal reformatted CT image of the right thigh demonstrates a dense, lobulated, bone-density mass within the proximal medial thigh soft tissues just below the hip joint. The lesion shows mature ossification with a peripheral cortical-type rim, without an associated large fluid-density collection or aggressive periosteal reaction in this plane. In a patient with hemophilia A, this represents heterotopic ossification, likely sequela of prior intramuscular hemorrhage; the reported full extent bridges the medial femoral metaphysis and ischium/inferior pubic ramus, measuring 8 x 4.4 cm. This is a radiologic image, and histologic features cannot be assessed.

ddx.vs: Pseudotumors are encapsulated expanding hematomas with fluid/blood density and bone erosion, rather than a mature ossified mass.
Malignant bone-forming tumors show central dense immature mineralization with soft tissue mass and aggressive growth, whereas heterotopic ossification matures from the periphery inward (zonation).
Imaging appearance is essentially the same; the distinction rests on the clinical context of hemophilia-related bleeding rather than on imaging.

63957.recognize_zh: 六格中的異常骨髓細胞，核呈摺疊或分葉狀，細胞質中含大而圓、粉紅至橘紅色的球狀包涵體（pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules），D 格則是較典型的密集紫紅細顆粒；配合流式 CD34−、HLA-DR− 與 PML::RARA，這些大顆粒是 APL 中 Auer rod 的變異形式。
features: Medium to large cells with folded, lobulated or bilobed nuclei and moderately condensed chromatin
Large round pink-orange to salmon globular cytoplasmic inclusions (pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules), often multiple (A, B, E)
Some cells with pale cytoplasmic vacuoles and fewer inclusions (B, C)
Panel D: cell with numerous coarse purple-red azurophilic granules typical of promyelocytes
Panel F: trilobed cell with a thin slender pink rod-like inclusion; background normal red cells
63957.describe_en: This composite of six fields from a bone marrow aspirate smear shows abnormal myeloid cells with folded to lobulated nuclei and moderately abundant pale cytoplasm. Many cells contain large, round, pink-orange globular inclusions consistent with pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules, some accompanied by cytoplasmic vacuoles, while an occasional cell (D) shows the more usual dense coarse azurophilic granulation and another (F) shows a slender rod-like inclusion. In combination with the reported CD34-negative, HLA-DR-negative, CD11b-negative myeloid immunophenotype, these findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia with prominent pseudo-Chediak-Higashi inclusions, requiring PML::RARA confirmation.

ddx.vs: True Chediak-Higashi granules are present in all granulocytes and lymphocytes of mature normal-appearing cells in a child with albinism and immunodeficiency, not in a clonal leukemic population.

ddx.dx: AML with maturation or other AML with PCH inclusions
ddx.vs: PCH granules also occur in non-APL AML and MDS, so HLA-DR and CD34 expression plus absence of PML::RARA separate them from APL.

ddx.dx: Hemophagocytosing or erythrophagocytic blasts (e.g. AML with t(8;16))
ddx.vs: Phagocytosed red cells are pale biconcave discs within a vacuole rather than dense homogeneous salmon globules.

ddx.dx: Toxic granulation or Dohle bodies in reactive neutrophils
ddx.vs: Toxic granules are fine dark and Dohle bodies are pale blue peripheral patches in mature segmented neutrophils, not large eosinophilic globules in abnormal promyelocytes.

63893.recognize_zh: 視野中大量小而圓、染色較深且缺乏中央淡染區的小球形紅血球（microspherocytes），與正常有中央淡染的紅血球及較大、偏藍的多染性紅血球混雜，呈明顯大小不均；配合家族史、脾腫大與 EMA binding 下降支持遺傳性球形紅血球症。
features: Numerous small, dense, round red cells lacking central pallor (microspherocytes)
Marked anisocytosis with admixed normal-sized biconcave red cells showing central pallor
Larger, slightly bluish-gray polychromatic red cells indicating reticulocytosis
Occasional ovalocytes and a few irregular forms; no significant schistocytes
Platelets present, small clumps; no nucleated cells in this field
63893.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisocytosis with numerous microspherocytes, which are small, dense red cells lacking central pallor. Interspersed are normal biconcave red cells and larger polychromatophilic cells indicating reticulocytosis. Schistocytes, agglutination and target cells are not prominent. Spherocytes are not specific, and autoimmune hemolysis must be excluded with a direct antiglobulin test. Findings are consistent with hereditary spherocytosis in the provided clinical context (positive family history, splenomegaly and reduced EMA binding).

ddx.vs: Spherocytes look identical; a positive direct antiglobulin test, absence of family history and normal EMA binding favor AIHA.

ddx.dx: ABO hemolytic disease of the newborn / delayed hemolytic transfusion reaction
ddx.vs: These are immune-mediated with a positive DAT and a relevant transfusion or neonatal history.
MAHA shows schistocytes (helmet and triangle fragments) with thrombocytopenia rather than intact round microspherocytes.
Thermal or toxin injury produces microspherocytes and budding fragments acutely in a clear clinical setting without chronic familial hemolysis.

exam.answer_en: Hereditary spherocytosis — numerous microspherocytes lacking central pallor with polychromasia
pearls_zh: 考法：指著小而深染無中央淡染的紅血球問名稱與鑑別；答 spherocytes，下一步必問「先做什麼檢查排除 AIHA」→ DAT。
HS 實驗室組合：DAT 陰性、MCHC 上升、網狀紅血球增加、EMA binding（flow）下降、osmotic fragility 上升；家族史多為體染色體顯性。
膜蛋白缺陷：ankyrin、band 3、β-spectrin、α-spectrin、protein 4.2，屬垂直連結（vertical interaction）缺陷，導致膜脂質流失。
併發症與處置：膽色素結石、parvovirus B19 aplastic crisis；中重度考慮脾切除（需疫苗接種）並補充葉酸。
exam.pitfall_zh: 球形紅血球最常與 warm AIHA 混淆；兩者抹片相似，需靠 DAT（HS 陰性、AIHA IgG 陽性）與家族史區分，勿單憑形態下診斷。

quiz.q: 此抹片中大量小而無中央淡染的紅血球稱為什麼？確認 HS 前必須先做哪項檢查排除自體免疫溶血？

63765.recognize_zh: 流式細胞散佈圖顯示 CD19+ B 細胞共同表現 CD5（黑箭頭），kappa 輕鏈限制且為弱表現（紅箭頭），CD20 弱、CD23 與 CD200 陽性、FMC7 與 CD79b 弱或陰性、CD10 陰性，這組免疫表型符合 CLL。
features: Dominant CD19-positive B-cell population co-expressing CD5 (black arrow)
Kappa light chain restriction with dim intensity, no lambda-positive population (red arrow)
Dim CD20 (curved arrow) and CD45-positive, CD10-negative
CD23 positive (yellow arrow) and CD200 bright (green circle)
FMC7 negative, CD79b dim to negative, CD43 positive
63765.describe_en: This figure shows flow cytometry dot plots rather than morphology. Gated lymphocytes contain a predominant CD19-positive B-cell population that co-expresses CD5 and CD43, shows dim CD20, and is negative for CD10. The population is kappa-restricted with dim surface light chain intensity. It is positive for CD23 and CD200 and negative for FMC7, with dim to negative CD79b. This immunophenotype (Matutes score 5) is consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: CD5-positive but typically CD23 negative, CD200 negative or dim, FMC7 positive, bright CD20 and bright light chain, with cyclin D1/t(11;14).
Usually CD5 and CD23 negative with bright CD20, CD79b and FMC7.
CD5 and CD23 usually negative, with a monotypic plasma cell component and MYD88 L265P.
Identical phenotype but clonal B-cell count is below 5 x 10^9/L without lymphadenopathy or cytopenias.

exam.answer_en: CLL immunophenotype by flow — CD19+ CD5+ CD23+ CD200+ B cells with dim CD20 and dim kappa restriction
pearls_zh: 讀法：先 gate 淋巴球與 CD19+ B 細胞，看 CD5 共表現與 κ/λ 是否單一輕鏈（克隆性），再用 CD23、CD200、FMC7、CD79b 區分 CLL 與 MCL。
Matutes score：CD5+、CD23+、FMC7−、表面 Ig 弱、CD22 或 CD79b 弱/陰性各 1 分，≥4 分支持 CLL；本例 5 分。
CD5+ 但 CD23− 或 CD200− 時，應加做 cyclin D1、SOX11 或 t(11;14) FISH 排除 MCL。
流式也用於 CLL 治療後 MRD 評估，常用門檻為 <10^-4（undetectable MRD）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 MCL：MCL 同樣 CD5+，但 CD23−、CD200 陰性或弱、FMC7+，且 CD20 與輕鏈呈亮表現。

quiz.q: 此流式結果的 Matutes score 幾分？代表什麼？

63701.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中泡沫狀組織球（foamy histiocytes）成片取代造血組織，抽吸片插圖中組織球內充滿未著色的條狀負影；AFB 染色呈大量紅色桿菌、PAS-D 呈洋紅色、GMS 呈黑色細絲狀菌體塞滿組織球，是 AIDS 病人瀰漫性 MAC 感染的典型表現。
features: Panel A (H&E): sheets of foamy histiocytes with finely granular/striated pale cytoplasm replacing hematopoiesis
Panel A inset (Wright-Giemsa): histiocyte packed with unstained rod-shaped negative images of bacilli
Panel B (AFB): innumerable red acid-fast bacilli clustered within histiocytes on a blue counterstain
Panel C (PAS-D): magenta PAS-positive, diastase-resistant filamentous organisms filling histiocyte cytoplasm
Panel D (GMS): black-staining bacilli aggregates within histiocytes on a green background
Poorly formed, non-necrotizing histiocytic aggregates without caseation
63701.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows markedly reduced hematopoiesis with extensive sheets and poorly formed non-necrotizing granulomas of foamy histiocytes containing finely striated cytoplasm (A). The aspirate smear shows histiocytes filled with negatively staining rod-shaped structures (A, inset). Acid-fast stain highlights innumerable intracellular bacilli (B), and the organisms are also positive on PAS with diastase (C) and Grocott methenamine silver (D). Findings are consistent with disseminated Mycobacterium avium-intracellulare complex infection in an immunocompromised host; culture or molecular identification is recommended for speciation.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have crumpled tissue-paper cytoplasm that is PAS positive but AFB and GMS negative, without negative bacillary images on smears.

M. tuberculosis usually forms well-formed caseating granulomas with few bacilli, whereas MAC in AIDS produces sheets of histiocytes stuffed with innumerable organisms; culture/PCR speciation is definitive.
Histoplasma yeasts are small, round to oval 2-4 um budding forms on GMS/PAS and are not acid-fast, unlike slender rod-shaped bacilli.
Tropheryma whipplei histiocytes are PAS-D positive but AFB negative and usually involve the gut, confirmed by PCR.

exam.answer_en: Disseminated Mycobacterium avium complex — sheets of foamy histiocytes packed with AFB-, PAS-D- and GMS-positive bacilli
pearls_zh: 考法：Wright 抽吸片中組織球內未著色的條狀「負影」即分枝桿菌線索；考官常問要加做哪個染色 → AFB（Ziehl-Neelsen），可見大量紅色桿菌。
染色特性：MAC 常 PAS-D 陽性與 GMS 陽性，這是與結核菌相比常考的差異；肉芽腫形成差、多無乾酪性壞死，反映宿主免疫缺陷。
臨床：典型見於 AIDS 且 CD4 <50 cells/µL，表現發燒、體重下降、肝脾腫大與血球低下；需做分枝桿菌血液培養或分子鑑定。
治療：以 clarithromycin 或 azithromycin 合併 ethambutol 為骨幹；開始抗病毒治療後需注意免疫重建發炎症候群（IRIS）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Gaucher cell（pseudo-Gaucher）：兩者都有條紋狀細胞質且 PAS 陽性，但 Gaucher cell AFB 陰性；Whipple 病同樣 PAS-D 陽性但 AFB 陰性。

quiz.q: 抽吸片組織球內未著色的條狀負影代表什麼？以哪個特殊染色最直接證實？

63573.recognize_zh: 箭頭處的組織球胞質淡藍、邊緣不規則，裡面塞滿數個被吞入、呈淡粉棕色輪廓的紅血球，還有一個深染的圓形核碎片，這就是紅血球吞噬（erythrophagocytosis）。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant pale blue-grey cytoplasm and irregular outline
Several engulfed intact erythrocytes seen as pale tan-pink rounded profiles within the cytoplasm
Eccentric round nucleus with fine chromatin, compressed by ingested material
Dense dark round body adjacent to the nucleus, suggestive of a phagocytosed nucleus or nuclear debris
Background of RBCs, a lymphocyte, a band/metamyelocyte and a smudged elongated nucleus
63573.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (May-Grünwald-Giemsa) shows a histiocyte with abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing multiple engulfed erythrocytes and a small dense round body suggestive of phagocytosed nuclear material. The histiocyte nucleus is eccentric and bland. Surrounding cells include a small lymphocyte and maturing granulocytes. Findings are consistent with erythrophagocytosis; hemophagocytosis alone is not diagnostic of HLH and requires correlation with HLH-2004 clinical and laboratory criteria.

ddx.vs: HLH requires clinical criteria (fever, cytopenias, splenomegaly, ferritin, triglycerides, fibrinogen, sCD25) since isolated hemophagocytosis also occurs after transfusion, infection or chemotherapy.

ddx.dx: Tumor cell with cannibalism/emperipolesis (e.g. megakaryocyte emperipolesis)
ddx.vs: Emperipolesis shows intact viable cells passing through a megakaryocyte with granular pink cytoplasm and lobulated nucleus rather than degraded RBCs within a histiocyte.
These contain blue granules or golden-brown pigment rather than recognizable intact ingested red cells.

exam.answer_en: Erythrophagocytosis — marrow histiocyte containing multiple engulfed red cells and nuclear debris (hemophagocytosis)
pearls_zh: 考官會指吞了紅血球的大細胞，問細胞種類與現象：histiocyte/macrophage 的 hemophagocytosis。
單見噬血現象不等於 HLH；輸血、敗血症、化療後都可出現。HLH-2004 需 8 項中符合 5 項，或有 HLH 相關基因突變。
HLH-2004 項目：發燒、脾腫大、≥2 系血球減少、高三酸甘油酯或低纖維蛋白原、組織噬血、NK 活性低、ferritin ≥500 ng/mL、sCD25 升高。
成人 HLH 常見誘因：EBV 感染、T/NK 細胞淋巴瘤、自體免疫疾病（MAS）；看到噬血要回頭找誘因。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與巨核細胞的 emperipolesis 混淆：emperipolesis 是完整存活細胞穿行於巨核細胞胞質，噬血則為組織球吞入並分解紅血球或有核細胞。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指大細胞胞質內的淡粉棕色圓形結構是什麼？
quiz.a: 被組織球吞噬的紅血球（erythrophagocytosis）

63381.recognize_zh: 抹片中大量中型異常淋巴球，細胞質中等量偏嗜鹼性，核呈凹陷、摺疊或輕度分葉，染色質粗；雖然不是典型的花瓣狀細胞（flower cell），但核輪廓不規則的 T 細胞增生，配合 HTLV-1 陽性即指向成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤（ATLL）。
features: Numerous medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells, larger than normal small lymphocytes, with moderate N:C ratio
Irregular nuclear contours with indentations, folds and occasional early lobulation
Moderately condensed chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli
Moderate rim of basophilic cytoplasm without granules
Scattered neutrophils and a monocyte among many red cells; classic polylobated flower cells are not prominent in this field
63381.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with a moderate rim of basophilic, agranular cytoplasm and irregular nuclear contours including indentations, folds and early lobulation. Chromatin is moderately condensed and nucleoli are not conspicuous. Scattered neutrophils and a monocyte are present in a blood-rich background, and well-developed polylobated flower cells are not prominent in this field. In conjunction with a CD4-positive, CD7-negative T-cell population, clonal TCR rearrangement, HTLV-1 seropositivity and hypercalcemia, findings are consistent with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells have cerebriform, finely grooved nuclei and occur with erythroderma, and they are HTLV-1-negative, whereas ATLL cells have polylobated or folded nuclei with hypercalcemia.
T-PLL cells have a prominent central nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, usually express CD7 strongly and carry TCL1 rearrangement.
MCL cells can be indented but are B cells (CD19+, CD5+, cyclin D1+) on flow and IHC.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm hugging red cells and lack the clonal CD7-loss T-cell phenotype.

exam.answer_en: Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma in marrow — medium atypical lymphocytes with indented, folded to early lobulated nuclei (HTLV-1)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指核摺疊分葉的淋巴球問診斷與病毒；答 ATLL，HTLV-1，典型形態為花瓣狀 flower cell（本圖為較不典型的摺疊核）。
表型：CD2+、CD3+、CD4+、CD25+、CCR4+，常失去 CD7；需證明 HTLV-1 抗體陽性，前病毒單株整合可支持克隆性。
Shimoyama 分型：acute、lymphoma、chronic、smoldering；acute 型常伴高血鈣、溶骨病變與伺機感染，預後差。
HTLV-1 主要經哺乳、性行為與輸血傳染；anti-CCR4 抗體 mogamulizumab 為治療選項之一。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Sézary syndrome 混淆；Sézary cell 為腦回狀核、CD4+ 且 CD7−/CD26−，但 CD25 多陰性並無 HTLV-1；ATLL 常 CD25 強陽性且 HTLV-1 陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中核不規則的 CD4+ T 淋巴球增生，確診 ATLL 必須證明哪一種病毒？典型 IL-2 受體標記為何？

63317.recognize_zh: 兩格高倍視野中可見紅系前驅細胞核分葉（A）、胞質空泡與血紅素化不良（B）、Howell-Jolly 小體（C）、有絲分裂像（D）及核質發育不同步（E），加上篩網狀染色質的巨母紅血球（megaloblast），符合巨母紅血球性貧血的紅系異生。
features: Erythroid precursors with open, finely stippled sieve-like chromatin (megaloblasts) and relatively mature basophilic-to-polychromatic cytoplasm
Nuclear lobulation/budding in a late erythroblast (A)
Poorly hemoglobinized erythroblast with cytoplasmic vacuolation (B)
Detached nuclear fragments/Howell-Jolly bodies in an erythroid cell (C)
Large erythroid mitotic figure (D) and nucleocytoplasmic asynchrony with hemoglobinized cytoplasm around a still-immature nucleus (E)
Giant granulocytic precursor with a large, open horseshoe-shaped nucleus (lower upper panel)
63317.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at 100x (two composite fields) shows erythroid precursors with megaloblastic change, characterized by large size and open, finely stippled chromatin that lags behind cytoplasmic maturation. Dyserythropoietic features are labeled, including nuclear lobulation (A), defective hemoglobinization with cytoplasmic vacuolation (B), Howell-Jolly body-type nuclear fragments (C), a mitotic figure (D) and nucleocytoplasmic asynchrony (E). A giant granulocytic precursor with an open, band-like nucleus is also present. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic erythropoiesis; correlation with serum vitamin B12, folate and drug history is required to exclude myelodysplastic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: MDS may show identical megaloblastoid dyserythropoiesis, but is favored by normal B12/folate, ring sideroblasts, hypolobated micromegakaryocytes, pseudo-Pelger neutrophils or clonal cytogenetics.

AEL shows a marked predominance of immature erythroid precursors with pronormoblast expansion, whereas megaloblastic anemia shows orderly (if asynchronous) maturation that corrects with vitamin replacement.
CDA shows binucleate/multinucleate late erythroblasts and internuclear bridging in young patients without giant myeloid precursors or B12/folate deficiency.
Morphology is indistinguishable; separation relies on medication history and normal vitamin levels.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic anemia — megaloblastic erythroblasts with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, nuclear budding, Howell-Jolly bodies and a giant myeloid precursor
pearls_zh: 考法：依字母逐一問：A 核分葉/出芽、B 血紅素化不良伴空泡、C Howell-Jolly body、D 有絲分裂像、E 核質發育不同步；核心機轉是 DNA 合成受損，核成熟落後於胞質。
周邊血對應：macro-ovalocytes、hypersegmented neutrophils、可伴全血球減少；網狀紅血球偏低，LDH 與間接膽紅素因 ineffective erythropoiesis 升高。
檢驗：B12 與 folate；邊界值時測 methylmalonic acid（B12 缺乏時升高）與 homocysteine（兩者缺乏皆升高）；惡性貧血查 anti-intrinsic factor 抗體。
B12 缺乏可合併神經學病變（subacute combined degeneration）；只補 folate 而未補 B12 可能讓神經症狀惡化。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤診為 MDS 或急性紅血球性白血病：megaloblastic anemia 伴巨大後髓細胞、B12/folate 低且補充後可矯正；MDS 常見 pseudo-Pelger 嗜中性球與小型巨核細胞。

quiz.q: 標示 E 的細胞呈現何種異常？其根本機轉為何？
quiz.a: Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony（核幼稚、胞質已血紅素化）；DNA 合成障礙（B12/folate 缺乏）

63253.recognize_zh: 血液分析儀 WDF（側向散射 SSC 對前向散射 FSC）散佈圖：除了紫色淋巴球群與淺藍色嗜中性球群外，有一條從左下角延伸到右上角飽和區的深藍色斜線狀異常事件帶，貫穿白血球族群；這種非細胞族群的連續條帶提示檢體內有顆粒干擾（如血塊、脂肪球或血小板凝集），會觸發分析儀警示並影響白血球分類。
features: Automated hematology analyzer WDF scattergram (side scatter on x-axis vs forward scatter on y-axis)
Purple cluster at low scatter consistent with lymphocytes
Cyan cluster at intermediate scatter consistent with neutrophils (granulocytes)
Abnormal dark blue, continuous diagonal band of events extending from the origin to the upper right saturation corner
The band passes through and overlaps the leukocyte clusters, indicating non-leukocyte particle interference
63253.describe_en: This image is a screenshot of a hematology analyzer WDF scattergram plotting side scatter against forward scatter. Discrete lymphocyte (purple) and neutrophil (cyan) clusters are present, but there is an abnormal continuous diagonal band of dark blue events extending from the lower left origin to the upper right corner at saturation, overlapping the leukocyte populations. This pattern indicates particulate interference, such as clots, fat globules or platelet aggregates, rather than a true cell population, and is the basis for an analyzer interference or clot flag. The automated differential should not be reported; the sample should be inspected for clots or lipid and a peripheral smear reviewed.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumps also produce events in the low-to-intermediate scatter region, but smear review shows platelet aggregates rather than fat globules or fibrin clots.
Lipemic particles and cryoprecipitates generate similar debris signals; plasma appearance, warming the sample and fat stains help identify the source.

ddx.dx: Nucleated red cells or lysis-resistant red cells
ddx.vs: NRBC and lysis-resistant RBC events cluster near the origin below the lymphocyte region rather than forming a diagonal band reaching the saturation corner.

63189.recognize_zh: 低倍下腺體只出現在骨髓切片一端靠近纖維軟組織的邊緣，數量少且成小群，右側細胞角蛋白（CK）染色僅標出這一小簇腺管，骨髓腔內沒有散在上皮細胞或促纖維增生反應。
features: Paired low-power panels: H&E (left) and cytokeratin immunostain (right) of a trephine core
Small cluster of glandular structures confined to the fibrous/soft tissue edge at one end of the core
Adjacent dense collagenous tissue, adipocytes and bone trabeculae; no infiltrative pattern within the marrow space
Cytokeratin highlights only the small tight cluster of tubules; remaining marrow and stroma are negative
No desmoplastic stroma or sheets of epithelial cells at this magnification
63189.describe_en: Low-power sections of a bone marrow trephine biopsy (H&E and cytokeratin immunostain) show a small, well-circumscribed cluster of glandular structures located at the extreme end of the core within fibrous soft tissue, adjacent to collagen, fat and bone trabeculae. Cytokeratin staining highlights only this compact group of tubules, with no scattered keratin-positive cells in the intertrabecular marrow. There is no desmoplastic stromal reaction. Given the peripheral location, lobular organization and bland appearance, findings are consistent with entrapped non-neoplastic adnexal (sweat gland) epithelium introduced during the biopsy procedure rather than metastatic carcinoma; high-power review of cytology is required.

ddx.vs: Metastases infiltrate the intertrabecular marrow with atypical, pleomorphic glands and desmoplastic stroma rather than forming a small lobule at the core edge.
These show single-file or scattered keratin-positive cells throughout the marrow, unlike this single circumscribed tubular cluster.
Epidermal contamination shows squamous epithelium with keratin layers, whereas here the keratin-positive elements form tubules.

63125.recognize_zh: 骨小樑兩側有密集、單一形態的中大型淋巴樣細胞沿骨表面及間質浸潤，與左上角含脂肪、造血細胞混雜的殘存骨髓明顯不同，符合濾泡性淋巴瘤（含轉化）侵犯骨髓。
features: Bony trabecula bordered by a dense monotonous infiltrate
Intermediate-to-large lymphoid cells with pale cytoplasm and irregular nuclei
Paratrabecular and interstitial distribution replacing fat
Residual normal hematopoiesis with fat spaces in upper left
No granuloma or fibrosis evident at this magnification
63125.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at intermediate power shows a dense, monotonous infiltrate of intermediate-to-large lymphoid cells with pale cytoplasm and irregular nuclei, closely applied to the trabecular surface and extending into the adjacent interstitium. Residual trilineage hematopoiesis with fat is seen in the upper left field. Cytology is better assessed at higher power, but the cell size exceeds that of typical centrocytes. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by B-cell lymphoma with a paratrabecular pattern, supporting transformed follicular lymphoma with immunohistochemical correlation.

ddx.vs: Low-grade FL forms paratrabecular aggregates of small cleaved centrocytes with low Ki-67, whereas transformed disease shows sheets of large centroblast-like cells with mitoses.
Metastases form cohesive nests with desmoplasia and are keratin- or melanocytic-marker positive and CD45/CD20 negative.
cHL shows scattered Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a fibrotic mixed inflammatory background, CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and CD20 usually negative.
Benign aggregates are small, well circumscribed, intertrabecular, contain mixed small T and B cells, and do not form paratrabecular sheets of large cells.

63061.recognize_zh: 試管內是離心後加入磺柳酸（sulfosalicylic acid）的尿液，底部為深棕到近黑色的沉澱與凝塊，代表大量血尿／血紅素與蛋白沉澱，符合蠍螫後 DIC 合併嚴重血尿。
features: Gross photograph of a glass test tube held by a gloved hand
Dark brown to nearly black, opaque material filling the lower portion of the tube
Lighter tan-brown flocculent precipitate layered above the dark material
No clear supernatant visible, indicating heavy protein/heme precipitation
Microscopic evaluation is not possible from this image
63061.describe_en: Gross photograph of a centrifuged urine specimen after addition of sulfosalicylic acid. The tube contains abundant dark brown-black precipitate with an overlying tan flocculent layer and no clear supernatant, indicating heavy proteinuria and marked heme pigment content. The appearance cannot distinguish intact red cells from free hemoglobin or myoglobin; urine microscopy and plasma/urine heme studies are required. In the clinical setting of scorpion envenomation, findings are consistent with severe hematuria accompanying DIC.

ddx.vs: Hemoglobinuria gives a dark urine positive for heme on dipstick but without red cells on urine microscopy, whereas hematuria shows intact RBCs in the sediment.
Myoglobinuria also darkens urine and is heme-positive without RBCs, but plasma is not pink and serum CK is markedly elevated.
Homogentisic acid darkens urine on standing/alkalinization and is heme-negative on dipstick with no RBCs.

62997.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見卵圓至紡錘形細胞，核呈細長或卵圓形，細胞質豐富、淡染透亮並帶細小空泡與稀疏顆粒，嵌在粉紅色膠原纖維之間，並混有少數嗜酸性球，符合非典型肥大細胞浸潤。
features: Oval to spindle-shaped cells with elongated, oval to reniform nuclei and fine chromatin
Occasional small but distinct nucleoli
Moderate to abundant pale, clear to finely vacuolated cytoplasm with sparse faint granules
Cells separated by wavy eosinophilic collagen bundles (fibrosis)
Scattered eosinophils with bright red granules and occasional small lymphocytes admixed
62997.describe_en: High-power view shows an infiltrate of oval to spindle-shaped cells with elongated to oval nuclei, fine chromatin and occasional small nucleoli. The cytoplasm is moderate to abundant, pale to clear and finely vacuolated with sparse granules. The cells lie between wavy collagen bundles, and scattered eosinophils and small lymphocytes are admixed. Findings are consistent with an atypical spindled mast cell infiltrate with associated fibrosis, as seen in systemic mastocytosis; confirmation with tryptase, CD117 and CD25 is required.

ddx.vs: Fibrotic PMF shows clustered, atypical megakaryocytes and streaming fibroblasts that are tryptase/CD117-negative, not clear-cytoplasm mast cells.
LCH cells have grooved nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm with CD1a/langerin positivity, not tryptase/CD25.
Hairy cells give a fried-egg pattern with round nuclei and are CD20+/annexin A1+, whereas these cells are spindled with fibrosis.
Carcinoma forms cohesive nests with keratin positivity, unlike this dyscohesive spindled mast cell infiltrate.

62933.recognize_zh: 同一份 EDTA 血液在 37°C 孵育後所做的抹片，低倍與高倍下嗜中性球都單獨散在分布，先前的成團聚集已消失；這證明聚集是體外、溫度相關的假性現象。
features: Neutrophils distributed singly and evenly across the smear with no clumps
Individual neutrophils show normal segmented nuclei and fine pink granules
Occasional lymphocytes and scattered platelets without platelet clumping
Red cells in a thick area with overlapping, chain-like arrangement (smear thickness artifact)
62933.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear prepared after incubation of the EDTA sample at 37 °C for 30 minutes, shown at low and high power. Neutrophils are evenly dispersed as single cells with normal segmented nuclei and cytoplasmic granulation, and no leukocyte aggregates are identified. Platelets are scattered singly, and the red cells show overlapping in this relatively thick area. Resolution of the aggregates seen at room temperature is consistent with in vitro, temperature-dependent (EDTA-associated) neutrophil agglutination causing pseudoleukopenia.

ddx.vs: A genuinely low count does not rise after warming and the smear shows no clumps before incubation.
Aggregates are composed of platelets rather than neutrophils and cause a falsely low platelet count.
Platelets rosette around neutrophils instead of neutrophils clumping together.

62869.recognize_zh: 五格免疫染色：密集淋巴球 CD3、CD2、CD7 瀰漫陽性，CD20 只有散在 B 細胞，CD5 大多陰性（CD5 喪失），顯示具異常 pan-T 抗原缺失的 T 細胞族群。
features: CD3: diffuse strong positivity in the dense small lymphocyte population
CD2 and CD7: diffusely positive, pan-T-cell antigens retained
CD5: largely negative with only scattered positive cells (aberrant loss)
CD20: only scattered positive B cells
Positive cells are small with round nuclei, forming sheets
62869.describe_en: Immunohistochemical panel of the lymphoid infiltrate shows diffuse positivity for CD3, CD2 and CD7 in a dense population of small lymphocytes, with only scattered CD20-positive B cells. CD5 stains only occasional cells, indicating aberrant loss of CD5 in the dominant T-cell population. The positive cells are small without obvious large atypical forms. Findings support a clonal-appearing, immunophenotypically aberrant small T-cell infiltrate, consistent with indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract.

ddx.vs: Reactive T cells retain CD5 (and CD7), whereas selective CD5 loss here is an aberrant phenotype.
ATLL is typically CD4-positive, CD7-negative, CD25-positive and HTLV-1 associated, with flower-shaped pleomorphic cells.

ddx.dx: T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia involving tissue
ddx.vs: T-LGL is CD8-positive and often CD5 dim but primarily involves blood, marrow and spleen with cytotoxic granules (granzyme B positive), not mucosal sheets.

62869.stain: IHC: CD20, CD3, CD5, CD2, CD7

62741.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中出現大小接近淋巴球或單核球的小型巨核細胞（micromegakaryocyte），核為單葉或雙葉、染色質緻密，胞質外緣有泡狀突起與血小板出芽（B、C），部分細胞核有小突出物（nuclear protrusion，B、D、E），屬 MDS 的巨核細胞發育不良表現。
features: Small megakaryocytes (micromegakaryocytes) approximating the size of a lymphocyte to a monocyte
Round to bilobed nuclei with dense, clumped chromatin and no visible nucleoli
Small knob-like nuclear protrusions/blebs budding from the nuclear contour (B, D, E)
Scant pale-to-granular cytoplasm with irregular blebs and platelet-like budding at the periphery
Circulating dysplastic cells amid neutrophils and red cells with mild anisocytosis (A)
62741.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating micromegakaryocytes, small cells approximately the size of a lymphocyte or monocyte with round or bilobed nuclei, dense chromatin and scant cytoplasm bearing irregular blebs and platelet budding. Several nuclei show small knob-like nuclear protrusions extending from an otherwise smooth contour. Neutrophils are present in the background. Findings represent dysmegakaryopoiesis and are suggestive of a myelodysplastic syndrome in the appropriate clinical and marrow context.

ddx.dx: Lymphocytes or monocytes with platelet satellitism/overlap
ddx.vs: Adherent platelets sit on the cell surface as discrete granules, whereas micromegakaryocytes show platelet budding continuous with their own granular cytoplasm and are CD61/CD42b positive.
Megakaryoblasts have fine chromatin with nucleoli and agranular blebbing cytoplasm, whereas micromegakaryocytes have mature, dense chromatin.
In PMF, naked or bare megakaryocyte nuclei with little cytoplasm circulate along with teardrop cells and leukoerythroblastosis, rather than small intact cells with granular budding cytoplasm.
5q- megakaryocytes are normal-to-small sized with round non-lobated nuclei in the marrow, and diagnosis rests on del(5q) cytogenetics.

62677.recognize_zh: 中倍 CD20 染色可見多個 CD20 細胞膜強陽性的密集結節（包括環繞小血管的一團），結節之間也散布許多 CD20 陽性 B 細胞，陰性區為小 T 淋巴球。
features: Medium power: several dense aggregates of strongly membranous CD20-positive cells
One aggregate concentrically arranged around a small blood vessel
Numerous CD20-positive cells also scattered through interfollicular areas
Interspersed CD20-negative small lymphocytes (presumed T cells) in the background
Crisp membranous staining pattern
62677.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry at intermediate power shows several dense aggregates of B cells with strong membranous staining, one centered around a small vessel, with many additional CD20-positive cells scattered in the interfollicular areas. The intervening CD20-negative cells are small lymphocytes, presumably T cells. The nodular and interfollicular B-cell expansion is consistent with follicular lymphoma with interfollicular spread, in keeping with the reported case.

ddx.vs: Reactive nodes show discrete follicles with a predominantly T-cell interfollicular zone, whereas here neoplastic B cells also spill into interfollicular regions.
NMZL B cells in the interfollicular area are CD10 and BCL6 negative, whereas FL cells retain germinal center markers outside follicles.
SLL shows proliferation centers and CD5/CD23/LEF1 coexpression rather than CD10-positive follicles.

62613.recognize_zh: CD30 免疫染色：積液細胞塊中大多數大型腫瘤細胞呈強的細胞膜與細胞質（部分高基氏體區點狀）陽性，背景小細胞為陰性；PEL 常表現 CD30，但仍須以 HHV8 LANA-1 確認診斷。
features: Strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD30 staining in the majority of large neoplastic cells
Occasional paranuclear (Golgi-type) dot accentuation
Positive cells are large and discohesive, arranged in loose clusters
Small background cells negative, serving as internal negative control
Pale fibrinous background typical of a cell block
62613.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD30 on the effusion cell block shows strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining, with focal Golgi accentuation, in the majority of the large atypical cells. Scattered small background cells are negative. CD30 expression is common in primary effusion lymphoma and supports an activated/plasmablastic phenotype but is not specific. Together with morphology, the findings are supportive of primary effusion lymphoma; diagnosis requires demonstration of HHV8 LANA-1 nuclear positivity and exclusion of other CD30-positive neoplasms.

ddx.vs: ALCL is also strongly CD30+ but expresses T-cell antigens or cytotoxic markers (and ALK in ALK+ ALCL), and is HHV8 negative.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30+/CD15+/PAX5 weak in an inflammatory background, rarely present as isolated effusion, and are HHV8 negative.
Embryonal carcinoma is CD30+ but is cohesive, keratin+, OCT4+ and SALL4+, and CD45 negative.

62549.recognize_zh: BCL2 在幾乎所有腫瘤細胞呈強陽性的胞膜／胞質染色，整片深棕色；在 Burkitt 樣形態的淋巴瘤中，BCL2 強陽性就是提醒你要排除雙打擊（MYC 加 BCL2 重排）的關鍵。
features: Strong, diffuse membranous and cytoplasmic BCL2 staining in nearly all tumor cells
Scattered cells with more intense staining, likely including reactive small lymphocytes
Medium-sized tumor cells with pale nuclei outlined by cytoplasmic staining
Unstained spaces correspond to vessels and macrophages
62549.describe_en: BCL2 immunohistochemistry shows strong, diffuse cytoplasmic and membranous staining in nearly all neoplastic cells, with scattered more intensely stained cells that likely include reactive small lymphocytes. Unstained areas correspond to vessels and tingible-body macrophages. Strong BCL2 expression in an aggressive B-cell lymphoma with a very high proliferation index argues against Burkitt lymphoma and supports high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, as confirmed by FISH in this case.

ddx.vs: Burkitt lymphoma is BCL2-negative or only weakly positive in a small fraction of cells.
Double-expressor DLBCL also shows BCL2 at or above 50% with MYC at or above 40% but lacks rearrangements on FISH.
BCL2 positivity is shared; distinction relies on a history or residual component of FL and on MYC status.

exam.answer_en: Double-hit lymphoma — strong diffuse BCL2 expression in nearly all tumor cells, arguing against Burkitt lymphoma
pearls_zh: 考法：配合 Burkitt 樣 H&E 給 BCL2 染色，問此結果如何改變鑑別診斷：強陽性不支持 Burkitt，要以 FISH 找 MYC/BCL2 重排。
判讀陷阱：背景小 T 細胞本來就 BCL2 強陽性，可作為內部陽性對照；判斷腫瘤是否陽性要看中型腫瘤細胞本身。
double expressor（IHC：MYC ≥40%、BCL2 ≥50%）是蛋白表現概念，預後較差，但不等於 double-hit；double-hit 需 FISH 證明重排。
BCL2 蛋白表現可由易位、擴增或轉錄活化造成，所以 IHC 強陽性不能取代 BCL2 FISH。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 BCL2 強陽性直接當成 double-hit：BCL2 IHC 只反映蛋白量，必須 FISH 證明 MYC 與 BCL2 同時重排；也勿把陽性的反應性 T 細胞當成腫瘤。

quiz.q: Burkitt 樣形態的淋巴瘤出現此 BCL2 染色結果，支持或反對 Burkitt lymphoma？
quiz.a: 反對（Burkitt 通常 BCL2 陰性/弱），需 FISH 排除 double-hit

62485.recognize_zh: IgD 染色中大部分淋巴球呈膜性／細胞質陽性，強度不一，陰性細胞散在並在中央條帶較多；脾邊緣區淋巴瘤常表現 IgD，這一點有別於大多數結節性邊緣區淋巴瘤及 MALT 淋巴瘤。
features: Dense sheet of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with membranous and cytoplasmic IgD positivity of variable intensity
Heterogeneous staining, with IgD-negative cells more concentrated in a paler central band
Scattered cells with stronger staining
No discrete IgD-negative germinal centers visible in this field
62485.describe_en: IgD immunohistochemical stain on spleen shows a dense lymphoid infiltrate in which most cells show membranous and cytoplasmic IgD positivity of variable intensity. A paler band with more IgD-negative cells traverses the center of the field. No discrete negative germinal centers are identified here. IgD expression by the neoplastic cells is frequent in splenic marginal zone lymphoma and helps distinguish it from nodal and extranodal marginal zone lymphomas; normal mantle zone B cells also express IgD, so correlation with the H&E architecture is required.

ddx.vs: Reactive IgD staining forms a discrete ring around germinal centers, whereas here positivity extends across the expanded nodules.
Mantle cell lymphoma is also IgD positive, but it is CD5 and cyclin D1 positive.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma (MALT) or nodal MZL
ddx.vs: These are usually IgD negative, with the entity separated by clinical distribution and splenic predominance.

62421.recognize_zh: 鐵染色（Prussian blue，核固紅對比染色）中，箭頭指出的紅血球前驅細胞核周圍有藍綠色含鐵顆粒環繞排列，覆蓋核周三分之一以上——即環形鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblast）；背景黃褐色團塊為紅血球。
features: Prussian blue stain with nuclear fast red counterstain; red cells appear tan-brown in clumps
Multiple erythroid precursors (arrows) with blue iron granules arranged in a perinuclear ring
Iron granules encircle at least one-third of the nuclear circumference
Other nucleated cells (granulocytes, erythroid precursors) lack perinuclear iron
Occasional scattered extracellular blue iron granules in the background
62421.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear stained for iron (Prussian blue with nuclear fast red counterstain) shows multiple erythroid precursors with coarse blue siderotic granules arranged in a ring around the nucleus (arrows), involving at least one-third of the nuclear circumference. Other nucleated cells lack perinuclear iron, and scattered blue granules are present in the background. Ring sideroblasts should be enumerated as a percentage of all erythroid precursors. Findings are consistent with ring sideroblasts, supporting MDS with ring sideroblasts (at least 15%, or at least 5% with SF3B1 mutation) after exclusion of secondary causes.

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts contain a few fine scattered cytoplasmic granules that do not form a perinuclear ring.

ddx.dx: Secondary sideroblastic anemia (alcohol, isoniazid, copper deficiency, zinc excess)
ddx.vs: Ring sideroblasts are morphologically identical, so drug/toxin history, copper and zinc levels and SF3B1 status separate them from MDS.
Congenital forms present in young patients with microcytic anemia and pyridoxine responsiveness rather than a clonal myeloid neoplasm.
Precipitate is irregular and lies in a different plane, whereas true siderotic granules sit within the cytoplasm hugging the nucleus.

exam.answer_en: Ring sideroblasts on Prussian blue iron stain — erythroid precursors with perinuclear iron granules encircling ≥1/3 of the nucleus
pearls_zh: 考法：指著核周藍色顆粒環，問定義：≥5 顆鐵顆粒環繞核周至少 1/3（ICSH），比例以占全部紅系前驅細胞計算；鐵沉積在粒線體。
分類門檻：WHO 2016 MDS-RS 為 ring sideroblasts ≥15%，或 ≥5% 且有 SF3B1 突變；WHO 5th 以 SF3B1 突變為主，RS ≥15% 可替代未檢測時。
非克隆性原因：酒精、銅缺乏（或鋅過量）、isoniazid、鉛中毒，以及 X-linked 先天性 sideroblastic anemia（ALAS2，部分對 pyridoxine 有反應）。
治療連結：低風險 MDS-RS 伴輸血依賴貧血，luspatercept 為考點藥物之一。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把正常 sideroblast 的散在鐵顆粒或巨噬細胞內的貯存鐵當成 ring sideroblast：必須是紅系前驅細胞、顆粒貼核排列並環繞至少 1/3 核周。

quiz.q: Ring sideroblast 的 ICSH 定義為何？
quiz.a: 紅系前驅細胞中 ≥5 顆鐵顆粒環繞核周至少 1/3

62357.recognize_zh: 組織內為一致性、密集排列的中型細胞，核質比高、核膜不規則（部分呈扭曲狀）、染色質細緻，並有散在凋亡小體與核分裂，形成典型的淋巴母細胞淋巴瘤外觀。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized cells with very high N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm
Oval to irregular, focally convoluted nuclei with finely dispersed to vesicular chromatin
Inconspicuous to occasionally visible small nucleoli
Scattered apoptotic bodies and mitotic figures, some within clear-halo macrophage spaces
Delicate fibrovascular septa between tumor cells; no follicular architecture
62357.describe_en: H&E section shows a diffuse, highly cellular infiltrate of monotonous medium-sized cells with scant cytoplasm and high N:C ratio. Nuclei are oval to irregular with finely dispersed chromatin, occasional small nucleoli, and irregular nuclear membranes. Numerous apoptotic bodies and mitotic figures are present, and no follicular or epithelial structures are seen in this field. The morphology is that of a lymphoblastic neoplasm; with CD3 and TdT positivity, findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells have round nuclei with multiple small nucleoli, basophilic cytoplasm, a prominent starry-sky pattern, and are TdT-negative.
Blastoid MCL is CD20+ cyclin D1+ SOX11+ and TdT-negative in most cases.
Myeloid sarcoma may show eosinophilic myelocytes and expresses MPO, lysozyme or CD117 rather than CD3.

ddx.dx: Small round blue cell tumors (e.g., Ewing sarcoma)
ddx.vs: Ewing sarcoma is CD99+ NKX2.2+ with EWSR1 rearrangement and is negative for CD45, CD3 and TdT (though CD99 is also expressed in LBL).

exam.answer_en: T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma — diffuse sheets of medium-sized blasts with fine chromatin, convoluted nuclei and frequent mitoses
pearls_zh: 考法：H&E 小圓藍細胞腫瘤，問形態上屬 lymphoblastic 的線索：細緻分散染色質、核膜不規則（convoluted）、核質比高、大量核分裂與凋亡。
必做 IHC 組合：TdT、CD34、CD3、CD19/PAX5、CD99，以及 MPO/CD117 排除 myeloid sarcoma，cyclin D1/SOX11 排除 blastoid MCL。
T-LBL 典型為前縱膈腫塊；若同時有嗜酸性球增多與 myeloid 腫瘤，需想到 FGFR1 重排的 myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm。
T-ALL/LBL 常見 NOTCH1/FBXW7 突變與 CDKN2A 缺失；復發或難治 T-ALL 可用 nelarabine。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Burkitt lymphoma：Burkitt 核較圓、多個小核仁、細胞質嗜鹼、starry-sky 明顯且 TdT−；lymphoblast 染色質更細緻並 TdT+。

quiz.q: 這些高核質比、染色質細緻的中型細胞最可能是什麼細胞？確認前驅性質要做哪個核染 IHC？

62293.recognize_zh: CD20（A）只標出幾個殘存濾泡與副皮質區零星 B 細胞，PD-1（B）主要在生發中心內，副皮質只有少數陽性；EBER 原位雜交（C）則見大量陽性細胞核，表示大部分浸潤的淋巴細胞感染 EBV，支持全身性 EBV 陽性 T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Panel A (CD20): compact positive residual follicles with only scattered B cells in the expanded paracortex
Panel B (PD-1): positive cells concentrated within germinal centers (follicular helper T cells), few in the paracortex
Panel C (EBER ISH): numerous dark-blue nuclear signals in the majority of infiltrating lymphoid cells
No expanded PD-1-positive interfollicular population to suggest a TFH-derived lymphoma
Expanded paracortex dominated by non-B, EBER-positive cells
62293.describe_en: Immunohistochemical and in situ hybridization studies on the lymph node show CD20-positive B cells confined mainly to residual follicles, with only scattered B cells in the expanded paracortex. PD-1 highlights cells predominantly within germinal centers, consistent with physiologic follicular helper T cells, and only rare paracortical cells. EBER in situ hybridization shows nuclear positivity in the majority of the infiltrating lymphoid cells, which in correlation with the T-cell stains represent EBV-infected T cells. Findings are consistent with systemic EBV-positive T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: AITL shows an expanded PD-1-positive interfollicular population and EBER positivity largely restricted to scattered B immunoblasts rather than most T cells.
In IM, EBER-positive cells are mainly B immunoblasts of variable size and the T cells are polyclonal and EBV-negative.
EBV+ DLBCL shows EBER in sheets of large CD20-positive B cells, unlike the CD20-sparse, T-cell-predominant infiltrate here.

ddx.dx: Chronic active EBV disease, T-cell type
ddx.vs: CAEBV also shows EBER-positive T cells but lacks effacement by a clonal, cytologically atypical T-cell population and follows a prolonged course.

62037.recognize_zh: 紅色免疫染色高倍下，可見數顆大型細胞與部分小至中型細胞呈深紅色核為主的陽性，強弱不一，大多數小淋巴球陰性；陽性大細胞散在分布，屬於 NLPHL 評估中的核抗原染色結果，需對照抗體名稱。
features: Scattered large cells with strong, predominantly nuclear red staining and granular texture
Additional small-to-intermediate cells with nuclear positivity of variable intensity
Majority of background small round lymphocytes negative
Several large cells with vesicular nuclei show weak or no staining
No sheets of positive large cells in this field; antibody identity not labeled
62037.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen, antibody not specified in the image) of lymph node at high power shows a predominantly nuclear staining pattern, with strong positivity in scattered large cells and variable positivity in a subset of small-to-intermediate cells. Most background small lymphocytes are negative, and some large vesicular cells are weak or unstained. The positive large cells are dispersed and do not form sheets. The pattern could correspond to a nuclear marker such as MUM1/IRF4, OCT2, or Ki-67; findings are compatible with the large-cell component of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma but require correlation with the labeled immunopanel for specific interpretation.

ddx.vs: Nuclear B-cell transcription factor staining is similar in large cells, so THRLBCL is separated by a diffuse CD8+ T-cell background without CD21+ meshworks.
HRS cells are strongly MUM1+ but typically lack OCT2 and BOB1 with weak PAX5, whereas LP cells retain strong OCT2/BOB1.
Reactive immunoblasts show a spectrum of plasmacytoid maturation with polytypic light chains in a preserved nodal architecture, rather than atypical lobulated LP cells.

61973.recognize_zh: CD7 免疫染色中，密集淋巴球浸潤裡只有散在的部分細胞呈細胞膜陽性，大多數小到中型細胞為陰性（藍色）；在 T 細胞為主的病灶中出現大量 CD7 缺失，提示 T 細胞異常表型，常見於 CD4+ 小/中型 T 細胞增生性疾病。
features: Dense infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells
Membranous CD7 staining in scattered cells only, a minority of the infiltrate
Most lymphoid cells are CD7-negative despite a T-cell-predominant lesion
Positive cells are evenly distributed without zonation
Supports partial loss of CD7 expression
61973.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD7 on a skin biopsy shows a dense lymphoid infiltrate in which only scattered cells show membranous staining, while the majority of small to medium-sized cells are negative. Given the T-cell predominance of the infiltrate on CD3, this indicates partial loss of CD7 expression. CD7 loss is a common aberrancy in cutaneous T-cell lymphoproliferations but is not specific, as it can also be seen in reactive dermatoses. Findings support an atypical T-cell population and are consistent with primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder in context.

ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates can also show some CD7 loss, so separation relies on the clinical presentation, a mixed B/T composition and absence of a dominant clone rather than CD7 alone.
Mycosis fungoides also frequently loses CD7 but is epidermotropic with a patch/plaque history, unlike a solitary dermal nodule.
ATLL typically shows CD7 loss with CD25 positivity, HTLV-1 serology and flower cells in blood.

61909.recognize_zh: 低倍下一個斜切的毛囊（含毛幹）周圍被密集淋巴樣細胞包圍，浸潤並向外延伸到皮下脂肪小葉間；附屬器周圍加上皮下脂肪侵犯的深層分布，是HV-LPD切片中常見的樣式。
features: Obliquely sectioned hair follicle with pigmented hair shaft surrounded by a dense lymphoid cuff (perifollicular infiltrate)
Infiltrate extends into surrounding deep dermis and between adipocytes of subcutaneous fat lobules
Follicular epithelium largely intact without significant folliculotropism or mucin at this magnification
Cells appear small to medium; cytologic detail limited at low power
No necrosis or granulomas evident
61909.describe_en: Low-power sections of deep dermis and subcutis show a dense lymphoid infiltrate cuffing an obliquely sectioned hair follicle and extending into the surrounding dermis and between adipocytes of the subcutaneous fat lobules. The follicular epithelium is largely intact without obvious folliculotropism or follicular mucinosis, and no necrosis or granulomas are seen. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. The deep periadnexal and subcutaneous distribution, with an EBER-positive cytotoxic infiltrate, is consistent with hydroa vacciniforme lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Folliculotropic MF shows atypical cerebriform lymphocytes infiltrating follicular epithelium, often with follicular mucinosis, and is EBER-negative.
SPTCL is restricted to fat lobules with adipocyte rimming and spares the periadnexal dermis, and is EBER-negative.
Lupus shows perifollicular and periadnexal lymphocytes with interface change, dermal mucin and plasma cells, with an EBER-negative polyclonal infiltrate.

61845.recognize_zh: 高倍下組織球的細胞質充滿細小空泡而呈泡沫狀，核小而溫和，夾在粗厚的嗜伊紅膠原束之間；這種泡沫組織球伴纖維化的組合支持 Erdheim-Chester 病。
features: Histiocytes with abundant finely vacuolated (foamy, xanthomatous) cytoplasm
Small round to oval bland nuclei, some slightly spindled
Occasional multinucleated histiocytes
Dense eosinophilic collagen bundles and fibrosis between histiocytes
Scattered lymphocytes and adipocytes; no atypia or mitoses
61845.describe_en: High-power view shows clusters of histiocytes with abundant finely vacuolated, foamy cytoplasm and small bland round to oval nuclei, some multinucleated, dispersed between thick eosinophilic collagen bundles. Scattered lymphocytes and fat spaces are present, and there is no nuclear atypia, mitotic activity, or emperipolesis. Findings are consistent with a xanthomatous histiocytic infiltrate with fibrosis, compatible with Erdheim-Chester disease when supported by CD68+/CD163+/CD1a-/Langerin- immunophenotype, clinical-radiologic findings, and MAPK pathway mutation.

ddx.vs: Xanthomas consist of similar foam cells but are usually associated with hyperlipidemia and lack fibrosis with systemic organ and bone involvement.
RDD histiocytes have eosinophilic rather than finely foamy cytoplasm, show emperipolesis, and are S100 positive.
LCH cells have folded grooved nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm with eosinophils and are CD1a/Langerin positive.
Granular cell tumor has coarse eosinophilic granular (not foamy) cytoplasm and is S100/SOX10 positive.

61717.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一個中大型芽細胞：核大、染色質細緻並可見小核仁，胞質中等量、淡藍色無顆粒，邊緣有細微空泡感且輪廓呈多角形；在 BPDCN 病例中代表循環的腫瘤芽細胞。
features: Single intermediate-to-large blast, about twice the diameter of adjacent red cells
High N:C ratio with a large round-to-polygonal nucleus
Finely dispersed chromatin with a small visible nucleolus
Moderate rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm with faint peripheral microvacuolation
Angular cell outline; no Auer rods
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis
61717.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a circulating intermediate-to-large blast with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and a small nucleolus. The cytoplasm is pale blue, agranular and shows faint peripheral microvacuolation, and the cell outline is angular. No Auer rods are identified, and the background red cells are unremarkable. The morphology is that of a nonspecific blast; in the setting of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm this represents peripheral blood involvement, to be confirmed by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts may show azurophilic granules or Auer rods and express MPO/CD34/CD117, whereas BPDCN blasts are agranular and CD4+/CD56+/CD123-bright.
Lymphoblasts usually have scantier cytoplasm and express TdT with B- or T-lineage markers.
Reactive lymphocytes have more condensed chromatin and abundant basophilic cytoplasm indented by red cells, without a blastic nucleus.

61653.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD117 免疫染色中，大多數浸潤細胞呈強陽性棕色胞質/膜染色，僅殘存少數小型陰性（藍色）細胞，顯示 CD117 陽性的不成熟髓系細胞大量取代骨髓，支持 APL 的免疫表型（CD117 常陽性、CD34 常陰性）。
features: Diffuse strong brown CD117 staining in the majority of infiltrating cells
Granular cytoplasmic and membranous staining pattern in large cells with abundant cytoplasm
Interspersed small CD117-negative cells with blue hematoxylin-counterstained nuclei
Near-complete replacement of marrow by the positive population
Scattered unstained fat/vacuolated spaces
61653.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD117 on the bone marrow core biopsy highlights a diffuse population of large cells with abundant cytoplasm showing strong granular cytoplasmic and membranous positivity, comprising the majority of marrow cellularity. Interspersed small cells, likely residual erythroid precursors and lymphocytes, are negative. In conjunction with H&E morphology and CD34 negativity, this pattern supports an infiltrate of immature myeloid cells consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia; CD117 is not specific and PML::RARA confirmation is required.

ddx.vs: Mast cells are also strongly CD117-positive, but they form spindled paratrabecular/perivascular aggregates and are tryptase- and CD25-positive, MPO-negative.
Most AMLs express CD117 but are usually CD34 and HLA-DR positive, whereas APL is typically CD34 and HLA-DR negative with strong MPO.

ddx.dx: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor or melanoma metastasis
ddx.vs: These CD117-positive tumors are cohesive, CD45- and MPO-negative, and express DOG1 or melanocytic markers.

61589.recognize_zh: 低倍肝臟切片可見肝小葉架構保存，但竇狀隙呈網狀被深染單核細胞浸潤撐開，上方門脈區也有浸潤；這種瀰漫竇狀隙加門脈區浸潤的低倍型態是白血病（此例 JMML）侵犯肝臟的線索。
features: Preserved lobular architecture with intact hepatocyte plates
Diffuse sinusoidal infiltrate of small-to-medium hyperchromatic cells forming a lace-like network
Periportal/portal tract infiltrate at the top of the field
No mass-forming or nodular destructive lesion
Hepatocytes with focal microvesicular clearing; no significant necrosis
61589.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of liver shows preserved lobular architecture with a diffuse infiltrate of hyperchromatic mononuclear cells expanding the sinusoids in a lace-like pattern and involving a portal tract at the top of the field. There is no mass-forming or destructive lesion, and hepatocytes are intact with focal cytoplasmic clearing. Individual cell lineages cannot be resolved at this power. The combined sinusoidal and portal pattern is consistent with hepatic involvement by juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia, to be confirmed on high-power and immunohistochemical evaluation.

ddx.vs: Also sinusoidal, but on high power shows megakaryocytes and erythroid islands without monocytic predominance.
Purely sinusoidal infiltrate of monotonous CD3+ γδ T cells with sparing of portal tracts.
Portal inflammation is lymphoplasmacytic with interface activity and spotty necrosis, not a diffuse sinusoidal hematopoietic infiltrate.

61525.recognize_zh: 混合性發炎背景（小淋巴球、漿細胞、嗜酸性球、組織球）加上細膠原纖維，中下方有一個大型多葉核細胞，上方則有一個核濃縮深染、周圍帶空暈的木乃伊細胞（mummified cell），提示古典何杰金淋巴瘤。
features: Large atypical cell with a multilobated nucleus and abundant amphophilic cytoplasm (HRS variant)
Mummified cell with a condensed, dark, homogeneous nucleus surrounded by a retraction halo
Polymorphous background of small lymphocytes, plasma cells, eosinophils, and epithelioid histiocytes
Delicate eosinophilic collagen fibers coursing between cells
No sheets of large atypical cells in this field
61525.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a polymorphous inflammatory background composed of small lymphocytes, plasma cells, eosinophils, and histiocytes with interspersed fine collagen fibers. Scattered large atypical cells are present, including a multilobated Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg-type cell and a mummified cell with a condensed hyperchromatic nucleus in a clear halo. Large cells do not form cohesive sheets. In the appropriate immunophenotypic context, findings are consistent with classical Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis subtype.

ddx.vs: Mixed cellularity has a similar polymorphous background but lacks broad collagen bands surrounding nodules and lacunar cells, which requires lower-power assessment.
PTCL shows a spectrum of atypical small to large T cells expressing T-cell antigens, rather than rare CD30+/CD15+/PAX5-dim HRS cells among normal-appearing lymphocytes.
Reactive immunoblasts lack multilobation and mummification and are PAX5-bright/CD20+ with a preserved nodal architecture.

61461.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片可見一群中型、核質比高、核圓至腎形、染色質細緻、胞質淡藍的非典型淋巴樣細胞，混雜於紅血球系前驅細胞間並可見分裂相；單看形態不具專一性，需搭配切片竇內分布及流式免疫表型才能診斷肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Clusters of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio and scant to moderate pale-blue agranular cytoplasm
Nuclei round to indented or reniform with fine, dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Occasional cells with elongated or irregular nuclear contours
Mitotic figure present (right center)
Admixed erythroid precursors with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a few small mature lymphocytes/orthochromic cells
Morphology alone is non-specific; cells can resemble blasts or monocytoid cells
61461.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with fine chromatin, round to indented nuclei, inconspicuous nucleoli, and a moderate rim of pale agranular cytoplasm, admixed with basophilic erythroid precursors and a mitotic figure. The atypical cells lack granules and Auer rods. These features are non-specific on the smear alone; distinguishing them from blasts or monocytes requires flow cytometry. In conjunction with an intrasinusoidal infiltrate on biopsy and a CD3+ CD4-/CD8- gamma-delta T-cell phenotype, the findings are consistent with involvement by hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Blasts show finer, more open chromatin with nucleoli and express CD34/TdT or myeloid markers, whereas HSTCL cells are mature CD3+ TdT- T cells.
Monocytes have gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles and are CD14+/CD64+, lacking T-cell markers.
LGLs have abundant pale cytoplasm with coarse azurophilic granules and are usually CD8+ alpha-beta T cells, with an indolent course.
Cells often contain azurophilic granules and are surface CD3-negative, CD56+ and EBV-positive.

61333.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中數顆大型紅血球母細胞，胞質深藍、核染色質細緻呈篩孔狀（megaloblastic），細胞之間以細長的胞質橋相連，符合巨母細胞性貧血的骨髓變化。
features: Large erythroblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and round central nuclei
Open, finely stippled ('sieve-like') chromatin that is immature for the degree of cytoplasmic development
Thin cytoplasmic/internuclear bridges connecting adjacent erythroblasts
Perinuclear clear zone (Golgi) in some cells
Background of red cells and a granulocytic precursor with azurophilic granules
61333.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a group of large erythroid precursors with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and round nuclei with open, finely stippled chromatin. Several of these cells are joined by thin cytoplasmic bridges. No ring-shaped nuclei, multinucleation or blasts with granules are evident in this field.
