Findings are consistent with megaloblastic erythropoiesis with intercellular bridging, as seen in megaloblastic anemia (vitamin B12 or folate deficiency).

ddx.vs: CDA I shows internuclear chromatin bridges between erythroblasts with spongy chromatin on electron microscopy, in the absence of B12/folate deficiency and with a lifelong history.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of proerythroblasts with vacuolated cytoplasm constituting >30% of marrow cells with TP53 mutation, and does not correct with vitamin replacement.
MDS shows megaloblastoid erythroid changes with ring sideroblasts, dysgranulopoiesis or cytogenetic abnormalities despite normal B12/folate levels.
Normal pronormoblasts are sparse and do not show a cohort of bridged large cells with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic anemia — megaloblastic erythroid precursors with open, finely stippled chromatin and intercellular cytoplasmic bridging
pearls_zh: 考法：指著核大、染色質細緻開放、胞質已較成熟的紅系前驅細胞，問「這是什麼變化」→ megaloblastic change，核質成熟不同步（nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony）。
機轉：B12 或 folate 缺乏導致 DNA 合成受損，細胞核成熟落後；骨髓內無效造血造成 LDH、間接膽紅素升高。
配套形態：周邊血 macro-ovalocytes 與 hypersegmented neutrophils；骨髓 giant metamyelocytes / band forms。
檢查：serum B12、folate；B12 邊界值時測 methylmalonic acid（B12 缺乏升高）與 homocysteine（兩者皆升高）。
臨床重點：單補 folate 可改善貧血卻會讓 B12 缺乏的神經病變（subacute combined degeneration）惡化。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 pure erythroid leukemia 或 MDS；megaloblastic 變化伴 giant metamyelocytes 且補充 B12/folate 後迅速恢復，應先排除營養缺乏再診斷腫瘤。

quiz.q: 此骨髓紅系前驅細胞核大、染色質細緻而胞質較成熟，稱為何種變化？最常見的兩種原因為何？
quiz.a: Megaloblastic change（核質成熟不同步）；vitamin B12 或 folate 缺乏

61397.recognize_zh: CD15 免疫染色中，中央一顆大型多葉核巨細胞只有淡淡的細胞質／膜上棕色染色（弱陽性），反而周圍嗜中性球呈強烈顆粒狀陽性，可當作內部陽性對照；巨細胞 CD15 弱表現有助與典型霍奇金淋巴瘤區分。
features: Central giant cell with large multilobated nucleus and weak, faint brown cytoplasmic/membranous CD15 staining
Scattered small cells with strong coarse granular CD15 staining, consistent with neutrophils (internal positive control)
Background histiocytes, lymphocytes and stromal cells negative
No Golgi dot pattern evident in the large cell
61397.describe_en: CD15 immunohistochemistry shows weak, faint cytoplasmic and membranous staining of the large multilobated giant cell in the center, without distinct paranuclear Golgi accentuation. Scattered neutrophils show strong granular staining and serve as an internal positive control, while the remaining background cells are negative. Weak or absent CD15 in the HRS-like cells, together with CD20 positivity and EBER positivity, favors EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer over classic Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: HRS cells more often show strong membranous and Golgi-pattern CD15 with loss of CD20, whereas this giant cell is only weakly positive.
The strongly CD15-positive cells here are small granulocytes, not atypical large cells, so they should not be mistaken for CD15+ tumor cells.
Large cells are CD15-negative or occasionally weak, but are CD30-strong T/null cells lacking PAX5 and CD20.

61269.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一大團黏聚的腫瘤細胞，核大、細胞質極少、彼此擠壓成多角形並有核塑形，細胞團中央夾有淡藍色細絲狀基質；這種成團、非造血細胞的排列加上纖維狀基質，符合神經母細胞瘤轉移至骨髓。
features: Large cohesive cluster of tumor cells distinct from dispersed marrow cells
High N:C ratio with scant cytoplasm; nuclei molded against each other into polygonal shapes
Delicate pale blue fibrillary material in the center of the cluster (neuropil-like)
Nuclear chromatin detail obscured by strong pink color cast and soft focus
Scattered single cells with round nuclei in the background, likely hematopoietic or detached tumor cells
61269.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large cohesive aggregate of tumor cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and nuclear molding, with delicate pale blue fibrillary material in the center of the cluster. Scattered single cells are present in the background. The strong color cast and focus limit evaluation of chromatin pattern and nucleoli, and definite rosettes are not seen. Findings are consistent with metastatic small round cell tumor in the marrow, in keeping with neuroblastoma; immunohistochemistry on the trephine biopsy is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts may clump artificially but lack true molding and fibrillary matrix and are CD45-positive.
Lacks neuropil, has vacuolated PAS-positive cytoplasm, and is CD99/NKX2.2 positive with EWSR1 rearrangement.
Osteoblasts have abundant blue cytoplasm with eccentric nuclei and a Golgi zone rather than scant cytoplasm and molding.
Cells may show vacuolated cytoplasm and multinucleation and are desmin/myogenin positive.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic neuroblastoma in bone marrow — large cohesive tumor cluster with nuclear molding and central fibrillary neuropil
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指細胞團中央的淡藍細絲，問「這是什麼？支持哪種腫瘤？」答：neuropil；neuroblastoma（成熟時可形成 Homer Wright rosettes）。
確診檢查：骨髓切片 IHC（PHOX2B、synaptophysin、chromogranin；CD45 陰性）、尿液 catecholamine 代謝物（VMA/HVA）、MIBG 掃描。
風險分層：年齡、分期、MYCN amplification、組織學分級、11q 缺失與 DNA ploidy。
抹片中的非造血細胞團鑑別：osteoblast、轉移癌、Ewing sarcoma、rhabdomyosarcoma、以及人為聚集的白血病母細胞。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把人為聚集的白血病母細胞或 osteoblast 群當成轉移腫瘤；neuroblastoma 有真正核塑形與纖維狀基質、CD45 陰性，osteoblast 則細胞質豐富、核偏心。

quiz.q: 圖中腫瘤細胞團中央的纖維狀物質稱為什麼？可協助確診的尿液檢查為何？

61205.recognize_zh: A 圖箭頭處紅血球內有藍紫色的環狀／8 字形 Cabot ring，背景為大卵圓形紅血球、淚滴細胞與明顯大小不等及異形；B、C 圖可見粗大嗜鹼性點彩，符合維生素 B12 吸收障礙（Imerslund-Gräsbeck 症候群）造成的巨母細胞性貧血。
features: Panel A: red cell (arrow) containing a thin purple loop/figure-of-eight Cabot ring within a slightly polychromatic cell
Marked anisopoikilocytosis with macro-ovalocytes, teardrop cells, stomatocyte-like cells and an occasional echinocyte
Panels B and C: red cells with coarse basophilic stippling, one teardrop-shaped
Normochromic red cells without significant hypochromia
No neutrophils or platelets are evaluable in these fields
61205.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with macro-ovalocytes, teardrop cells and occasional stomatocytic and echinocytic forms. A red cell containing a Cabot ring is identified (arrow), and separate fields show red cells with coarse basophilic stippling. These features reflect severe dyserythropoiesis; in the context of congenital selective vitamin B12 malabsorption, the findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia due to Imerslund-Grasbeck syndrome.

ddx.vs: Malarial rings are smaller with a distinct chromatin dot and blue cytoplasm, whereas a Cabot ring is a thin loop or figure-of-eight without a chromatin dot.
Lead poisoning also shows coarse basophilic stippling but is associated with microcytic hypochromic cells rather than macro-ovalocytes.
Thalassemia shows stippling with microcytosis, hypochromia and target cells rather than macro-ovalocytes.
MDS can show Cabot rings and macrocytosis but vitamin B12 levels are normal and anemia does not respond to B12 replacement.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic anemia from Imerslund-Gräsbeck syndrome — Cabot ring, macro-ovalocytes, teardrop cells and coarse basophilic stippling
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指 A 圖紅血球內細環狀／8 字形紫色線，問名稱 → Cabot ring；一般認為是有絲分裂紡錘體殘留，見於巨母細胞性貧血、MDS、鉛中毒等嚴重異常造紅血球。
Imerslund-Gräsbeck syndrome：體染色體隱性，CUBN 或 AMN 基因缺陷，迴腸 intrinsic factor–B12 受體（cubam）失能，造成選擇性 B12 吸收不良；常合併輕度蛋白尿。
與 pernicious anemia 不同：IGS 於幼兒期發病、intrinsic factor 與胃黏膜正常、無 anti-IF 抗體；治療為終身非經口（肌肉注射）B12。
巨母細胞性貧血抹片組合：macro-ovalocytes、hypersegmented neutrophils、Howell-Jolly bodies、basophilic stippling、Cabot rings；嚴重時可有 pancytopenia。
exam.pitfall_zh: Cabot ring 最常誤認為瘧原蟲環狀體：瘧原蟲環較小、有明顯紅紫色 chromatin dot 與藍色胞質；Cabot ring 為細環或 8 字形、無 chromatin dot。

quiz.q: A 圖箭頭所指紅血球內的細環狀構造名稱為何？如何與 Plasmodium ring form 區分？
quiz.a: Cabot ring；Cabot ring 無 chromatin dot、呈細環或 8 字形，瘧原蟲環有 chromatin dot 與藍色胞質

61141.recognize_zh: 淋巴組織中出現成片的組織球，細胞質被大量粉紅色、角狀或針狀的結晶物撐大（B），免疫染色中細胞質內結晶呈棕色且帶纖維紋理（C、D），這是結晶儲存型組織球增生（crystal-storing histiocytosis）的表現。
features: Low power (A): dense small lymphoid infiltrate adjacent to a band of pale eosinophilic histiocyte-rich tissue; a rounded eosinophilic structure within lymphoid tissue (possible Hassall corpuscle)
High power (B): sheets of histiocytes with abundant, densely eosinophilic cytoplasm containing angulated, rhomboid and needle-like crystalline material
Interspersed small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid cells between the crystal-laden histiocytes
IHC (C, D): strong cytoplasmic staining of the histiocytes, highlighting striated, fibrillary crystalline inclusions
Histiocyte nuclei small and displaced by the crystals; no significant atypia in the histiocytes
61141.describe_en: Composite figure of a thymic mass. At low power there is a dense lymphoid infiltrate bordered by an eosinophilic histiocyte-rich zone. At higher power, sheets of histiocytes are distended by abundant intracytoplasmic eosinophilic, angulated to needle-shaped crystals, with interspersed small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid cells. Immunohistochemical stains highlight the crystal-laden cytoplasm and accentuate the fibrillary, striated texture of the crystals (specific antibodies not labeled in the figure). Findings are consistent with crystal-storing histiocytosis, which should prompt a search for an underlying light-chain-secreting B-cell or plasma cell neoplasm, here thymic extranodal marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Myoid and granular cell lesions have desmin/myogenin or S100 positivity, whereas crystal-storing cells are CD68/CD163-positive histiocytes with immunoglobulin light-chain crystals.
LCH cells have grooved nuclei, eosinophils and CD1a/langerin positivity and do not contain eosinophilic crystalline inclusions.
Spindled histiocytes with striated pale cytoplasm in mycobacterial infection are AFB positive and lack light-chain-restricted crystals.

ddx.dx: Adult rhabdomyoma-like thymoma or thymic carcinoma
ddx.vs: Epithelial neoplasms are keratin positive and cohesive, while the crystal-laden cells here are histiocytes.

61077.recognize_zh: 成片大型非典型淋巴樣細胞瀰漫浸潤，中央一條小血管被腫瘤細胞以同心圓方式緊密包繞（血管周圍袖套，perivascular cuffing），細胞核呈泡狀、有核仁並見核分裂，為中樞神經原發 DLBCL 的典型切面。
features: Diffuse, densely cellular infiltrate of large atypical lymphoid cells
Angiocentric arrangement: tumor cells concentrically cuffing and infiltrating the wall of a central small vessel
Nuclei ≥2x small lymphocytes with vesicular chromatin, irregular contours and visible nucleoli
Scattered mitotic figures and apoptotic/darkly condensed cells
Scant cytoplasm; no glial fibrillary background or cohesive nesting evident
61077.describe_en: Sections show a diffuse, densely cellular infiltrate of large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin, irregular nuclear contours, visible nucleoli and scattered mitoses. The tumor cells are arranged concentrically around and within the wall of a small blood vessel, producing perivascular cuffing. No cohesive nests, fibrillary glial background or pseudopalisading necrosis are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with primary diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the CNS, to be confirmed by B-cell immunostains (CD20, PAX5) and typically a non-GCB (MUM1+) profile.

ddx.vs: Glioblastoma shows fibrillary GFAP+ tumor cells, microvascular proliferation and palisading necrosis rather than discohesive large lymphoid cells cuffing vessels.
Carcinoma forms cohesive nests with more cytoplasm and is keratin-positive and CD45-negative.
Reactive cuffs contain small mature T lymphocytes and macrophages without sheets of large atypical cells with mitoses.
IVLBCL cells are confined to vessel lumina without forming a parenchymal mass or perivascular cuffs.

exam.answer_en: Primary DLBCL of the CNS — large atypical lymphoid cells with perivascular cuffing of a small vessel
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍考細胞辨識（大型非典型淋巴細胞、泡狀核、核仁、核分裂）與中央小血管被腫瘤細胞同心圓包繞的 perivascular cuffing。
第一步 IHC：CD45、CD20/PAX5 證明 B 細胞；GFAP、keratin 陰性以排除膠質瘤與轉移癌。
免疫功能正常者 PCNSL 多為 EBV 陰性；HIV 或移植病人的 CNS 淋巴瘤則多為 EBV 陽性。
診斷以立體定位切片為主，不以手術切除為治療；切片前避免類固醇。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為腦炎的反應性血管周圍袖套；反應性袖套為小 T 淋巴球與巨噬細胞，沒有成片大型非典型細胞與核分裂。

quiz.q: 此腦部切片中圍繞小血管浸潤的大型非典型細胞，確認診斷時最先做哪個 IHC？

61013.recognize_zh: A–C 三格周邊血中各有一個淋巴球，細胞質呈深藍色、核偏位、核旁可見淡染區，外觀像漿細胞（plasmacytoid lymphocyte）；搭配 D–E 圖表說明登革熱初次與再次感染時 NS1、病毒、IgM、IgG 的偵測時間差，提示此類細胞在發燒、血小板低下旅客中應想到登革熱。
features: Panels A-C: medium-sized lymphocytes with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse, clumped chromatin; faint perinuclear pale zone in some cells
No visible nucleoli or cytoplasmic granules; morphology intermediate between reactive lymphocyte and plasma cell
Background red cells largely normocytic without visible intraerythrocytic parasites in these fields
Platelets are sparse in the fields shown
Panels D-E: line graphs of diagnostic test sensitivity (virus, NS1, IgM, IgG) versus days after fever onset in primary and secondary dengue
61013.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (panels A-C) shows atypical plasmacytoid lymphocytes characterized by abundant, intensely basophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei with clumped chromatin, and a subtle perinuclear clearing. Red cells appear unremarkable and no malaria parasites are identified in the fields shown; platelets are scarce. Panels D and E are schematic graphs showing that in primary dengue IgM rises by about day 5-6 while IgG rises late, whereas in secondary infection IgG rises early and IgM may be low or undetectable. In a febrile, thrombocytopenic returning traveler, these plasmacytoid lymphocytes are suggestive of dengue virus infection, which should be confirmed by NS1 antigen, RT-PCR, or paired serology.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic plasma cells show a well-formed Golgi hof, more abundant cytoplasm and often atypia, and are monotypic on flow cytometry, unlike these transient polyclonal plasmacytoid lymphocytes.
EBV-reactive lymphocytes are larger with abundant pale-to-blue cytoplasm that scallops around adjacent red cells, rather than compact deeply basophilic plasmacytoid cells.
LPL shows a persistent, clonal population of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid cells with an IgM paraprotein, not a self-limited febrile illness.
Separated by identifying intraerythrocytic parasites on thick and thin films, which were absent here.

60949.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中箭頭指出圓形或梭形、由波浪狀細長纖維與細長核組成的束狀結構，周圍有神經束膜包覆，免疫染色呈棕色陽性，這是骨髓內的周邊神經，不應誤認為腫瘤或肉芽腫。
features: Well-circumscribed bundle of wavy, pale eosinophilic fibers with elongated slender nuclei (arrow, H&E)
Thin perineurial sheath surrounding the bundle
Longitudinally cut nerve alongside a small vessel in an IHC-stained section (arrow)
Nerve bundles strongly highlighted by immunostain (brown) in several sections (arrows), consistent with a neural marker
Surrounding marrow cellular with hematopoietic/leukemic cells and fat
60949.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine sections show small, well-circumscribed bundles composed of wavy fibrillary eosinophilic stroma with slender elongated nuclei and a thin perineurial sheath, located within the intertrabecular marrow adjacent to vessels. Immunohistochemical stains highlight these structures as discrete brown bundles consistent with peripheral nerve twigs. The surrounding marrow is cellular. These structures represent normal intramedullary nerves, an incidental finding that should not be mistaken for granulomas, metastatic spindle cell tumor or fibrosis in this case of therapy-related acute myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Granulomas consist of plump epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pink cytoplasm, often with giant cells, rather than wavy fibers with slender nuclei and a perineurium.
Metastases infiltrate destructively with atypia and mitoses and lack an organized perineurial sheath.
Mast cell aggregates are spindled but tryptase/CD117 positive and associated with eosinophils and fibrosis rather than being S100/neurofilament positive.
Vessels have a lumen and smooth muscle media rather than a solid bundle of wavy neural fibers.

60885.recognize_zh: 同一視野中，上方與左下方是大型、核深染、彼此緊密黏聚成巢的腫瘤細胞，右下方則是含紅系前驅細胞、顆粒球與巨核細胞的正常造血區；造血細胞不會形成黏聚性細胞巢，因此強烈提示轉移性非造血腫瘤。
features: Sharp interface between cohesive tumor nests (upper field, lower left) and residual trilineage hematopoiesis (lower right)
Tumor cells larger than hematopoietic cells, with high N:C ratio, hyperchromatic oval to molded nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Tumor cells arranged in tightly packed sheets and cords, lining spaces in a pseudoalveolar/pseudoglandular pattern
Residual marrow with erythroid precursors (small round dark nuclei), maturing granulocytes and a megakaryocyte
Adjacent bony trabecula at left; interspersed adipocytes and dilated sinusoids
60885.describe_en: Hematoxylin and eosin-stained bone marrow biopsy shows a paratrabecular field with two distinct populations. Cohesive nests and cords of large tumor cells with hyperchromatic, overlapping oval nuclei and scant cytoplasm occupy the upper and lower left portions of the field, focally lining spaces in a pseudoalveolar arrangement. They abut residual normal hematopoiesis containing erythroid precursors, maturing granulocytes and a megakaryocyte. The cohesive growth pattern is uncharacteristic of hematopoietic cells and indicates a metastatic non-hematopoietic neoplasm, consistent with metastatic alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma in this child.

ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma nests often contain eosinophilic fibrillary neuropil and Homer Wright rosettes and stain for synaptophysin/PHOX2B rather than myogenin.
Ewing cells are monotonous with fine chromatin and clear cytoplasm, CD99 and NKX2.2 positive.
Leukemic blasts grow as diffuse discohesive sheets replacing marrow rather than cohesive nests with a sharp interface, and are TdT/CD34/MPO positive.

ddx.dx: Clusters of erythroid precursors or megakaryocytes
ddx.vs: Normal erythroid islands consist of small round nuclei with perinuclear halos and show maturation, unlike these large pleomorphic overlapping nuclei.

60821.recognize_zh: CD15 染色在大型腫瘤細胞中呈顆粒狀胞質與膜狀陽性，並有明顯的核旁 Golgi 點狀加強，背景小細胞陰性；B 細胞表型的大細胞同時帶 CD15，是灰區淋巴瘤的特徵之一。
features: Large cells with abundant cytoplasm showing coarse granular cytoplasmic and membranous CD15 staining
Prominent paranuclear (Golgi) dot accentuation in many large cells
Staining present in most of the large cell population
Background small lymphocytes and stromal cells negative
60821.describe_en: CD15 immunohistochemistry shows granular cytoplasmic and membranous staining with paranuclear Golgi-pattern accentuation in the large atypical cells, which are positive throughout the field, while background small lymphoid cells are negative. This Hodgkin-type CD15 staining pattern in large cells that retain B-cell program markers (CD20, Oct-2) supports a B-cell lymphoma with features intermediate between diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and classic Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: cHL shows the same CD15 Golgi pattern but Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells lose CD20 and Oct-2 in most cells, whereas here the B-cell program is retained.
PMBL is typically CD15-negative with strong uniform CD20/CD79a and sheets of medium-to-large cells with clear cytoplasm.
Granulocytes and myeloid cells are CD15-positive but also express MPO/lysozyme and lack B-cell markers and Hodgkin-like morphology.

60757.recognize_zh: A 圖周邊血可見大量橢圓形與鉛筆狀紅血球（elliptocytes），分布均勻；B 圖骨髓抹片細胞量多、可見芽細胞與異常紅血球系前驅細胞（箭頭），在 del(20q) 骨髓分化不良症候群中出現的是後天性橢圓形紅血球增多，而非遺傳性。
features: Panel A (peripheral blood): numerous elliptocytes and elongated ovalocytes comprising a large proportion of red cells, with occasional teardrop-like forms
Panel A: a single neutrophil and scattered platelets; no significant polychromasia evident
Panel B (marrow aspirate): cellular smear with immature cells having high N:C ratio and fine chromatin, admixed with granulocytic precursors
Panel B: arrows mark abnormal precursors, apparently with irregular or vacuolated cytoplasm and nuclear-cytoplasmic dyssynchrony; fine dysplastic detail is limited by low image resolution
Elliptocytes are also visible in the marrow smear background
60757.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (A) shows prominent elliptocytosis, with a large fraction of red cells being oval to elongated pencil-shaped forms, and a single neutrophil without obvious dysplastic features at this magnification. The bone marrow aspirate (B) is cellular, with immature cells including blasts and abnormal precursors marked by arrows; the low resolution precludes detailed assessment of dysplasia or an accurate blast count. In a patient with an MDS with excess blasts and del(20q), findings are consistent with acquired elliptocytosis associated with a myelodysplastic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Lifelong, often familial, with normal marrow maturation and spectrin/protein 4.1 defects, whereas acquired elliptocytosis appears with dysplasia, cytopenias and clonal abnormalities such as del(20q).
Produces pencil cells with hypochromia and microcytosis and low ferritin, without increased blasts.
Shows teardrop cells with leukoerythroblastosis and marrow fibrosis, rather than predominant regular elliptocytes.
Causes macro-ovalocytes with hypersegmented neutrophils and megaloblastic precursors, and corrects with B12/folate replacement.

60629.recognize_zh: 周邊血中可見兩顆有核紅血球的細胞核之間以細長染色質絲相連（箭頭，internuclear chromatin bridging），另有雙核紅血球前驅細胞，屬於明確的紅血球系發育異常（dyserythropoiesis），提示 MDS。
features: Pairs of nucleated red blood cells with round, condensed nuclei connected by a thin internuclear chromatin bridge (arrows)
Binucleated erythroid precursor with polychromatophilic cytoplasm
Marked anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells, elliptocytes, fragments and an echinocyte
Left-shifted/dysplastic granulocyte with abnormal nuclear contour
Platelets present, some small and scattered
60629.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating nucleated red blood cells, including pairs of erythroblasts connected by fine internuclear chromatin bridges and a binucleated erythroid precursor. Red cells show marked anisopoikilocytosis with dacrocytes, elliptocytes and fragments. A granulocyte with abnormal nuclear morphology is also present. Internuclear bridging and multinucleation are features of dyserythropoiesis; findings are suggestive of a myelodysplastic syndrome with multilineage dysplasia, pending bone marrow examination and cytogenetics.

ddx.vs: CDA-I also shows internuclear chromatin bridges but presents in young patients with isolated erythroid dysplasia and no granulocytic dysplasia or clonal cytogenetics.
Megaloblastic anemia shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open chromatin, macro-ovalocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, reversible with B12/folate.
Myelofibrosis shows teardrop cells and nucleated red cells but typically without chromatin bridges or binucleation.
Overlapping cells lack a discrete thin strand of chromatin linking separate nuclei.

60693.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液細胞離心抹片中出現大量成群的小型淋巴樣細胞，免疫細胞化學一張呈細胞膜陽性、另一張呈細胞質陽性，證實為中樞神經系統內的單株性 B 淋巴樣細胞，在 Waldenström 巨球蛋白血症病人即符合 Bing-Neel 症候群。
features: CSF cytospin (A): markedly increased cellularity with loose clusters and singly dispersed small-to-medium lymphoid cells with round nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Immunocytochemistry (B): crisp membranous staining of the lymphoid cells (B-cell surface marker, unlabeled)
Immunocytochemistry (C): diffuse cytoplasmic staining of a cluster of cells, compatible with cytoplasmic immunoglobulin/light chain (marker unlabeled)
Low magnification and resolution limit assessment of plasmacytoid features and nucleoli
60693.describe_en: Cerebrospinal fluid cytospin shows a markedly increased population of small-to-medium lymphoid cells arranged singly and in loose clusters, with round nuclei and scant cytoplasm; plasmacytoid detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. Immunocytochemical stains demonstrate membranous positivity in the lymphoid cells on one preparation and cytoplasmic positivity on another (antibodies not labeled in the figure), supporting a B-lineage population with cytoplasmic immunoglobulin. In a patient with Waldenström macroglobulinemia, findings are consistent with central nervous system involvement by lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma (Bing-Neel syndrome); flow cytometric light chain restriction and MYD88 L265P testing of CSF provide confirmation.

ddx.vs: Reactive CSF contains a mixture of T cells, monocytes and activated lymphocytes that are polytypic and MYD88 wild-type.

ddx.dx: CNS involvement by diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are large with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli and high proliferation, unlike these small uniform lymphoid cells.
Blood contamination brings red cells and leukocytes in blood proportions rather than a dense clonal lymphoid population.

ddx.dx: CNS hyperviscosity or IgM paraprotein neuropathy
ddx.vs: These cause neurologic symptoms without lymphoplasmacytic cells in the CSF.

captions: CSF cytospin: increased small lymphoid cells in clusters
Immunocytochemistry: membranous staining of lymphoid cells
Immunocytochemistry: cytoplasmic staining of a cell cluster

60437.recognize_zh: 抹片中一個小顆粒（particle）旁可見紅血球系與骨髓系前驅細胞混合，沒有成片的母細胞，造血細胞只集中在局部；需配合切片的低細胞性與片狀造血灶，才能支持兒童難治性血球減少症。
features: Small marrow particle with stromal strands; hematopoietic cells clustered focally rather than diffusely
Mixture of erythroid precursors (round nuclei, deep blue cytoplasm, condensing chromatin) and granulocytic precursors
Several larger precursors with fine chromatin and small nucleoli, but no blast sheets
Occasional mature granulocytes and lymphocytes; no overt dysplastic forms clearly identified in this field
Background of scattered red cells; no abnormal infiltrate
60437.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows a small particle with associated stromal strands and a focal collection of hematopoietic cells. Both erythroid precursors and maturing granulocytic precursors are present, with scattered larger early precursors but no increase in blasts. Definite dysplasia is not evident in this single field. The findings are nonspecific on their own and must be interpreted with the hypocellular, patchy biopsy; in that context they are consistent with refractory cytopenia of childhood.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia aspirates are typically dilute with lymphocytes, plasma cells and stromal cells predominating, whereas focal preserved erythroid and myeloid maturation favors refractory cytopenia of childhood.
Excess blasts would be evident as increased agranular blasts on the differential (>=2% PB or >=5% BM), which are not present here.
Morphology may overlap; persistence of cytopenias, dysplasia in multiple lineages, or clonal cytogenetic abnormalities such as monosomy 7 support the neoplastic diagnosis.

60373.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中，片狀中型芽細胞具細緻散開的染色質、不規則或有凹陷的核膜、核仁不明顯且細胞質稀少，並可見有絲分裂，其間僅殘存少量深染的紅血球前驅細胞，符合 B-ALL 骨髓浸潤。
features: Sheets of medium-sized blasts with scant pale cytoplasm and high N:C ratio
Round to irregular, focally convoluted or indented nuclear contours
Finely dispersed, open chromatin with small or inconspicuous nucleoli
Scattered mitotic figures
Few residual erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei; rare hemosiderin granules
Interstitial eosinophilic proteinaceous material/sinusoidal red cells between blasts
60373.describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow core biopsy shows diffuse sheets of medium-sized blasts with scant cytoplasm, round to irregular and focally indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Mitotic figures are present. Residual normal hematopoiesis is limited to scattered erythroid precursors with condensed nuclei, and megakaryocytes are not seen in this field. In conjunction with CD34, TdT, CD79a and CD10 positivity, findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by relapsed B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: AML blasts often have more cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli; immunohistochemistry for MPO/CD117 versus PAX5/CD79a/TdT is decisive.
Nuclear convolutions can be seen in both; cytoplasmic CD3 positivity and lack of B markers indicate T lineage.
Burkitt shows starry-sky tingible-body macrophages and TdT-/CD34- mature B cells with near-100% Ki-67.
Blastoid MCL is cyclin D1+/SOX11+ and TdT-/CD34-, unlike these TdT+/CD34+ blasts.

60181.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一個嗜中性球核呈雙葉、染色質粗塊，細胞質淡而幾乎沒有顆粒（低顆粒、假性 Pelger 樣），周圍多為紅母細胞，是 MDS 常見的顆粒球發育異常。
features: Central neutrophil with bilobed (pseudo-Pelger-like) nucleus and coarsely clumped chromatin
Markedly hypogranular, pale gray cytoplasm in the neutrophil
Numerous erythroid precursors (basophilic to polychromatic normoblasts) surrounding it
One cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nucleus, likely an early erythroid precursor
Smudged cell debris and red cells with mild poikilocytosis in the background
60181.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypogranular neutrophil with a bilobed, pseudo-Pelger-Huët-like nucleus and clumped chromatin, set among numerous erythroid precursors. The neutrophil cytoplasm is pale and nearly devoid of granules. Blasts are not conspicuous in this field. Hypogranular neutrophils with abnormal nuclear segmentation represent dysgranulopoiesis and, with a blast percentage of 5%, support myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts-1.

ddx.vs: Inherited Pelger-Huët neutrophils are uniformly bilobed but normally granulated, without cytopenias or other lineage dysplasia.
Medications such as mycophenolate or taxanes cause reversible changes, and history plus absence of clonality exclude MDS.

ddx.dx: Smear or staining artifact (poor granule staining)
ddx.vs: Artifactual hypogranulation affects all granulocytes evenly, whereas eosinophils and adjacent well-stained cells serve as internal controls.

exam.answer_en: Dysgranulopoiesis in MDS with excess blasts-1 — hypogranular pseudo-Pelger-Huët neutrophil with bilobed nucleus among erythroid precursors
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著中央雙葉、胞質淡而無顆粒的中性球問形態名稱——答 pseudo-Pelger-Huët 合併 hypogranulation，是 MDS 中最具代表性的顆粒球發育異常之一。
WHO 2016 MDS-EB-1：骨髓 blasts 5–9% 或周邊 2–4%，無 Auer rods；WHO 5th 為 MDS-IB1；ICC 2022 為 MDS-EB。
Pseudo-Pelger 在 MDS/AML 與 TP53 突變或 del(17p) 有關聯；看到大量 pseudo-Pelger 時應注意核型與 TP53 狀態。
非腫瘤原因需排除：藥物（mycophenolate、化療）、HIV、嚴重感染；遺傳性 Pelger-Huët anomaly（LBR 突變）中性球顆粒正常、功能正常。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易將 pseudo-Pelger 誤判為正常 band 或抹片凋亡細胞；band 核呈連續 C/S 形且顆粒正常，凋亡中性球核呈數個緻密圓球且胞質常空泡化，pseudo-Pelger 為兩個緻密葉以細絲相連且低顆粒。

quiz.q: 圖中央雙葉、顆粒稀少的中性球稱為什麼？骨髓 blasts 5% 且有此發育異常的 MDS，WHO 2016 分類為何？

60117.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片四聯圖：H&E 見單形細胞浸潤於脂肪間，CD3 呈瀰漫強陽性，而 TdT 只零星陽性、CD34 陰性；與流式結果（TdT−、CD34−）一致，但判讀 T-ALL 時要記得 TdT/CD34 陰性不能排除。
features: H&E: cellular marrow space between trabeculae with a diffuse monotonous infiltrate among fat cells
CD3: strong, diffuse positivity in the large majority of marrow cells
TdT: only scattered nuclear-positive cells; most infiltrating cells negative
CD34: essentially negative in the infiltrate
Pattern parallels the flow cytometry profile (cCD3+, TdT-, CD34-)
60117.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy composite shows, on H&E, a diffuse monotonous cellular infiltrate among fat cells between bony trabeculae. Immunohistochemistry demonstrates strong diffuse CD3 positivity in the vast majority of cells, whereas TdT highlights only scattered cells and CD34 is essentially negative. This CD3-positive, TdT-largely-negative, CD34-negative profile matches the flow cytometric findings. In the context of blast morphology on the aspirate, findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia with a TdT-negative phenotype; additional immature markers (CD1a, CD99) would further support immaturity.

ddx.vs: Also CD3+/TdT-/CD34-, so separation requires blast morphology, CD1a/CD99 expression, and flow cytometric CD45-dim gating.
Reactive T cells are small, mature, admixed with preserved hematopoiesis and do not replace the marrow diffusely.
B-ALL would be CD3-negative with PAX5/CD79a positivity and usually TdT positive.

60053.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片幾乎整片都是脂肪細胞，僅見散在的基質細胞、小血管與紅血球，找不到巨核細胞或成群的造血前驅細胞，細胞密度明顯低於 10%，符合再生不良性貧血的三系低下（trilineage hypoplasia）。
features: Marrow space almost entirely replaced by mature adipocytes
Estimated hematopoietic cellularity well below 10%
Only scattered spindled stromal cells, endothelial cells, and occasional lymphoid/plasma-type cells
No megakaryocytes and no erythroid or granulocytic islands identified
Scattered extravasated red cells; no fibrosis, granulomas, or infiltrate
Edge of a bony trabecula at the lower right
60053.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypocellular marrow in which the intertrabecular space is replaced by mature adipose tissue. Residual cells consist of scattered stromal and endothelial cells with rare lymphoid cells; megakaryocytes and erythroid or myeloid precursors are not identified in this field. There is no fibrosis, abnormal infiltrate, or granulomatous inflammation. Findings show severe trilineage hypoplasia with less than 10% cellularity, consistent with aplastic anemia; testing for an associated PNH clone is appropriate.

ddx.vs: Hypocellular MDS retains foci of dysplastic megakaryocytes or clustered immature precursors and often clonal cytogenetic abnormalities, none of which are seen in this uniformly fatty marrow.
Hypocellular AML shows residual clusters or sheets of blasts (CD34+) within the fat, whereas no blast aggregates are present here.
Gelatinous transformation shows pale pink-blue extracellular ground substance with atrophic fat cells, rather than the intact mature adipocytes seen here.
Hairy cell leukemia can mimic a dry hypocellular marrow but shows an interstitial infiltrate of fried-egg cells with reticulin fibrosis and CD20/annexin A1 positivity.

exam.answer_en: Aplastic anemia — markedly hypocellular fatty marrow (<10% cellularity) with trilineage hypoplasia and no megakaryocytes or abnormal infiltrate
pearls_zh: 考法：考官問細胞密度與診斷；答 cellularity <10%、三系低下、無纖維化或異常浸潤。細胞密度判讀必須用切片而非 aspirate，且切片長度要足夠。
嚴重度（Camitta）：severe AA 需骨髓 cellularity <25%（或 25–50% 但殘存造血細胞 <30%），加上 ANC <0.5、血小板 <20、網狀紅血球過低三項中至少兩項；ANC <0.2 為 very severe。
必做檢查：PNH flow（FLAER/CD59），因 AA 常合併小型 PNH clone；細胞遺傳與 NGS 排除 hypocellular MDS；年輕病人篩檢 telomere length 與 chromosome breakage test。
治療：年輕且有 HLA 相合手足者優先 allo-HSCT；其餘採 horse ATG + cyclosporine，現多加 eltrombopag。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為 hypocellular MDS 或 hypocellular AML：後兩者在低細胞背景中仍可見發育不良小型巨核細胞、CD34+ 母細胞成群或克隆性染色體異常；AA 的殘存細胞以淋巴球、漿細胞與基質為主，巨核細胞幾乎消失。

quiz.q: 此骨髓切片幾乎全為脂肪，診斷 aplastic anemia 時需同時做哪一項流式檢查以找出相關克隆？
quiz.a: PNH 流式細胞檢查（顆粒球/單核球 FLAER 與 CD24/CD14，紅血球 CD59）。

28821.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一群胞質淡藍灰、核卵圓或腎形的淋巴樣細胞（毛細胞）之間，夾著一個核偏位、胞質嗜鹼、有核旁淡染區的漿細胞；雙重免疫染色把紅色標記的漿細胞與棕色核染的間質淋巴樣細胞分開，顯示兩種腫瘤並存。
features: Background of medium-sized lymphoid cells with oval to reniform nuclei, homogeneous chromatin and moderate pale grey-blue cytoplasm with indistinct, slightly irregular borders (panel A)
Large plasma cell with eccentric round nucleus, perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing a small vacuole among the lymphoid cells (arrow)
Occasional erythroid precursors and a basophil/mast-type granulated cell in the field

Double immunostain of the marrow biopsy: red membranous/cytoplasmic staining of large plasma cells versus brown nuclear staining of a separate interstitial population of smaller cells between fat spaces (panel B; markers not labeled)
28821.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a population of medium-sized lymphoid cells with oval to bean-shaped nuclei, bland homogeneous chromatin and moderate amounts of pale grey-blue cytoplasm, among which a large plasma cell with an eccentric nucleus, perinuclear hof and basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm is present. The bone marrow biopsy double immunostain highlights two distinct populations: larger cells with red membranous/cytoplasmic staining in a plasma cell distribution and an interstitial infiltrate of smaller cells with brown nuclear staining. In conjunction with flow cytometry and clonality studies, findings are consistent with synchronous hairy cell leukemia and a plasma cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia with reactive plasmacytosis
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are polytypic by kappa/lambda staining, whereas a coexisting myeloma shows light-chain-restricted, often CD56+/CD19- plasma cells.
LPL is a single clone spanning small lymphocytes to plasma cells with MYD88 L265P, rather than two separate populations with HCL immunophenotype (CD103, CD25, CD11c, annexin A1).

ddx.dx: Splenic marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: SMZL plasmacytic cells share the same light chain as the B cells and lack BRAF V600E and CD103/annexin A1 expression.

21653.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中散布數個大型巨噬細胞（紅箭頭），高倍下其胞質內吞入多個完整的有核細胞（嗜中性球、淋巴球或紅血球前驅細胞）與紅血球碎片，即噬血現象（hemophagocytosis），在成人型 Still 病的脈絡下符合巨噬細胞活化症候群。
features: Low-power field with scattered large macrophages (red arrows) among hematopoietic cells
Macrophages with abundant vacuolated pale-blue cytoplasm and a round to oval eccentric nucleus
Multiple engulfed intact nucleated cells with dense pyknotic nuclei (neutrophils, lymphocytes and/or erythroid precursors) within cytoplasmic vacuoles
Phagocytosed red cells and pink-red cellular debris in the macrophage cytoplasm
No atypical lymphoid cells, blasts or intracellular organisms identified in these fields
21653.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows scattered large macrophages distributed among hematopoietic elements. At high power, the macrophages have abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing multiple engulfed intact nucleated cells, including granulocytes and small cells with dense nuclei consistent with lymphocytes or erythroid precursors, as well as red cells and debris. No atypical lymphoid cells, blasts or microorganisms are identified. Findings represent hemophagocytosis and, in a patient with adult-onset Still's disease and compatible laboratory findings (ferritin, cytopenias, triglycerides), are consistent with macrophage activation syndrome, a secondary form of hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Lymphoma-associated HLH shows accompanying atypical lymphoid cells (e.g. CD30+ or EBV+ T/NK cells) on smear or biopsy, which are absent here.
Intracellular organisms such as Leishmania amastigotes or Histoplasma yeasts, or viral PCR positivity, identify infectious triggers.

ddx.dx: Nonspecific phagocytosis after transfusion, chemotherapy or sepsis
ddx.vs: Occasional hemophagocytic macrophages are nonspecific, so HLH/MAS requires the clinical-laboratory criteria (HLH-2004 or MAS classification criteria).
Emperipolesis involves intact cells passing through megakaryocyte cytoplasm with a lobulated megakaryocyte nucleus, not destruction within a macrophage vacuole.

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytosis in marrow, consistent with macrophage activation syndrome (secondary HLH) in adult-onset Still's disease — macrophages engulfing intact nucleated cells
pearls_zh: 考法：指著紅箭頭的大細胞問「胞質內是什麼？這現象叫什麼？」→ 巨噬細胞吞噬完整有核細胞與紅血球，即 hemophagocytosis。
HLH-2004 診斷需符合 8 項中 5 項（發燒、脾腫大、兩系以上血球減少、高 TG 或低 fibrinogen、噬血現象、NK 活性低、ferritin 升高、sCD25 升高），或有致病基因。
骨髓噬血現象既非必要也非充分；MAS 常見 ferritin 極度升高，且 ESR 可因 fibrinogen 消耗反而下降。
AOSD/sJIA 相關 MAS 治療以高劑量 corticosteroids 為主，anakinra 等 IL-1 阻斷劑常用；需同時排除感染與淋巴瘤誘發。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 megakaryocyte emperipolesis 混淆；emperipolesis 是完整細胞穿行於分葉核的巨核細胞胞質中，噬血則是單核巨噬細胞的空泡內吞噬並分解細胞。

quiz.q: 紅箭頭所指的大細胞胞質內含完整有核細胞，此現象的名稱為何？在 AOSD 病人應想到什麼併發症？

26965.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中部分紅血球內含小型、深藍色的點狀或環狀包涵體，且紅血球外也散在類似的小藍點；配合貧血、血小板低下與「未切脾」的病史提示，應考慮紅血球內寄生蟲（如巴貝西蟲 Babesia），但此圖解析度不足以確定種類。
features: Panel A: a large mononuclear cell with dense nucleus and a rim of blue cytoplasm (reactive-appearing lymphocyte) among red cells
Occasional red cells containing small, dark blue punctate or ring-like intraerythrocytic inclusions
Small blue dots also present outside red cells (possible extracellular organisms versus platelets)
Red cells largely normocytic with central pallor; occasional polychromatic cell
Few platelets in the fields, consistent with thrombocytopenia; image resolution limits identification of parasite morphology
26965.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells with scattered polychromatic cells and a paucity of platelets. A reactive-appearing lymphocyte is present (A). Several erythrocytes contain small, dark, punctate to ring-like inclusions, and similar tiny blue bodies are seen extracellularly (B); pigment, Schüffner dots, gametocytes and tetrad (Maltese cross) forms cannot be confidently assessed at this resolution. Findings are suggestive of an intraerythrocytic parasitic infection such as babesiosis in the appropriate epidemiologic context; confirmation by thick and thin film review at high magnification, parasitemia estimation and PCR is required.

ddx.vs: P. falciparum rings are uniform with double chromatin dots and appliqué forms, crescentic gametocytes may be present, and hemozoin pigment is seen in later stages, whereas Babesia lacks pigment and forms tetrads.
Howell-Jolly bodies are single round dense DNA remnants and Pappenheimer bodies are Prussian blue-positive peripheral clusters, neither with a ring morphology.
Overlying platelets are larger, granular, lie in a different focal plane and lack a chromatin dot with a pale center.
These form morulae within neutrophils (Anaplasma) or monocytes (Ehrlichia) rather than intraerythrocytic inclusions.

17365.recognize_zh: A 周邊血液紅血球內可見細小環狀體（ring forms）；B、C 胎盤絨毛間隙（intervillous space）充滿母體紅血球，其中許多含深色點狀寄生蟲與色素，並夾雜含瘧色素的單核細胞，符合懷孕期惡性瘧原蟲於胎盤的隔離（placental malaria）。
features: Panel A: peripheral blood with delicate intraerythrocytic ring forms, including an RBC with more than one ring; infected RBCs are not enlarged
Panel B: placenta with intervillous space densely filled with maternal RBCs; arrows mark aggregates of RBCs and arrowheads mark pigment-laden cells
Panel C: many intervillous RBCs contain dark dot-like parasites/hemozoin pigment
Panel C: scattered mononuclear cells (monocytes/macrophages) within the intervillous space, some with dark pigment
Chorionic villi with trophoblast lining at the edges; no villous necrosis evident at this resolution
17365.describe_en: Panel A, peripheral blood smear, shows small delicate ring-form trophozoites within normal-sized erythrocytes, including a multiply infected cell. Panels B and C, placental sections (H&E), show the intervillous space packed with maternal erythrocytes, a large proportion of which contain dark dot-like parasites and hemozoin pigment, accompanied by scattered pigment-laden monocytes/macrophages between the chorionic villi. These findings reflect sequestration of parasitized erythrocytes in the placenta. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum infection with placental malaria.

ddx.vs: P. vivax and ovale enlarge infected RBCs with Schuffner stippling and do not cause heavy intervillous sequestration of parasitized cells.
Babesia forms small pleomorphic rings and tetrads (Maltese cross) without hemozoin pigment.
Acid formalin hematin is extracellular, birefringent and diffusely distributed, whereas malarial hemozoin lies within parasitized RBCs and macrophages.
Chronic histiocytic intervillositis shows CD68+ histiocytes in the intervillous space without parasitized RBCs or pigment.

16725.recognize_zh: 臨床照片中，年輕女性的額頭、雙眼淚管、鼻孔、肚臍與手指皮膚表面有血液滲出，但皮膚沒有明顯傷口、瘀斑或紫斑，這種完整皮膚自發性滲血符合血汗症（hematidrosis）。
features: Clinical photographs of a young woman with fresh blood streaks on the forehead running down the nasal bridge
Bloody tears flowing from both medial canthi (hemolacria) and blood below the nostrils and on the upper lip
Blood oozing from the umbilicus and from the dorsal skin of a finger
No visible laceration, ecchymosis, petechiae or purpura on the bleeding skin surfaces
Non-morphologic image; diagnosis relies on clinical exclusion of coagulopathy and factitious bleeding
16725.describe_en: Clinical photographs show an 18-year-old woman with spontaneous bleeding from intact skin and mucosa: blood streaks on the central forehead, bloody tears from both lacrimal regions, blood below the nares, oozing from the umbilicus and a bleeding spot on the dorsum of a finger. The skin surrounding these sites shows no visible wound, bruising or petechial rash. This is not a histologic or cytologic image; interpretation requires normal platelet counts, platelet function and coagulation studies and exclusion of self-inflicted bleeding. Findings are consistent with hematidrosis (hematohidrosis).

ddx.vs: Factitious disorder shows traumatic lesions or bleeding only when unobserved, whereas hematidrosis episodes can be witnessed arising from intact skin with blood cells in sweat on microscopy.

ddx.dx: Inherited or acquired bleeding disorder (VWD, platelet function defect, coagulopathy)
ddx.vs: True bleeding disorders produce abnormal coagulation or platelet function tests and typically ecchymoses or mucosal bleeding at sites of trauma, not blood from intact forehead or navel skin.
Colored sweat from lipofuscin or chromogenic bacteria lacks red blood cells on microscopic examination and is occult-blood negative.

ddx.dx: Hemolacria from local ocular or nasal pathology
ddx.vs: Local conjunctival or nasolacrimal lesions cause isolated bloody tears, not simultaneous bleeding from multiple distant skin sites.

14933.recognize_zh: 慢性血小板低下伴脾腫的患者，周邊血抹片上大部分紅血球的中央淡染區呈狹長裂縫狀（口形紅血球 stomatocyte），並可見接近紅血球大小的巨大血小板，這個組合提示植物固醇血症（sitosterolemia）。
features: Numerous stomatocytes with slit-like or mouth-shaped central pallor across most of the field
Occasional giant platelet approaching the diameter of a red cell, alongside a normal-sized platelet
Reduced platelet number in the field
Red cells otherwise fairly uniform in size without spherocytes, schistocytes, or target cells
No abnormal leukocytes present in this field
14933.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a prominent population of stomatocytes, with slit-like central pallor in the majority of red cells. Platelets are decreased and include a giant platelet approaching the size of an erythrocyte. There are no significant schistocytes, spherocytes, or abnormal leukocytes in this field. The combination of stomatocytosis and macrothrombocytopenia in a patient with splenomegaly is suggestive of sitosterolemia (ABCG5/ABCG8 deficiency); plasma plant sterol measurement and genetic testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Hereditary stomatocytosis has abnormal red cell cation content with normal platelet size, whereas sitosterolemia pairs stomatocytes with macrothrombocytes and elevated plasma phytosterols.
ITP may show large platelets but lacks stomatocytosis and splenomegaly, and plant sterol levels are normal.
MYH9 disease shows giant platelets with Döhle-like inclusions in neutrophils and normal red cell morphology.

ddx.dx: Artifactual stomatocytes (drying artifact) or liver disease/alcohol
ddx.vs: Artifactual stomatocytes are regional in thick areas of the smear and acquired stomatocytosis lacks giant platelets and hereditary sterol accumulation.

14741.recognize_zh: 白血球增多的 CML 背景下，周邊血出現大量帶顆粒的前骨髓細胞與芽細胞（A），骨髓則被成片的異常前骨髓細胞佔滿：細胞大、細胞質充滿嗜天青顆粒、核圓或腎形並可見核仁（B），符合 CML 前骨髓細胞型急變期（promyelocytic blast crisis）。
features: BM aspirate: sheets of large promyelocyte-like cells with abundant cytoplasm packed with azurophilic granules
Round to reniform nuclei with fine chromatin and visible nucleoli
Maturation largely arrested at the promyelocyte stage, with few myelocytes and mature granulocytes
PB: leukocytosis with circulating granulated promyelocytes and blasts plus occasional immature granulocytes
No Auer rod bundles (faggot cells) or bilobed hypogranular nuclei evident at this resolution
14741.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows leukocytosis with circulating blasts and numerous granulated promyelocytes, together with occasional maturing granulocytes. The bone marrow aspirate is replaced by sheets of large promyelocyte-like cells with abundant cytoplasm containing coarse azurophilic granules, round to reniform nuclei, fine chromatin, and nucleoli, with markedly reduced later-stage granulocytic maturation. Faggot cells are not identified at this resolution. In a patient with BCR-ABL1-positive chronic myeloid leukemia, findings are consistent with blast phase with promyelocytic differentiation; cytogenetic or molecular testing for PML-RARA and additional clonal abnormalities is recommended.

ddx.vs: APL shows hypergranular promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and faggot cells and carries t(15;17) without BCR::ABL1, whereas this entity arises from known Ph-positive CML.
Chronic phase shows a full spectrum of granulocytic maturation dominated by myelocytes and segmented neutrophils, not sheets of arrested promyelocytes.
AML with maturation has agranular to lightly granulated myeloblasts >=20% with Auer rods and lacks BCR::ABL1.

ddx.dx: Marrow recovery after G-CSF or toxic insult
ddx.vs: Regenerating marrow shows a synchronized promyelocyte wave that matures within days, with no Ph chromosome and normal karyotype.

2709.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆比周圍造血細胞大數倍的巨噬細胞，細胞質淡藍色、充滿纖維狀條紋，呈「皺紙（crumpled tissue paper）」外觀，核小且偏位，是典型的高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cell）。
features: Very large histiocyte, several times the diameter of adjacent myeloid precursors
Abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fibrillary, wrinkled 'crumpled tissue paper' striations
Small, eccentric, round-to-oval nuclei with condensed chromatin
No discrete vacuoles or phagocytosed cells within the cytoplasm
Background of normal maturing granulocytic precursors and red cells
2709.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows normal maturing granulocytic precursors and a large histiocyte several times the size of surrounding cells. The histiocyte has abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with a fibrillary, wrinkled 'crumpled tissue paper' texture and small eccentric nuclei. There is no hemophagocytosis or vacuolated foamy change. Findings are consistent with a Gaucher cell; confirmation of Gaucher disease requires glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay and GBA1 genotyping, since pseudo-Gaucher cells occur in other disorders.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells are morphologically similar but occur with an underlying neoplasm or infection and normal glucocerebrosidase activity; mycobacterial forms contain acid-fast bacilli.
Niemann-Pick cells have finely vacuolated soap-bubble cytoplasm and sea-blue histiocytes have blue-green granules, not fibrillary striations.
Megakaryocytes have a single large multilobated nucleus and granular pink cytoplasm, not small eccentric nuclei with striated pale cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Gaucher disease — Gaucher cell: giant histiocyte with fibrillary crumpled-tissue-paper cytoplasm and small eccentric nucleus
pearls_zh: 考法：指著比周圍大數倍、胞質呈纖維條紋的細胞問名稱與儲積物 → Gaucher cell，堆積 glucosylceramide（glucocerebroside）。
遺傳：體染色體隱性 GBA1 變異，glucocerebrosidase 活性下降；確診以白血球或乾血點酵素活性測定加上 GBA1 基因檢測，骨髓檢查非必要。
臨床：type 1 最常見、無中樞神經侵犯，表現為脾腫大、血小板低下、貧血與骨病變（骨痛、Erlenmeyer flask 變形、骨壞死）。
治療：type 1 可用 enzyme replacement therapy（如 imiglucerase）或 substrate reduction therapy（eliglustat、miglustat）；ERT 無法改善神經型症狀。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 pseudo-Gaucher cells（CML、myeloma、thalassemia、分枝桿菌感染）混淆，光學顯微鏡下幾乎無法區分；需以 glucocerebrosidase 活性與 GBA1 基因檢測確認。

quiz.q: 這顆胞質如皺紙的大型細胞堆積的是什麼物質？缺乏哪一個酵素？

12693.recognize_zh: 四格周邊血中的單核球／巨噬細胞細胞質內含深黑褐色的瘧色素顆粒（hemozoin），左下一顆細胞還吞入了帶有被寄生紅血球殘影的空泡；從非洲返國的發燒病人出現周邊血吞噬現象，應積極尋找瘧原蟲。
features: Monocytes/macrophages with abundant blue-grey cytoplasm containing dark brown-black hemozoin (malaria pigment) granules
One monocyte contains a vacuole with an engulfed red cell remnant (erythrophagocytosis)
One monocyte contains a dense dark round phagocytosed body
A neutrophil in one panel without visible pigment
Red cells show mild anisocytosis; intraerythrocytic parasites are not clearly identified in these fields
12693.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several circulating monocytes with abundant basophilic cytoplasm containing dark brown-black pigment granules consistent with hemozoin, and monocytes with phagocytosed material, including an engulfed red cell within a cytoplasmic vacuole. A neutrophil without pigment is also present. Intraerythrocytic parasites are not clearly seen in the fields shown. Pigment-laden and erythrophagocytic monocytes in a febrile traveler returning from an endemic area are consistent with malaria (typically Plasmodium falciparum); thick and thin smears, rapid antigen testing, and parasitemia quantification are required, and severe infection should prompt assessment for secondary hemophagocytic syndrome.

ddx.vs: HLH-related phagocytes lack hemozoin pigment and parasites, and HLH is defined by clinical criteria such as ferritin and soluble CD25.
Babesia forms intraerythrocytic rings and tetrads without producing hemozoin pigment.
Precipitate is extracellular, lies in a different focal plane and is not confined to phagocyte cytoplasm.
These organisms appear as small oval yeasts or amastigotes with a nucleus (and kinetoplast for Leishmania) rather than refractile brown-black pigment.

3669.recognize_zh: 一顆大型巨噬細胞的細胞質內含大量大小不一的藍黑色、藍綠色吞噬碎片與數顆小型深染核碎片，自身核位於中央，周圍是顆粒球系細胞，這就是含碎片的組織球（debris-laden histiocyte）。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Numerous phagocytosed inclusions of varying size, blue-black to blue-green (likely hemosiderin and nuclear debris)
Engulfed small dense round nuclear fragments
Central oval-reniform nucleus with fine chromatin
Background maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils)
3669.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large histiocyte with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing numerous heterogeneous blue-black and blue-green inclusions consistent with phagocytosed cellular debris and pigment, along with several small pyknotic nuclear fragments. The histiocytic nucleus is oval with fine chromatin. The background contains maturing granulocytic cells. Findings are consistent with a debris-laden histiocyte, a nonspecific marker of increased cell turnover (e.g., after chemotherapy, ineffective hematopoiesis or high-grade neoplasm); Prussian blue staining can confirm the iron-containing component.

ddx.vs: Sea-blue histiocytes contain uniform blue-green ceroid granules rather than heterogeneous coarse debris and nuclear fragments.
Hemophagocytes contain intact red cells or nucleated cells rather than degraded pigment and apoptotic fragments.
Melanin is black-brown, Prussian blue negative and associated with atypical SOX10-positive tumor cells.
Mast cells have uniform, densely packed purple-black granules and no engulfed nuclear debris.

1365.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中淋巴球數量大增，多為中小型、細胞質淡藍、染色質成塊的成熟樣淋巴球，並夾雜較大的細胞；整個視野幾乎找不到血小板，符合 CLL 合併血小板低下。
features: Marked lymphocytosis dominating the field
Small to medium-sized lymphocytes with round nuclei and clumped chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Scant to moderate pale blue cytoplasm; a subset of larger cells with more abundant cytoplasm
Platelets markedly decreased to virtually absent
Occasional small dense round nuclei, possibly nucleated red cells
Erythrocytes normochromic without significant fragmentation
1365.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked lymphocytosis composed predominantly of small to medium-sized mature-appearing lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and scant pale cytoplasm, admixed with a subset of larger lymphoid cells with more abundant cytoplasm. Platelets are virtually absent across the field, and red cells show no schistocytes. Occasional small dense nuclei may represent nucleated red cells. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with thrombocytopenia, which may reflect marrow infiltration or immune thrombocytopenia; flow cytometry and marrow evaluation would clarify.

ddx.vs: MCL cells often have irregular nuclear contours and are CD5+ CD23- cyclin D1/SOX11+, while CLL is CD5+ CD23+ with dim surface immunoglobulin.
Prolymphocytes are larger with a single prominent central nucleolus, and a prolymphocyte proportion above 55% changes the category.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm hugging red cells and are polyclonal by flow cytometry.
Would show platelet clumps at the feathered edge rather than true absence of platelets.

2773.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片右半部被許多深藍紫色的小圓形細胞巢狀或分葉狀團塊取代，團塊之間有出血與纖維血管分隔；左半部則是淡粉紅色的疏鬆纖維性間質，無正常造血，符合轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Low-power core biopsy with marrow largely replaced by metastatic tumor
Right half: lobulated nests of densely packed small blue cells separated by thin fibrovascular septa and hemorrhage
Left half: pale eosinophilic loose fibrillary to fibrotic stroma with scattered cells
No recognizable normal trilineage hematopoiesis or fat
Intervening bony trabeculae without significant change
2773.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy shows near-total replacement of the marrow. On the right, the intertrabecular spaces contain lobulated nests of densely packed small blue cells separated by delicate fibrovascular septa and hemorrhage. On the left, the marrow is replaced by pale eosinophilic, loosely fibrillary to fibrotic stroma containing scattered cells. Normal hematopoiesis and fat are not identified. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by metastatic small round blue cell tumor, compatible with metastatic neuroblastoma.

ddx.vs: Ewing sarcoma shows sheets of uniform cells without neuropil or nesting septa and is CD99/NKX2.2 positive with EWSR1 rearrangement.
Alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma also forms nests separated by septa but shows discohesion with myogenin and desmin positivity.
ALL infiltrates diffusely in sheets without nesting or fibrovascular septa and is TdT positive.
Small cell carcinoma occurs in adults, shows crush artifact and nuclear molding, and is keratin and TTF-1 positive.

2581.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆圓形細胞，細胞質塞滿大小一致、深紫黑色的嗜鹼性顆粒，顆粒密到遮住部分細胞核，核圓形且位於中央，是正常組織肥大細胞（mast cell）的樣子。
features: Round to oval cell larger than surrounding nuclei
Cytoplasm packed with densely crowded, uniform, dark purple-black metachromatic granules
Central round nucleus partially obscured by granules
Cell outline smooth and round, not spindled
Background of stromal and lymphoid nuclei, red cells and a fibrillary background
2581.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a single round cell with abundant cytoplasm that is densely packed with uniform, dark purple-black granules that partially obscure a centrally located round nucleus. The cell has a smooth, round contour without spindling or hypogranularity. Surrounding cells include stromal and lymphoid nuclei. The morphology is that of a normal tissue mast cell; isolated round, well-granulated mast cells are not by themselves indicative of systemic mastocytosis.

ddx.vs: Basophils are smaller with a segmented nucleus and fewer, larger, coarser granules that overlie rather than fill the cytoplasm evenly.
Neoplastic mast cells are spindled, hypogranular or with bilobed nuclei and form aggregates, and they are CD25/CD2 positive, whereas this cell is round and fully granulated.
Promyelocytes have azurophilic red-purple granules, a visible nucleolus and a perinuclear hof, without granules obscuring the nucleus.
Hemosiderin appears as coarse, irregular blue-black to golden clumps of varying size in a larger macrophage, not uniform fine granules.

exam.answer_en: Normal tissue mast cell — round cell with central round nucleus obscured by densely packed uniform metachromatic granules
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著這顆顆粒塞滿的細胞問「mast cell 還是 basophil？」；mast cell 較大、核圓位於中央、顆粒細小均勻；basophil 較小、核分葉、顆粒粗大稀疏且覆蓋在核上。
Mast cell 標記：tryptase、CD117（KIT）陽性，toluidine blue 呈 metachromasia；腫瘤性 mast cell 異常表現 CD25、CD2 或 CD30。
Systemic mastocytosis 關鍵分子為 KIT D816V；serum tryptase 持續 >20 ng/mL 是 minor criterion 之一。
WHO 的 major criterion 看的是切片中多發、緊密的 mast cell 聚集（每簇 ≥15 顆），不是抹片上單顆圓形、顆粒飽滿的 mast cell。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 basophil：basophil 核分葉、顆粒較少較粗且不均；另勿把單顆正常 mast cell 當 mastocytosis，腫瘤性者為 spindle、hypogranular 並成簇。

quiz.q: 圖中這顆顆粒塞滿的細胞是什麼？腫瘤性時常異常表現哪個 IHC 標記？
quiz.a: Mast cell（tissue mast cell）；CD25（亦可 CD2、CD30）

1237.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片見到細胞極度密集、大小相近的單一形態細胞群均勻鋪滿整個視野，看不到正常造血的多樣性；此放大倍率只能提示白血病性浸潤，無法評估分化程度或 Auer rod，需高倍確認。
features: Low-power aspirate smear with a markedly hypercellular, monotonous cell population
Uniform small to medium round cells densely packed across the field
Loss of the normal mixed hematopoietic pattern
Thick smear areas at the upper and lower edges
Cytologic detail (chromatin, nucleoli, granules, Auer rods) not assessable at this magnification
1237.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low magnification shows a markedly hypercellular preparation composed of a densely packed, relatively monotonous population of round cells, with loss of the normal heterogeneous hematopoietic appearance. Thick areas are present at the edges of the smear. Cytologic detail, including chromatin pattern, granules, Auer rods and the degree of granulocytic maturation, cannot be evaluated at this power. The findings are suggestive of marrow replacement by an acute leukemia and are compatible with the stated diagnosis of AML with maturation, which requires high-power morphology, blast enumeration and immunophenotyping for confirmation.

ddx.vs: ALL may look identical at low power; high-power morphology showing agranular blasts and immunophenotyping (TdT, CD19 or CD3 versus MPO) are required.
Distinction depends on counting maturing granulocytic cells (at least 10% in AML with maturation), which cannot be done at this power.
Lymphoma cells are typically mature-appearing with clumped chromatin and a B- or T-cell immunophenotype, requiring high power and flow cytometry.
Reactive hyperplasia retains a heterogeneous mixture of erythroid, myeloid and megakaryocytic elements, unlike this monotonous population.

1173.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中，大多數細胞是具粉紫色顆粒的骨髓球、後骨髓球與帶狀核嗜中性球，僅見零星核深染圓形的晚期紅血球母細胞，另有嗜酸性前驅細胞，呈現骨髓球/紅血球比（M:E）上升且顆粒球成熟有序。
features: Predominance of maturing neutrophilic precursors: myelocytes, metamyelocytes and bands
Nuclei show progressive indentation with condensed chromatin; cytoplasm pink-lilac with fine secondary granules
Occasional promyelocyte with coarse azurophilic granules; blasts not increased
Scattered eosinophilic precursors with orange-red granules
Few erythroid precursors (small orthochromatic normoblasts with dense round nuclei)
No significant dysplasia (granulation and nuclear segmentation appear normal)
1173.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a predominance of granulocytic precursors with orderly maturation from promyelocytes through myelocytes, metamyelocytes and band forms, with normal granulation. Eosinophilic precursors are present, while erythroid precursors are sparse and represented mainly by a few late normoblasts. Blasts are not increased and no dysgranulopoiesis is identified. Findings are consistent with an increased M:E ratio due to granulocytic hyperplasia with relative erythroid paucity.

ddx.vs: CML shows marked left-shifted granulocytic hyperplasia with basophils and eosinophils and dwarf megakaryocytes, requiring BCR::ABL1 testing to exclude.
MDS shows hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger-Huet neutrophils and dyserythropoiesis, which are not seen here.
G-CSF effect shows a left shift with toxic granulation and cytoplasmic vacuoles and a clinical history of cytokine therapy, while morphology alone may be identical.

1109.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫組織化學中，許多圓形大細胞呈環狀棕色胞膜/胞質周邊染色、內部淡染（被 Russell bodies 撐大），另有少數小細胞整顆深棕色，對應 Mott 細胞與漿細胞。
features: Numerous large, round cells with ring-like peripheral brown staining and pale central cytoplasm
Ring-positive cells distended, consistent with Russell body-filled Mott cells
Scattered smaller plasma cells with intense solid cytoplasmic staining
Background small lymphoid and hematopoietic cells negative with blue nuclei
Faint granular interstitial brown staining; interstitial distribution between fat spaces
1109.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a bone marrow biopsy shows numerous large rounded cells with rim-like peripheral staining and pale, distended centers, along with scattered smaller cells showing strong solid cytoplasmic staining, distributed interstitially between fat spaces. The ring pattern reflects immunoreactivity around cytoplasm distended by Russell bodies, identifying these cells as Mott cells, while the solid positive cells represent ordinary plasma cells. The antibody is not specified; the pattern is compatible with a plasma cell marker such as CD138 or a light chain. Kappa and lambda studies are needed to assess clonality in the setting of marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Adipocytes or empty spaces mimicking membranous staining
ddx.vs: Small fat cells lack a nucleus and cytoplasm and show no true brown membrane signal, unlike positive Mott cells.
Myeloma shows sheets or large aggregates of monotypic CD138+ plasma cells rather than scattered Mott cells with a lymphoid background.
Histiocytes are CD68/CD163 positive and plasma cell marker negative, although crystal-storing cells may contain light chain.

1109.stain: IHC (antibody not specified; likely CD138 or light chain)

4245.recognize_zh: 脂肪細胞空泡之間夾著造血細胞島，並有一顆大型分葉核的巨核細胞（左中）；免疫染色為棕色，連紅血球輪廓也呈棕色，箭頭指向成群深棕色的細胞，呈現成熟脂肪與三系造血並存的骨髓脂肪瘤。
features: Mature adipocytes forming large empty vacuoles with intervening islands of hematopoietic cells
Mixed hematopoietic population with small round nuclei, including clusters of strongly brown-positive cells (arrow)
Megakaryocyte with large lobulated nucleus at left-center
Brown chromogen also outlines red cells, suggesting an erythroid-associated antigen; exact antibody not specified
Loosely cohesive hemorrhagic material at left
4245.describe_en: Tissue section with immunohistochemical staining (brown chromogen, antibody not specified) shows mature adipose tissue with interspersed islands of hematopoietic elements, including a megakaryocyte and clusters of small hematopoietic cells showing strong staining (arrow). Red cell membranes are also stained, raising the possibility of an erythroid marker such as glycophorin, but this cannot be determined from the image. There is no atypical infiltrate. Findings are consistent with trilineage hematopoiesis within fat, as seen in adrenal myelolipoma, in the appropriate anatomic context.

ddx.vs: Extramedullary hematopoiesis occurs in a setting of marrow failure or hemolysis and involves organ parenchyma without forming a well-circumscribed mass of mature fat.
Liposarcoma shows atypical hyperchromatic stromal cells and lipoblasts with MDM2 amplification rather than benign hematopoietic elements.
Normal marrow contains bony trabeculae, whereas myelolipoma is an adrenal mass lacking bone; the distinction depends on the anatomic site.

4053.recognize_zh: 低倍下骨小樑旁的骨髓中有一個境界清楚的淡染結節，中央是深染的淋巴球聚集，外圍包著淡嗜酸性的梭形細胞與纖維化，與旁邊正常造血骨髓對比明顯，這是系統性肥大細胞增生症的典型病灶。
features: Discrete, pale, fibrotic nodule near a bony trabecula at low power
Central dark aggregate of small lymphocytes
Peripheral rim of spindled cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Sharp contrast with adjacent normocellular trilineage marrow and fat
No sheets of blasts or granulomas
4053.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow biopsy shows a well-circumscribed pale nodule near a bony trabecula, in contrast to the adjacent cellular trilineage hematopoietic marrow. The nodule contains a central aggregate of small lymphocytes surrounded by spindled cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm in a fibrotic stroma. No granulomas or blast sheets are seen. Findings are consistent with a mast cell lesion of systemic mastocytosis; tryptase, CD117 and CD25 immunostains and KIT D816V testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive aggregates lack the peripheral fibrotic rim of spindled tryptase-positive mast cells.
Granulomas are composed of epithelioid histiocytes with multinucleated giant cells and are tryptase-negative.

ddx.dx: Hodgkin lymphoma or T-cell lymphoma in marrow
ddx.vs: Lymphoma lesions contain atypical large cells (Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells or atypical T cells) in a polymorphous infiltrate rather than bland spindled mast cells.

exam.answer_en: Systemic mastocytosis, BM biopsy — well-circumscribed paratrabecular fibrotic nodule with central lymphoid aggregate and rim of spindled mast cells
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍看到骨小樑旁淡染結節，問鑑別與下一步；答 SM 病灶，下一步 tryptase、CD117、CD25 IHC 與 KIT D816V 檢測。
典型的「target/bull's eye」結構：中央淋巴球、外圍肥大細胞與纖維化、再外圍可有嗜酸性球。
KIT D816V 檢測宜用高敏感度方法（如 ddPCR 或 ASO-qPCR），骨髓檢體陽性率高於周邊血。
部分 SM 合併另一髓系腫瘤（SM-AHN，如 CMML），因此周圍骨髓也要仔細評估。
exam.pitfall_zh: 低倍下易誤判為良性淋巴聚集、肉芽腫或 Hodgkin lymphoma 結節：SM 病灶有外圍梭形細胞與纖維化，IHC tryptase/CD117 陽性且無肉芽腫組織球。

quiz.q: 圖中骨小樑旁結節最可能的診斷為何？確認用的分子檢查是？

4117.recognize_zh: 成群體積增大的紅血球前驅細胞，細胞核染色質呈細緻開放、篩網狀（sieve-like），但細胞質已深藍甚至帶粉紅，呈現核質發育不同步（nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony），是巨母紅血球（megaloblast）的特徵。
features: Clusters of enlarged erythroid precursors (megaloblasts) with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Finely stippled, open sieve-like chromatin that is immature relative to cytoplasmic maturation
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony: more hemoglobinized polychromatophilic cells retain open chromatin
Large granulocytic precursors with horseshoe/band-shaped nuclei suggestive of giant metamyelocytes/bands
Occasional cell with irregular nuclear outline or fragmented nucleus; background with scattered macrophage debris
4117.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of markedly enlarged erythroid precursors with abundant basophilic to polychromatophilic cytoplasm and finely dispersed, sieve-like nuclear chromatin. The chromatin appears immature relative to the degree of cytoplasmic hemoglobinization, indicating nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony. Enlarged granulocytic precursors with horseshoe-shaped nuclei suggest giant metamyelocytes and bands. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic erythropoiesis, as seen in megaloblastic anemia due to vitamin B12 or folate deficiency.

ddx.vs: Shows at least 30% proerythroblasts of the erythroid lineage with often vacuolated cytoplasm and TP53 mutation, and does not correct with vitamin replacement.
Megaloblastoid features coexist with ring sideroblasts, dysmegakaryopoiesis or clonal cytogenetics despite normal B12/folate levels.
Morphology is indistinguishable and is separated by medication history and normal vitamin levels.
Show giant proerythroblasts with glassy intranuclear viral inclusions and absent maturing erythroid cells rather than a full megaloblastic maturation spectrum.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic anemia marrow — megaloblastic erythroid precursors with sieve-like chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, giant metamyelocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：指著大型紅血球前驅細胞問「核質有何矛盾？」答 nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony（胞質已血紅素化、核仍幼稚）；也常指 giant metamyelocytes/bands。
機轉：B12 或 folate 缺乏導致 DNA 合成障礙，RNA/蛋白合成正常，故核成熟落後於胞質。
無效造血導致骨髓內溶血：LDH 可明顯升高、indirect bilirubin 上升、網狀紅血球低。
補充 B12/folate 後骨髓形態可於數天內改善，因此補充後才做骨髓可能看不到典型變化。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最危險的誤判是 pure erythroid leukemia 或 MDS：megaloblastic 變化隨維生素補充可逆，須先檢測 B12/folate；幼紅細胞極多加芽細胞樣形態不要急著下白血病診斷。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球前驅細胞核幼稚但胞質已成熟的現象稱為什麼？

3989.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆大型嗜中性球的細胞核分成約 7 葉，周圍紅血球大小不一並可見大型卵圓紅血球（macro-ovalocyte）；嗜中性球出現 6 葉以上（或 5 葉以上達 5%）即為分葉過多，是維生素 B12 或葉酸缺乏之巨母紅血球性貧血（megaloblastic anemia）的經典線索。
features: Enlarged neutrophil with about seven discrete nuclear lobes (hypersegmentation)
Neutrophil cytoplasm with normal fine pink granulation
Anisocytosis with scattered oval macrocytes among normocytic red cells
A monocyte (lower left) and a lymphocyte with clumped chromatin (upper right)
Small cell with dense round nucleus at lower center; occasional platelet clump
3989.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large neutrophil with approximately seven nuclear lobes connected by thin chromatin strands, consistent with hypersegmentation. Red cells show anisocytosis with scattered oval macrocytes. A monocyte and a lymphocyte are also present. Findings are consistent with hypersegmented neutrophils and macro-ovalocytes, suggestive of megaloblastic anemia due to vitamin B12 or folate deficiency; serum B12, folate, methylmalonic acid and homocysteine levels should be correlated.

ddx.vs: The hereditary form is a benign autosomal dominant finding without macro-ovalocytes, cytopenias or abnormal vitamin levels.
Antimetabolite drugs produce identical megaloblastic changes, distinguished only by medication history with normal B12 and folate.
MDS more often shows hypolobated pseudo-Pelger-Huet neutrophils and hypogranulation rather than hypersegmentation, with normal vitamin levels.
These may cause occasional hypersegmented neutrophils but have microcytic or normocytic red cells rather than macro-ovalocytes.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic anemia — hypersegmented neutrophil (about 7 lobes) with macro-ovalocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：數葉數。定義為任一顆 ≥6 葉，或 ≥5 葉者佔 ≥5% neutrophils；合併 macro-ovalocyte 最指向 B12/folate 缺乏。
鑑別 B12 與 folate：methylmalonic acid 在 B12 缺乏上升、folate 缺乏正常；homocysteine 兩者都上升。
B12 缺乏只補 folate 會改善貧血但神經學病變（subacute combined degeneration）持續惡化，考試常考。
原因：pernicious anemia（anti-intrinsic factor／anti-parietal cell 抗體）、胃切除、metformin、nitrous oxide；藥物如 methotrexate、hydroxyurea 亦可造成相同形態。
骨髓無效造血會使 LDH 與間接膽紅素上升、haptoglobin 下降，可類似溶血或 TMA；骨髓形態可被誤判為 MDS 或急性紅白血病。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把兩個重疊的 neutrophil 或 hereditary hypersegmentation 當作 megaloblastic 變化；確認核葉相連於同一細胞，並搭配 macro-ovalocyte、MCV 與維生素濃度。

quiz.q: 圖中嗜中性球分葉過多，若 methylmalonic acid 與 homocysteine 都上升，最可能缺乏哪一種維生素？

3925.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有大量散落的小型卵圓形微生物，每一個都有一顆紫色的核和旁邊一條短棒狀的動基體（kinetoplast），成群出現在破裂巨噬細胞的周圍，這就是利什曼原蟲的無鞭毛體（LD bodies）。
features: Innumerable small oval amastigotes (about 2–4 µm) lying extracellularly after macrophage rupture
Each organism with a round purple nucleus and a separate small rod-shaped kinetoplast perpendicular to it
Pale-blue cytoplasm around each amastigote; organisms aggregated around a disrupted macrophage
Background marrow cells including a large nucleus of the host histiocyte, myelocyte and plasma cell
3925.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of numerous small oval organisms, largely extracellular around a ruptured macrophage. Each organism has a pale cytoplasm, a round nucleus and a distinct rod-shaped kinetoplast, the double-dot configuration characteristic of Leishmania amastigotes (Leishman-Donovan bodies). Residual hematopoietic cells are present in the background. Findings are consistent with visceral leishmaniasis (kala-azar) involving the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts have a single crescent nucleus with a clear halo and no kinetoplast, and they are GMS/PAS-positive.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped with a central nucleus and lack a kinetoplast.
T. cruzi amastigotes also have a kinetoplast but are usually in cardiac/smooth muscle rather than marrow macrophages and are accompanied by blood trypomastigotes; epidemiology and PCR separate them.
Platelets lack the organized nucleus plus kinetoplast structure and do not show a regular oval outline.

exam.answer_en: Visceral leishmaniasis — numerous Leishman-Donovan bodies (amastigotes with nucleus and rod-shaped kinetoplast) in bone marrow aspirate
pearls_zh: 考法：指一顆小卵圓體問「兩個點」各是什麼：較大圓形的是 nucleus，旁邊短棒狀的是 kinetoplast（粒線體 DNA），這個 double-dot 是 LD body 的診斷依據。
臨床：kala-azar 三大表現為發燒、巨脾、全血球低下，常伴 polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia；台灣病例多為境外移入（地中海、南亞、東非、南美）。
檢體敏感度：脾臟抽吸最高但出血風險大，骨髓抽吸較安全為常用；血清 rK39 rapid test 可輔助，PCR 可確認。
治療首選 liposomal amphotericin B；HIV 合併感染易復發。
Visceral leishmaniasis 是繼發性 HLH 的重要誘因，出現 HLH 樣表現時需主動在骨髓尋找 LD body。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 Histoplasma 混淆；Histoplasma 無 kinetoplast、有透明暈且 GMS 陽性，LD body 有核＋棒狀 kinetoplast、GMS 陰性。破裂巨噬細胞外的蟲體也易被當成血小板。

quiz.q: 圖中每個小卵圓體旁短棒狀的深染結構叫什麼？它本質上是什麼？

3861.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中的淋巴瘤細胞比旁邊的正色母紅血球大好幾倍，核呈分葉、摺疊或凹陷，染色質細緻並見核仁，胞質淡藍到嗜鹼性且帶小空泡，符合 DLBCL 侵犯骨髓。
features: Very large atypical lymphoid cells, several times the size of adjacent normoblasts
Markedly irregular nuclei: folded, lobulated and indented contours
Open, finely granular chromatin with small indistinct nucleoli
Moderate pale-blue to basophilic cytoplasm with fine vacuoles
Background orthochromatic normoblasts and a small dark lymphocyte-like cell
3861.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows large atypical lymphoid cells with markedly irregular, folded and lobulated nuclei, open finely granular chromatin with small nucleoli, and moderate amounts of pale-blue to basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm. Adjacent orthochromatic normoblasts highlight their large size. No granules or Auer rods are identified. Findings are consistent with involvement by diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts and promonocytes also have folded nuclei and vacuolated cytoplasm but show fine azurophilic granules, nonspecific esterase positivity and CD14/CD64 expression.
ATLL cells show polylobated 'flower' nuclei with condensed chromatin, CD4+/CD25+ T-cell phenotype and HTLV-1 positivity.
Megakaryocytic cells show cytoplasmic blebs or granular cytoplasm and are CD41/CD61-positive.

3797.recognize_zh: 淋巴結副皮質區被淡染、細胞質豐富的組織球與樹突細胞擴張成淡色區，與左上方深藍色的淋巴濾泡形成明暗對比，符合皮膚病性淋巴結病（dermatopathic lymphadenopathy）。
features: Dense dark lymphoid follicle/mantle area in the upper left
Adjacent paracortex expanded by a pale-staining zone of cells with abundant pale cytoplasm (histiocytes, interdigitating and Langerhans cells)
Pale zone contains admixed small lymphocytes and small vessels
Sharp light-dark contrast between follicle and expanded paracortex
Melanin pigment not clearly identified at this magnification
3797.describe_en: Section of lymph node shows a dense lymphoid follicle adjacent to a markedly expanded paracortex composed of pale-staining histiocytic and dendritic cells with abundant cytoplasm, admixed with small lymphocytes. The architecture is preserved and there is no destructive atypical infiltrate at this power; melanin pigment is not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with dermatopathic lymphadenopathy; evaluation for melanin/hemosiderin and, in patients with erythroderma, exclusion of mycosis fungoides involvement is recommended.

ddx.dx: Lymph node involvement by mycosis fungoides
ddx.vs: MF involvement shows clusters or sheets of atypical cerebriform lymphocytes in the paracortex and clonal TCR rearrangement.
LCH infiltrates sinuses with sheets of grooved CD1a+ cells and eosinophilic abscesses, often effacing architecture.
Toxoplasmosis shows small clusters of epithelioid histiocytes encroaching on reactive germinal centers and monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia.

3733.recognize_zh: 左側嗜中性球外緣被一圈小血小板黏附包圍，中間那顆嗜中性球邊緣也附著數顆血小板，而右側的嗜中性球則沒有；這種血小板圍繞嗜中性球的現象就是血小板衛星現象（platelet satellitism），常為 EDTA 引起的體外假象，可造成假性血小板減少。
features: Platelets adherent in a rosette around the circumference of a segmented neutrophil
A second neutrophil with a few platelets attached to part of its margin
Adherent platelets are small, normally granulated, and not phagocytosed
Remaining neutrophils and red cells unremarkable
Scattered free platelets in the background
3733.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows segmented neutrophils rimmed by adherent platelets, forming a rosette around one neutrophil and a partial rim around a second. The platelets are morphologically normal and remain on the cell surface rather than within the cytoplasm. A third neutrophil lacks platelet adherence, and red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism, an in vitro EDTA-dependent phenomenon that can cause spurious thrombocytopenia; a citrate-anticoagulated count is recommended.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumping forms free-floating platelet aggregates, whereas satellitism shows platelets encircling individual neutrophils.
Phagocytosed platelets lie within cytoplasmic vacuoles inside the neutrophil rather than attached to the outer membrane.
Toxic granules are intracytoplasmic dark granules, not discrete platelets arranged around the cell border.

exam.answer_en: Platelet satellitism — platelets rosetting around neutrophils, an EDTA-dependent in vitro artifact causing pseudothrombocytopenia
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指被血小板圍成一圈的嗜中性球問「這是什麼、對 CBC 有什麼影響」，答 platelet satellitism，自動計數器會假性血小板低下。
機轉：EDTA 暴露出 GPIIb/IIIa 抗原，病人的自體抗體使血小板與嗜中性球 FcγRIII（CD16）橋接；在體外發生，無臨床出血意義。
處理：看到不明原因血小板低下先看抹片；改用 citrate（或 heparin）抗凝管重抽並立即計數，citrate 需校正稀釋倍數。
臨床意義：辨認假性血小板低下可避免不必要的骨髓檢查、輸血或 ITP 治療；衛星現象常與 EDTA 誘發血小板聚集同時存在。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 EDTA 引起的血小板聚集或嗜中性球吞噬血小板；聚集是游離血小板團塊，吞噬的血小板位於細胞質空泡內，衛星現象則是血小板貼在細胞膜外圍成一圈。

quiz.q: 圖中現象會讓 CBC 出現什麼假性異常？應改用什麼抗凝管重驗？
