quiz.a: 假性血小板低下；改用 sodium citrate 管

3541.recognize_zh: 移植後再生中的骨髓，可見許多細胞質深藍、核圓、染色質細緻的早期紅血球前驅細胞（pronormoblasts/basophilic normoblasts）群聚，混有成熟嗜中性球與嗜酸性球，顯示造血正在恢復的左移現象，不應誤判為芽細胞增加。
features: Clusters of round cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and round nuclei with fine to slightly granular chromatin, consistent with early erythroid precursors
Several small to medium cells with condensed chromatin (later normoblasts or lymphocytes)
Occasional segmented neutrophil and eosinophil
Background with abundant granular debris from ruptured cells
No Auer rods or dysplastic granulocytes seen in this field
3541.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear from a post-transplant patient shows a cluster of round cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, round nuclei, and fine to slightly granular chromatin, most consistent with early erythroid precursors at various stages, along with smaller condensed normoblasts or lymphocytes. Occasional segmented neutrophils and an eosinophil are present. The findings represent regenerating, left-shifted hematopoiesis. Because early erythroid precursors can mimic blasts, correlation with a full differential count and flow cytometry for residual or relapsed disease is recommended.

ddx.vs: Relapse shows a monotonous blast population with agranular grey-blue cytoplasm and nucleoli and aberrant flow phenotype, rather than a maturing spectrum of erythroid cells.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of highly atypical proerythroblasts (≥30%) with vacuoles, not a mixed, orderly maturing marrow.
Hematogones have scant, barely visible cytoplasm and homogeneous chromatin, unlike the rim of deep blue cytoplasm in erythroid precursors.

3477.recognize_zh: 高倍下畫面中央橫走一條淡藍色纖維狀帶，帶上排列著細長卵圓形、染色質均勻的內皮細胞核，兩旁擁擠著成熟中的骨髓細胞，這是骨髓抹片中微血管的高倍外觀。
features: Horizontal band of pale blue fibrillar/cytoplasmic material crossing the field
Elongated oval to spindle nuclei with smooth fine chromatin aligned along the band (endothelial cells)
No nucleoli or significant atypia in the aligned nuclei
Crowded surrounding myeloid precursors and erythroid cells with normal morphology
Thick area of smear with overlapping cells
3477.describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow aspirate particle shows a band of pale blue fibrillar material running across the field, along which elongated oval and spindle-shaped nuclei with smooth, evenly distributed chromatin are aligned. These nuclei lack nucleoli and atypia, and represent endothelial cells of a capillary. The surrounding hematopoietic cells, including myeloid and erythroid precursors, show normal morphology. Findings represent a normal bone marrow capillary.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are larger, cohesive and polygonal with coarse chromatin, prominent nucleoli and nuclear molding, unlike bland aligned endothelial nuclei.
Mast cells contain dense metachromatic granules and often oval central nuclei, while endothelial cells here are agranular.
A disrupted megakaryocyte shows a large lobulated single nucleus and granular pink cytoplasm, not multiple separate spindle nuclei.

3413.recognize_zh: 中央一顆分葉核中性球的細胞質內有數個小卵圓形酵母體，每個外圍帶透明暈（halo）、內含深紫色新月形染色質，符合莢膜組織漿菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）在白血球內的包涵體。
features: Segmented neutrophil containing at least two to three small oval intracytoplasmic yeast forms
Yeasts about 2–4 µm with a clear surrounding halo (unstained cell wall) and a crescentic purple chromatin cap
Neutrophil cytoplasm finely granular; adjacent mononuclear cell without visible organisms
Second neutrophil at upper left without obvious inclusions
Background red cells in rouleaux-like chains with scattered small platelets
3413.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells forming rouleaux-like chains and scattered platelets. A segmented neutrophil contains several small oval intracytoplasmic yeast forms, each with a clear halo and a crescent of purple-staining chromatin; an adjacent mononuclear cell and a second neutrophil lack definite inclusions. Findings are consistent with intraleukocytic Histoplasma capsulatum, indicating disseminated histoplasmosis; confirmation by fungal culture, urine/serum antigen testing or GMS/PAS stains is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes contain both a nucleus and a rod-shaped kinetoplast and lack the clear halo, typically within macrophages.
Candida forms budding yeasts/pseudohyphae and Cryptococcus has variable size with a thick mucicarminophilic capsule, unlike small uniform halo-surrounded Histoplasma.
Talaromyces yeasts are elongated and divide by a central transverse septum rather than budding.
Ingested platelets are granular without a chromatin crescent, and Döhle bodies are pale blue cytoplasmic patches without a halo.

exam.answer_en: Disseminated histoplasmosis — intracytoplasmic Histoplasma capsulatum yeasts with clear halos in a peripheral blood neutrophil
pearls_zh: 考法：指中性球內帶透明暈的小卵圓形包涵體，問是寄生蟲、細菌還是黴菌，並說出 Histoplasma 的形態特徵。
周邊血白血球內看到菌體代表高菌量的播散性感染，常見於 HIV（CD4 低）、器官移植或免疫抑制病人，屬需立即治療的急症。
確認：urine/serum Histoplasma antigen、血液與骨髓培養、GMS 或 PAS 染色；重症首選 liposomal amphotericin B，之後以 itraconazole 維持。
播散性組織漿菌病可合併 HLH，出現發燒、血球低下與高 ferritin。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Leishmania amastigotes 或 Talaromyces marneffei：Leishmania 有棒狀 kinetoplast 且無透明暈，Talaromyces 以中央橫隔分裂；Histoplasma 為帶暈的出芽酵母。

quiz.q: 中性球內帶透明暈的小卵圓形菌體最可能是什麼？哪一項非侵入性檢查可快速輔助確認？

3349.recognize_zh: 低中倍率免疫染色：左側成片的大型腫瘤細胞呈細胞膜陽性並帶有核旁點狀（Golgi）染色，右側殘存的小淋巴球區域為陰性；這種在大細胞上的膜加點狀陽性型態最符合 CD30，是 ALCL 淋巴結侵犯的表現。
features: Sheets of large atypical cells occupying most of the field, with a residual small lymphocyte area at upper right
Membranous staining of large cells with paranuclear dot-like Golgi accentuation
Occasional very large, strongly positive hallmark-like cells
Weaker granular cytoplasmic positivity in some tumor cells
Small lymphocytes and stromal cells negative
3349.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a lymph node at low to intermediate power shows sheets of large atypical cells that largely efface the architecture, with a residual area of negative small lymphocytes at the edge. The large cells display membranous positivity with paranuclear Golgi-zone dots and variable granular cytoplasmic staining, including occasional very large strongly positive cells. The antibody is not labeled, but the pattern is characteristic of CD30. Findings are consistent with nodal involvement by anaplastic large cell lymphoma; correlation with ALK, EMA and T-cell markers is required.

ddx.vs: CD30+ Hodgkin cells are scattered singly within an inflammatory background rather than forming cohesive sheets, and they are CD15+/PAX5 weak+.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma in lymph node sinuses
ddx.vs: Carcinoma also forms cohesive sheets but is cytokeratin-positive and CD30/CD45-negative.

ddx.dx: Primary mediastinal or CD30+ diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These express B-cell markers and generally show weaker, more heterogeneous CD30 staining.

3285.recognize_zh: 巨大的巨核細胞（megakaryocyte）有分葉核與顆粒狀細胞質，細胞質內可見數個完整的小型有核細胞穿行其中（非被消化），即 emperipolesis；本圖色調偏藍綠為影像色偏。
features: Very large megakaryocyte with abundant finely granular cytoplasm
Large, multilobated, hyperchromatic nucleus
Several intact small nucleated cells (hematopoietic cells) located within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm
Engulfed cells retain normal nuclear detail without degeneration or phagocytic vacuoles
Background of cellular marrow with granulocytic and erythroid precursors; image shows a blue-green color cast
3285.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with a multilobated nucleus and abundant granular cytoplasm. Several intact small nucleated hematopoietic cells are seen within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm, without evidence of degradation or phagocytic vacuoles. The surrounding marrow is cellular with maturing hematopoietic elements. The image has an artifactual blue-green color balance. Findings represent megakaryocytic emperipolesis, a nonspecific phenomenon that may be increased in myeloproliferative neoplasms, especially primary myelofibrosis, and in reactive states.

ddx.vs: Hemophagocytosis occurs in histiocytes with a bland oval nucleus and the ingested cells are degraded within phagocytic vacuoles, whereas emperipolesis involves intact cells within a megakaryocyte with a lobated nucleus.
Osteoclasts have multiple separate, uniform round nuclei rather than one large lobulated nucleus and do not contain intact passenger cells.
In Rosai-Dorfman the host cell is an S100+ histiocyte with vesicular nucleus in lymph node sinuses, not a marrow megakaryocyte.
Superimposed cells lie in a different focal plane and are not enclosed by megakaryocyte cytoplasm on fine focusing.

exam.answer_en: Megakaryocytic emperipolesis — several intact nucleated cells within a large megakaryocyte's cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：同一主題常出現不同色調的照片，本圖偏藍綠為影像色偏，不要被顏色誤導；考點仍是辨認巨核細胞內完整的穿行細胞。
Emperipolesis vs phagocytosis：前者宿主細胞與被包入細胞皆存活，被包入細胞可離開；後者被吞細胞在 phagolysosome 內降解。
臨床意義：MPN（特別是 primary myelofibrosis）巨核細胞 emperipolesis 常增加；但單獨出現不足以診斷，需配合巨核細胞形態、reticulin 纖維化與 JAK2/CALR/MPL。
與 osteoclast 區分：osteoclast 為多顆分開的圓核、貼骨小樑表面；巨核細胞是單一大型分葉核。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為細胞疊在巨核細胞表面；真正 emperipolesis 的細胞位於同一焦平面、周圍有透亮胞質腔隙。

quiz.q: 此巨核細胞內的小型有核細胞代表什麼現象？它與組織球噬血現象最主要的差別？
quiz.a: Emperipolesis；被包入細胞完整未被消化，宿主為分葉核巨核細胞

3157.recognize_zh: 骨髓顆粒高倍下主要是梭形基質細胞、內皮細胞與大小不一的脂肪空泡，造血細胞只零星散在，並有少許金褐色色素，符合治療後的低細胞性骨髓。
features: Marrow particle composed mainly of spindle-shaped stromal and endothelial cells in a pale pink-blue matrix
Numerous variably sized fat vacuoles within the particle
Only scattered residual hematopoietic cells with round nuclei
Occasional golden-brown refractile pigment consistent with hemosiderin
Background of peripheral blood red cells around the particle
3157.describe_en: Higher-power view of a bone marrow aspirate particle shows a stroma-rich fragment composed of spindle-shaped stromal and endothelial cells and numerous fat vacuoles. Hematopoietic precursors are sparse and scattered, and focal golden-brown pigment consistent with hemosiderin is present. No clusters of blasts or tumor cells are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with a hypocellular, stroma-predominant marrow following therapy; correlation with trephine biopsy cellularity is recommended.

ddx.vs: Metastatic tumor forms cohesive groups of large atypical cells with high N:C ratio, whereas the cells here are bland spindle stromal and endothelial cells.
Aplastic anemia shows a similar fatty stromal particle, so the distinction relies on the history of cytotoxic therapy rather than morphology.
Myelofibrosis usually yields scant or no particles and shows reticulin/collagen fibrosis on biopsy, whereas this particle contains mainly fat and stroma.

2965.recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓切片細胞密度高，骨小樑旁有密集成片、核大淡染的未成熟骨髓系前驅細胞，間有散在嗜酸性球；此倍率只能提示左移的顆粒球生成，無法單獨確診。
features: Hypercellular marrow with reduced fat
Dense band of immature myeloid precursors with oval vesicular nuclei adjacent to a trabecula
Scattered eosinophils with red granules and erythroid islands
Loose edematous areas with hemorrhage
Mature neutrophils difficult to assess at this magnification
2965.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at intermediate power shows a hypercellular marrow with reduced fat. A dense, expanded zone of immature myeloid precursors with oval vesicular nuclei lies adjacent to a bony trabecula, with scattered eosinophils, erythroid islands and edematous hemorrhagic areas elsewhere. The proportion of mature neutrophils cannot be reliably assessed at this magnification. Findings suggest a left-shifted granulopoiesis compatible with severe congenital neutropenia, requiring aspirate differential for confirmation.

ddx.vs: AML shows diffuse effacement by blasts with CD34/CD117 positivity and a blast count of at least 20 percent on aspirate.
Reactive hyperplasia shows orderly maturation with abundant bands and segmented neutrophils.
Tumor forms cohesive nests with desmoplasia and is negative for myeloid markers.

2901.recognize_zh: 高倍 LAP 染色：一群中性球紅色分葉核清楚，細胞質大多空白或只有極少藍點，僅一顆有較多藍色顆粒，屬於 0–1 分為主的低 LAP 分數。
features: Cluster of neutrophils with red-counterstained segmented nuclei
Most cells without or with very sparse blue granules (0 to 1+)
Single cell with more evident blue granules (about 2+)
Unstained red cells; slightly out-of-focus image
2901.describe_en: High-power view of a leukocyte alkaline phosphatase-stained peripheral blood smear shows a group of neutrophils with red-counterstained lobulated nuclei. Most cells have no or only scattered faint blue granules (0 to 1+), with a single cell showing moderate positivity. The predominance of negative to weakly positive neutrophils corresponds to a low LAP score, as expected in chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: These typically show most neutrophils with moderate to strong granules and an elevated score.
Normal blood shows a mixture weighted toward 1+ to 2+ cells rather than a predominance of 0 cells.

2645.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片滿布大小不一的母細胞，核圓或略有凹陷、染色質細緻，細胞質藍色、多數帶小空泡，殘存正常細胞只剩零星小淋巴球，符合復發ALL的母細胞浸潤。
features: Dense, monotonous infiltrate of medium to large blasts with mild size variation
High N:C ratio; round, oval or focally indented nuclei
Finely granular to slightly stippled chromatin with small or inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale-blue cytoplasm, many cells with fine cytoplasmic vacuoles
No granules or Auer rods; only rare residual small lymphocytes and red cells in background
2645.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows near-total replacement by blasts of medium to large size. The blasts have high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to indented nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant pale-blue cytoplasm that frequently contains small vacuoles. Granules and Auer rods are absent, and normal trilineage hematopoiesis is not appreciated in this field. Findings are consistent with relapsed acute lymphoblastic leukemia in the appropriate clinical setting; immunophenotyping is required to confirm lineage and to compare with the diagnostic immunophenotype.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts may contain azurophilic granules or Auer rods and are MPO positive, but agranular cases require flow cytometry to exclude them.
Burkitt cells have intensely basophilic cytoplasm with prominent vacuoles in virtually all cells, a mature B phenotype (sIg+, TdT-), and MYC rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Therapy-related myeloid neoplasm or lineage switch at relapse
ddx.vs: A relapse with a new myeloid or mixed phenotype cannot be recognized by morphology and requires repeat flow cytometry and cytogenetics.

2453.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中大多是中型原始細胞：圓核、染色質細緻、可見小核仁，胞質為淡灰藍色中等量且無顆粒，背景有碎屑，只剩少數中性球與有核紅血球；符合 ALL，T 細胞系需免疫表型確認。
features: Predominance of medium-sized blasts with round to slightly indented nuclei
Fine, evenly dispersed chromatin with one or more small nucleoli
Moderate rim of pale grey-blue agranular cytoplasm
Occasional small dense cells, erythroid precursors and a segmented neutrophil
Background with granular debris and bare nuclei
2453.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a predominance of medium-sized blasts with round to slightly indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and a moderate rim of agranular grey-blue cytoplasm. Residual erythroid precursors and a rare segmented neutrophil are present, and the background contains granular debris. No Auer rods are seen. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; T-lymphoblastic lineage should be confirmed by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Morphologically indistinguishable; defined by CD19/CD79a/CD22 expression without cytoplasmic CD3.
Myeloblasts with moderate cytoplasm can look similar but express MPO, CD13, CD33 or CD117.
MPAL shows a single blast population co-expressing cytoplasmic CD3 and MPO, detectable only by immunophenotyping.

2197.recognize_zh: 淡染背景中一顆組織球樣細胞，核皺縮不規則，泡沫狀細胞質內橫跨一條藍紫色帶狀物；解析度與染色均偏淡，無法明確辨認弓形蟲速殖體（tachyzoite）的新月形與核，只能提示可能為胞內寄生物。
features: Single histiocyte-like cell with irregular, crumpled nucleus
Pale, finely vacuolated (foamy) cytoplasm with ill-defined borders
Band-like basophilic structure overlying the nucleus, possibly intracellular organisms
Individual crescent-shaped tachyzoites with discrete nuclei not resolvable
Faintly stained background with a nearby RBC and a small dark particle
2197.describe_en: Smear (likely marrow or body fluid) shows a single histiocyte-like cell with an irregular, crumpled nucleus and pale foamy cytoplasm. A band-like basophilic structure overlies the nucleus and could represent intracellular organisms; however, the staining is faint and individual crescent-shaped tachyzoites with discrete nuclei cannot be clearly resolved at this resolution. No free extracellular organisms are identified. The image is of limited diagnostic value on its own and is only suggestive of Toxoplasma infection; confirmation by serology, PCR or immunohistochemistry is required.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes are oval with a nucleus and a rod-shaped kinetoplast, while Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescentic and lack a kinetoplast.
Histoplasma yeasts are small oval forms with a clear halo, PAS/GMS positive, unlike Toxoplasma which is GMS negative.

ddx.dx: Phagocytosed debris or overlying platelet clumps
ddx.vs: Debris lacks the uniform crescent shape and single central nucleus of tachyzoites; IHC for Toxoplasma resolves ambiguity.

2069.recognize_zh: 高倍抹片中為大小一致的中型淋巴樣細胞，核圓、染色質細緻，細胞質雖少但細胞間與細胞質內可見大量清晰的圓形空泡（lipid vacuoles），成串排列，是 Burkitt 淋巴瘤/白血病細胞在抹片上最具代表性的特徵。
features: Monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei and finely stippled chromatin
Innumerable sharply defined, round clear cytoplasmic vacuoles clustered along cell borders
Scant basophilic cytoplasm; high N:C ratio
Some nuclei show faint small nucleoli
Tightly packed cells in a touch imprint/aspirate preparation
2069.describe_en: Cytologic preparation at high power shows sheets of monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, finely stippled chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm. Numerous sharply punched-out clear lipid vacuoles are clustered within the cytoplasm along the cell borders. No significant background population is present in this field. Findings are consistent with Burkitt lymphoma/leukemia cells; confirmation by immunophenotype (CD10+, BCL2-, surface light chain) and MYC rearrangement is recommended.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger and more variable in size with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, and vacuolation is usually less uniform.
Lymphoblasts may have occasional vacuoles but are TdT/CD34 positive and lack surface immunoglobulin.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: It can show identical cytology and is separated by BCL2 protein expression and BCL2 rearrangement on FISH.

exam.answer_en: Burkitt lymphoma/leukemia cells — monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells with innumerable sharply punched-out cytoplasmic lipid vacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍抹片（touch imprint 或骨髓抽吸）問「這些空泡加單一中型細胞，第一個要想到什麼？下一步檢查？」答：Burkitt；flow 與 MYC FISH。
Flow：CD19+、CD20+、CD10+、BCL6+、BCL2 陰性、surface light chain restricted、TdT 陰性；骨髓 blasts 雖可 ≥20% 仍屬成熟 B 細胞腫瘤，不稱 B-ALL。
遺傳：MYC 重排（t(8;14) 最常見）；若同時帶 BCL2 重排，應歸為 high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements，而非 Burkitt。
臨床：屬腫瘤急症，治療需住院預防與監測 tumor lysis syndrome（水化、rasburicase 或 allopurinol），並評估 CNS 侵犯。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 B-lymphoblastic leukemia：淋巴母細胞偶有空泡，但細胞質較淡少、TdT/CD34 陽性且無 sIg；Burkitt 為深藍細胞質密集空泡、TdT 陰性。

quiz.q: 此圖細胞做 TdT 與 surface immunoglobulin 染色，預期結果為何？
quiz.a: TdT 陰性；surface Ig 輕鏈限制性陽性

1621.recognize_zh: 油鏡下可見大型細胞，核卵圓、核膜清楚纖細、染色質淡而細、核仁小而居中，其中有雙核相貼的細胞，細胞質淡粉且邊界不清，符合生發中心內的濾泡樹突細胞（FDC），並夾雜中心母細胞與巨噬細胞。
features: Large cells with oval nuclei, thin sharp nuclear membranes, pale finely dispersed chromatin and small central nucleoli
Binucleate cell with two closely apposed nuclei (characteristic of follicular dendritic cells)
Abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders (syncytial appearance)
Admixed cells with vesicular nuclei and peripheral nucleoli (centroblasts)
Scattered small dark nuclear fragments/lymphocytes and a cell with dense pink cytoplasm
1621.describe_en: High-power H&E section shows large cells with oval nuclei, delicate nuclear membranes, pale chromatin and small central nucleoli, including a binucleate form with closely apposed nuclei, set within ill-defined pale eosinophilic cytoplasm. These are admixed with centroblast-like cells and scattered small lymphocytes. The cytologic features are those of follicular dendritic cells within a germinal center; confirmation would require CD21, CD23 or CD35. Findings are consistent with normal germinal center constituents.

ddx.vs: RS cells have large eosinophilic inclusion-like macronucleoli and thick membranes in a mixed inflammatory background, whereas FDC nuclei have small nucleoli and delicate membranes.
FDC sarcoma forms fascicles or whorls of spindle-to-ovoid cells with atypia effacing the tissue, not individual FDCs within a germinal center.
Macrophages have abundant cytoplasm containing phagocytosed apoptotic debris and a single nucleus, whereas FDCs are often binucleate without ingested material.

1429.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片（H&E）細胞量偏高、造血成分混雜；箭頭標示數顆型態異常的前驅細胞（核仁明顯、核周空亮），雙箭頭指一顆小而單葉核的細胞，疑為小型異常巨核細胞，提示多系發育不良的 MDS。
features: Cellular marrow with mixed trilineage hematopoiesis between fat spaces
Single arrows: cells with round nuclei, open chromatin and distinct nucleoli surrounded by clear cytoplasm, suggestive of atypical/immature precursors
Double arrow: small cell with dense, eccentric non-lobated nucleus and eosinophilic cytoplasm, suggestive of a micromegakaryocyte
Scattered erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei and mature granulocytes
No sheets of blasts identified in this field
Limited resolution precludes detailed assessment of individual lineage dysplasia
1429.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section (H&E) shows a cellular marrow with mixed hematopoietic elements between adipocytes. Scattered precursor cells with open chromatin, visible nucleoli and perinuclear clearing are highlighted (single arrows), and a small cell with a dense non-lobated nucleus suggestive of a dysplastic micromegakaryocyte is indicated (double arrow). No sheets or clusters of blasts are evident in this field, although resolution limits evaluation. Findings are suggestive of a myelodysplastic syndrome with multilineage dysplasia in the appropriate clinical and aspirate context; blast enumeration requires aspirate smears and CD34 immunohistochemistry.

ddx.dx: Reactive marrow hyperplasia (e.g., nutritional deficiency, drug effect)
ddx.vs: Reactive or megaloblastic changes lack micromegakaryocytes and resolve with correction of B12/folate or removal of the toxin; clonal cytogenetics favor MDS.
Requires 5-19% marrow blasts or ALIP clusters confirmed by CD34 staining, which is not established in this field.
AML shows sheets of blasts (>=20%) effacing normal hematopoiesis rather than scattered atypical precursors within mixed hematopoiesis.
PMF shows clustered, large megakaryocytes with cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei rather than small monolobated micromegakaryocytes.

60309.recognize_zh: 數顆紅血球的中央淡染區呈細長裂縫狀或嘴巴形（slit-like/mouth-shaped），而非圓形淡染區，其餘紅血球有些偏小且染色較深，符合口形紅血球（stomatocytes）。
features: Several red cells with a linear slit-like or mouth-shaped central pallor (stomatocytes)
Some red cells are dense and lack central pallor, suggesting a spherostomatocytic component
Mild anisocytosis with scattered overlapping cells
A leukocyte at the left edge; no nucleated red cells or inclusions seen
Scale bar present, but cell morphology rather than absolute size is diagnostic here
60309.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a population of red cells in which several display a linear, slit-like central pallor characteristic of stomatocytes. Other red cells are small and dense without central pallor, and mild anisocytosis is present. No target cells, schistocytes or inclusions are prominent. Findings are consistent with stomatocytosis; causes include hereditary stomatocytosis, alcohol-related liver disease, Rh-null phenotype and drying artifact, and clinical correlation is required.

ddx.vs: Artifactual stomatocytes occur in thick areas and affect nearly all cells in a region, whereas true stomatocytes are seen in well-spread areas mixed with discocytes; examining a fresh wet preparation helps.
Target cells have a central hemoglobinized dot within a ring of pallor rather than a linear slit.
Spherocytes lack central pallor entirely, whereas stomatocytes retain a slit-shaped area of pallor.
SAO shows oval cells with one or two transverse slits or bars, whereas these stomatocytes are round with a single longitudinal slit.

exam.answer_en: Stomatocytes — red cells with linear slit-like (mouth-shaped) central pallor instead of a round central pallor
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指中央淡染呈嘴巴形裂縫的紅血球，問名稱並要求列出後天與遺傳原因。
後天原因：酒精與肝病最常見，另有藥物；抹片乾燥假影也會造成，需在薄而分散區確認。
Hereditary stomatocytosis 分 overhydrated 與 dehydrated（hereditary xerocytosis，常見 PIEZO1 變異）；後者血片 stomatocyte 可不明顯、MCHC 偏高。
Hereditary stomatocytosis 患者脾切除後血栓風險明顯上升，一般不建議脾切除；這是與 HS 處置的重要差異。
Rh-null phenotype（缺乏 Rh 抗原複合體）亦表現為 stomatocytosis 與輕度溶血。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 target cell 或推片假影混淆：target cell 中央有血紅素圓點；假影 stomatocyte 多集中在抹片厚區或某一區塊。真正 stomatocyte 在薄區仍可見裂縫狀淡染。

quiz.q: 遺傳性口形紅血球症（尤其 dehydrated 型）病人為何通常不建議脾切除？
quiz.a: 脾切除後血栓（靜脈血栓、肺高壓）風險明顯增加

85.recognize_zh: 臉部與頭皮可見小型結痂丘疹（紅箭頭）；皮膚切片表皮有明顯海綿狀水腫與表皮內水泡形成，真皮到皮下脂肪有密集、繞血管及附屬器的小至中型淋巴球浸潤，並有一組IHC顯示許多細胞毒性標記陽性細胞，另有核染色型式的陽性細胞（應為EBER原位雜交），符合水痘樣水疱病淋巴增生疾患（HV-LPD）。
features: Clinical photos: small crusted/hyperpigmented papules on the temple and scalp (arrows)
Epidermis with marked spongiosis, reticular degeneration and intraepidermal vesicle formation
Dense dermal lymphoid infiltrate, perivascular and periadnexal, with angiocentric cuffing and extension into subcutaneous fat
Infiltrating cells are small to medium lymphocytes with mildly irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei; extravasated red cells

IHC panel: numerous positive lymphocytes with membranous/cytoplasmic and granular (cytotoxic-type) staining; a nuclear-pattern stain labels scattered to many infiltrating cells (consistent with EBER ISH)
Summary table lists EBV-associated T/NK lymphoproliferations and usual age groups
85.describe_en: Clinical photographs show small crusted papules on the face and scalp. Skin punch biopsy shows marked spongiosis with reticular degeneration and intraepidermal vesiculation overlying a dense, superficial and deep dermal lymphoid infiltrate that is perivascular, periadnexal and angiocentric and extends into the subcutaneous fat, with red cell extravasation. The infiltrate is composed of small to medium-sized lymphocytes with mildly irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei, without sheets of large atypical cells. Immunostains (markers not labeled in the images) highlight many lymphocytes with a granular cytotoxic-type pattern, and a nuclear-pattern stain, consistent with EBER in situ hybridization, marks numerous infiltrating cells. In the appropriate clinical setting, findings are consistent with hydroa vacciniforme lymphoproliferative disorder (cutaneous chronic active EBV infection); exact marker identities cannot be confirmed from the unlabeled panels.

ddx.vs: ENKTL typically forms destructive, necrotic masses of medium-to-large atypical EBER+ cells with prominent angiodestruction, whereas HV-LPD shows vesiculopapular lesions with a less atypical cytotoxic infiltrate in a CAEBV clinical context.
SPTCL shows lipotropic rimming of adipocytes by atypical CD8+ alpha-beta T cells confined to fat without epidermal vesiculation and is EBER-negative.
PCGDTCL has epidermotropic/panniculitic atypical TCR-delta+ cells and is usually EBV-negative, whereas HV-LPD is defined by abundant EBER+ cells.
Reactive bite reactions contain mixed eosinophils and few or no EBER+ cells, while HV-LPD requires an EBV-positive cytotoxic lymphoid infiltrate.

captions: Table: EBV-positive T/NK lymphoproliferative disorders and usual patient age groups
Clinical photo: small crusted papule on the left temple (arrow)
Clinical photo: small papular lesion at the temporal hairline (arrow)
Clinical photo: crusted scalp papule above the ear (arrow)
Skin biopsy, low power: intraepidermal vesiculation over a dense superficial and deep dermal lymphoid infiltrate (H&E)
Epidermal spongiosis and reticular degeneration with dermal lymphoid infiltrate (H&E)
High power: reticular degeneration of keratinocytes with intraepidermal lymphocytes and red cells (H&E)
Dermis: dense perivascular and periadnexal lymphoid infiltrate between collagen bundles (H&E)
High power: angiocentric small to medium lymphocytes cuffing a dermal vessel (H&E)
Deep dermis/subcutis: sheet-like infiltrate of mildly atypical lymphocytes (H&E)
Subcutaneous extension of the lymphoid infiltrate around a hair follicle and into fat (H&E)
IHC (marker unlabeled): many positive lymphocytes in the dermal infiltrate
IHC (marker unlabeled): scattered positive lymphocytes
IHC (marker unlabeled): rare positive cells in the infiltrate
IHC (marker unlabeled): numerous positive lymphocytes infiltrating subcutaneous fat
Nuclear-pattern stain (consistent with EBER ISH): scattered to numerous positive lymphoid nuclei
IHC (marker unlabeled): granular cytoplasmic staining consistent with a cytotoxic granule marker
Special stain (type not labeled): lymphoid infiltrate in subcutaneous fat

21.recognize_zh: 周邊血中可見少量芽細胞，細胞質嗜鹼性、邊緣不規則並有胞質泡突（cytoplasmic blebs）；骨髓切片為成片芽細胞，流式顯示 CD34+、MPO 陰性但 cytoplasmic CD61/CD41 呈弱陽性，指向巨核母細胞系（megakaryoblastic）。
features: Medium-to-large blasts with high N:C ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei and fine chromatin
Deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with irregular borders, pseudopod-like projections and cytoplasmic blebs
Bone marrow core shows diffuse sheets of blasts with vesicular chromatin effacing normal hematopoiesis
Flow: CD45-dim blasts, CD34+, CD13+, HLA-DR negative, CD33+ with positivity in the CD7/CD56 combined channel
Flow: cytoplasmic CD61 and CD41 dim-positive, cytoplasmic MPO negative
Peripheral blood background with normocytic red cells, few platelets and scattered mature neutrophils
21.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows occasional circulating blasts with a high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm bearing irregular projections and cytoplasmic blebs; platelets are markedly decreased. The bone marrow core biopsy is replaced by diffuse sheets of immature blasts with vesicular chromatin, consistent with the clinically reported dry tap. Flow cytometry of the marrow identifies a CD45-dim blast population that is CD34+, CD13+, CD33+, HLA-DR negative and positive in the CD7/CD56 combined channel, with dim cytoplasmic CD41 and CD61 and no cytoplasmic MPO. No Auer rods are seen. Findings are consistent with acute megakaryoblastic leukemia; cytogenetic/molecular studies (e.g., CBFA2T3::GLIS2, RBM15::MRTFA) are recommended in this non-Down syndrome child.

ddx.vs: ALL blasts may look agranular but lack cytoplasmic blebbing and express CD19/cCD79a or cCD3 rather than CD41/CD61.

ddx.dx: Myeloid proliferation associated with Down syndrome (TAM/ML-DS)
ddx.vs: Morphology and CD41/CD61 expression overlap, so the distinction rests on constitutional trisomy 21 and GATA1 mutation, absent here.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma)
ddx.vs: Tumor cells form cohesive clusters or rosettes and are CD45 negative, whereas these blasts are CD45-dim with megakaryocytic antigens.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 is also MPO negative but lacks CD41/CD61 and the platelet-like cytoplasmic blebs.

captions: Peripheral blood: scattered blasts with basophilic cytoplasm among normocytic RBCs
Composite of peripheral blood blasts with irregular cytoplasmic borders and blebs
Bone marrow core biopsy: diffuse sheets of blasts
Bone marrow flow cytometry: CD34+, HLA-DR-, cCD41/cCD61 dim+, MPO- blasts

exam.answer_en: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia (non-Down syndrome child) — blasts with basophilic blebbed cytoplasm; flow CD34+, MPO-negative, cytoplasmic CD41/CD61 positive
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指胞質深嗜鹼性、邊緣有泡突（blebs）的母細胞問系別，並問確認需哪些標記——CD41、CD61（及 CD42b），MPO 陰性。
骨髓常伴網狀纖維化造成 dry tap，診斷要靠切片 IHC（CD61、CD42b）與流式。
非 Down 症兒童 AMKL 的融合基因：RBM15::MRTFA（t(1;22)，嬰兒）、CBFA2T3::GLIS2（預後差）、NUP98::KDM5A。
Down 症 ML-DS 帶 GATA1 突變、化療反應良好；新生兒 transient abnormal myelopoiesis（TAM）可自行緩解。
exam.pitfall_zh: 芽細胞成團、MPO 陰性又 dry tap，易誤認為 ALL 或轉移性小圓藍細胞腫瘤（如 neuroblastoma）；需做 CD41/CD61/CD42b 與上皮/神經標記區分。

quiz.q: 胞質有泡突、MPO 陰性的芽細胞，流式要看哪兩個標記證明巨核母細胞系？

65813.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片白血球極多，同一視野就能看到骨髓細胞（myelocyte）、後骨髓細胞、帶狀及分節嗜中性球等各成熟階段，並有一顆深紫色顆粒遮蓋細胞核的嗜鹼性球與少數大型未成熟細胞，背景血小板不少，是慢性骨髓性白血病（CML）慢性期的典型血片。
features: Marked leukocytosis with a continuous spectrum of granulocytic maturation: myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Occasional large immature cells (promyelocyte/blast-like) with fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm, few in number
Basophil with coarse dark purple granules obscuring the nucleus
Granulocytes lack toxic granulation, Döhle bodies or obvious dysplasia
Numerous platelets in the background; red cells normochromic with central pallor accentuated by smear thickness
65813.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis composed of granulocytes at all stages of maturation, including myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils, with only occasional large immature cells. A basophil is present, and the granulocytes lack toxic changes or significant dysplasia. Platelets appear increased, and red cells are largely normocytic and normochromic. Eosinophilia described in the case is not prominent in this particular field. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, chronic phase, as confirmed by RT-PCR.

ddx.vs: A leukemoid reaction shows mainly mature neutrophils and bands with toxic granulation and Döhle bodies, few myelocytes, no basophilia and no BCR::ABL1 fusion.
aCML has prominent dysgranulopoiesis (hypogranular, pseudo-Pelger neutrophils) without basophilia and is BCR::ABL1 negative.
CNL shows predominantly mature segmented neutrophils with <10% immature granulocytes and a CSF3R mutation.
PMF shows leukoerythroblastosis with teardrop cells and nucleated red cells rather than the myelocyte-rich leukocytosis with basophilia seen here.

exam.answer_en: Chronic myeloid leukemia, chronic phase — leukocytosis with full spectrum of granulocytic maturation and basophils on blood smear
pearls_zh: 考法：辨認同一視野中 myelocyte、metamyelocyte、band、segmented neutrophil，並找出嗜鹼性球（絕對嗜鹼性球增多是 CML 線索）。
必驗 BCR::ABL1：核型 t(9;22)、FISH 或 RT-PCR；p210 為 CML 主要轉錄本，p190 多見於 Ph+ ALL。
慢性期周邊芽細胞通常很少；WHO 5th blast phase 門檻為 blasts ≥20%。
常伴血小板增多與脾腫大；TKI 治療後以 BCR::ABL1 IS 追蹤分子反應。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 leukemoid reaction；後者以 band/metamyelocyte 為主，有毒性顆粒與 Döhle bodies、無嗜鹼性球增多，且 BCR::ABL1 陰性。

quiz.q: 圖中核被深紫色粗顆粒遮蓋的細胞是什麼？其增多對診斷的意義？
quiz.a: Basophil；絕對嗜鹼性球增多支持 CML

4181.recognize_zh: 真皮內片狀排列單一型態的圓形細胞，核圓至卵圓、居中、染色質均勻，胞質豐富淡嗜酸性、邊界清楚（煎蛋樣），間雜少數嗜酸性球；這是皮膚肥大細胞浸潤（mastocytoma/urticaria pigmentosa）的典型樣貌。
features: Sheets of monomorphic, evenly spaced cells with round to oval central nuclei
Abundant pale eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm with distinct cell borders ('fried-egg' appearance)
Bland nuclei with evenly distributed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and no significant mitotic activity
Scattered eosinophils within the infiltrate
Delicate collagen bundles separating the cells in a diffuse dermal pattern
4181.describe_en: Section of skin shows a diffuse, dense dermal infiltrate composed of sheets of monomorphic cells with central, round to oval bland nuclei and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with well-defined borders, imparting a fried-egg appearance. Scattered eosinophils are admixed, and mitotic figures and necrosis are not evident. Granules are not discernible on H&E at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a cutaneous mast cell infiltrate (mastocytoma/maculopapular cutaneous mastocytosis) in a patient with systemic mastocytosis; tryptase, CD117 and CD25 immunostains or Giemsa/toluidine blue would confirm.

ddx.vs: LCH cells have grooved, reniform nuclei, are often epidermotropic and are CD1a+/langerin+ rather than tryptase+/CD117+.
Nevus cells form nests that mature with depth and are S100/SOX10-positive, lacking metachromatic granules.
JXG contains foamy histiocytes and Touton giant cells and is CD68+/Factor XIIIa+ and tryptase-negative.
Myeloid sarcoma consists of immature blasts with fine chromatin, nucleoli and mitoses, expressing MPO/CD34 rather than tryptase.

exam.answer_en: Cutaneous mast cell infiltrate in mastocytosis — dermal sheets of monomorphic fried-egg cells with admixed eosinophils
pearls_zh: 考法：H&E 辨認煎蛋樣單一細胞並問譜系；確認需特殊染色：Giemsa/toluidine blue（異染顆粒）、tryptase、CD117。
Systemic mastocytosis 腫瘤性肥大細胞常異常表現 CD25（亦可 CD2、CD30）；成人 SM 絕大多數有 KIT D816V。
WHO SM 主要標準：骨髓或其他皮膚外器官有多灶緻密肥大細胞聚集（每灶 ≥15 顆）；次要標準含 serum tryptase >20 ng/mL。
Darier sign：搓揉皮膚病灶引起紅腫與蕁麻疹；需避免誘發肥大細胞去顆粒的刺激與藥物。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Langerhans cell histiocytosis 或皮內痣；LCH 核有溝、CD1a+，肥大細胞核圓居中、tryptase/CD117 陽性且 Giemsa 顆粒呈異染。

quiz.q: 確認這些煎蛋樣細胞為肥大細胞的 IHC？腫瘤性肥大細胞常異常表現哪個標記？
